title: Associate Professor in Radiography
description:
A position as associate professor (10% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Radiology (Odense), the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark.

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology, Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), in collaboration with University College Lillebælt (UCL) and Odense Universitetshospital (OUH), invites applications for a position as Associate Professor in Radiography, with 10% research time at the Department of Radiology, OUH. The position is offered for a five-year period with the possibility of extension. The starting date is subject to agreement.

About the research unit

UNIFY – Research and Innovation Unit of Radiology conducts high-quality research across all radiological specialties and contributes significantly to the education and development of highly qualified staff for both clinical and academic work.

The unit values researchers with diverse professional backgrounds and has approximately 20 affiliated members, including a professor, associate professors, PhD students, adjunct professors and others.

The unit has a well-established research environment and organises a number of regular activities and meetings throughout the year, including research retreats combining academic and social activities.

Research and Teaching ResponsibilitiesThe position involves research, academic development, research training, teaching, including examinations, supervision and assessment activities.

Qualifications and ExpectationsThe Associate Professor must hold a primary position at UCL.

The successful applicant must have documented research and teaching experience within radiography and a particular interest in ultrasound.

Furthermore, strong collaborative skills are required in order to further develop research in radiography, both across disciplines and at national and international level. Having international research collaborators is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

Joint Research Strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and OUH

The joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and OUH sets the direction for our shared research activities in the coming years.

Based on the vision, “We conduct research together to create the patient care of the future,” particular emphasis is placed on:

  • Research across disciplines, with people at the centre

  • Strong research environments as a driving force for development

  • The research pathway from idea to impact

Further information about the joint research strategy is available on the SDU website.

Applicants Must Document

  • A PhD degree or equivalent postgraduate research qualifications

  • Relevant research experience documented through publications in international peer-reviewed journals

  • Relevant clinical experience

  • Relevant experience in educational administration

  • A successful track record in obtaining research funding

Applicants must meet the qualifications required at Associate Professor level in accordance with the applicable Danish Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Reporting

The Associate Professor will report to Head of Research Bo Mussmann on matters relating to the associate professorship.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Head of Research Bo Mussmann, Department of Clinical Research/OUH: Email: bo.mussmann@rsyd.dk, Telephone: +45 20 59 88 56

Application deadline

01.11.2026 at 23:59 CET

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Associate Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed associate professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Kløvervænget 10, 2nd floor, 5000 Odense C, Denmark.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below. 

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply. 

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation. 

Your application must include the following as PDF files:

Please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total).

  • a motivation letter 

  • a detailed CV 

  • degree certificates (including a Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications 

  • 6 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file. 

  • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan

  • a detailed description of research experience 

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark.

title: Purchaser - Global Supply Chain
description:
Do you have experience with technical or project procurement in a larger international company? Would you like to help develop a global supply chain in an international project-driven organization? Then you may be the Purchaser we are looking for.

We are upgrading, servicing, and operating engine- and biomass-based power plants around the world. This creates a continuous need to source goods and services from subcontractors and ensure reliable transport for our customers.

For our Global Supply Chain department, we are looking for an outgoing and internationally minded colleague with commitment, determination, and a positive attitude. The department consists of 20 employees responsible for procurement, warehousing, and transport of goods and services.

BWSC – Ever better energy! 

Join us in our mission of building a world of sustainable energy and make a meaningful impact on the world of power generation and energy conversion.

BWSC is a leading player in the power generation industry, specializing in the service, operations, and maintenance of power plants. We are seeking to always provide Ever Better Energy whether it comes to optimizing a conventional power plant, operating a biomass power plant or constructing new energy facilities. Our commitment to excellence, innovation, and environmental stewardship sets us apart in the industry.

Your responsibilities

  • Support Project Procurement Managers with procurement tasks related to the execution of upgrading, service- and maintenance projects for engine and biomass power plants globally.
  • Obtain quotations from suppliers and place purchase orders within a defined area of responsibility.
  • Participate in broader departmental activities such as category management, supplier relationship development, negotiations, and implementation of supplier agreements.
  • Contribute to identifying and evaluating potential suppliers.
  • Convert purchase requisitions into purchase orders.
  • Maintain and update various data, including supplier data, in the ERP system.
  • Follow up on purchase orders, deliveries and invoice approvals.
  • Assist with various development-oriented Global Supply Chain tasks within BWSC, including work instructions and new workflows.

The work is carried out in close collaboration with other departments in a dynamic and project-oriented organization. A flexible, cooperative, and positive attitude is therefore essential.

Desired Background and Qualifications

  • Experience within procurement, including purchase order placement and follow-up.
  • Completed education as an office assistant and/or relevant higher education qualification.
  • Minimum 3 years of practical experience with technical or project procurement.
  • Strong written and spoken English skills.
  • Good IT skills and experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
  • Ability to work in a structured manner and meet deadlines.

What do we offer? 

At BWSC we build inspiring careers locally and internationally and give you access to a great network of possibilities. 

We offer you a position with great colleagues and the opportunity to bring your skills into play and grow professionally and personally. As a Purchaser at BWSC, you will receive a competitive starting salary and a strong reward package.

We offer an exciting position in a skilled, collaborative, and project-driven work environment, with opportunities for professional development and growth.

We have a good canteen, fitness facilities, and an active Staff Club that organizes various events and activities. Our HQ is located in Allerød, close to the train station and only a 30-minute ride from central Copenhagen.

Ready for a challenge?  

We review applications and invite relevant candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Supply Chain Manager Anders S. A. Pedersen at asap@bwsc.dk.

title: Consultant Interventional Cardiologist
description:
Consultant Interventional Cardiologist – PCI On-Call ServiceDepartment of Cardiology, Aalborg University Hospital, DenmarkThe opportunityAre you an experienced interventional cardiologist looking to join a highly specialised university hospital with a strong clinical, academic and collaborative environment?The Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is seeking one or more Consultant Interventional Cardiologists from the EU/EØS to join our team. We welcome applications from candidates who are already qualified to participate in a PCI on-call service, as well as experienced PCI operators who are motivated to develop the additional competencies required for on-call duties.The position is available as soon as possible or by mutual agreement.This is an opportunity to work in a busy interventional cardiology environment, contribute to the development of specialised cardiac care and collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across cardiology, cardiac surgery and other disciplines.The positionYour primary clinical responsibilities will be within interventional cardiology, particularly percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.You will be part of a multidisciplinary team providing specialised care for patients with ischaemic heart disease, including patients requiring urgent and complex coronary interventions.Depending on your experience, qualifications and the department's clinical needs, there may also be opportunities to contribute to the development of other specialised interventional services, including transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) and chronic total occlusion (CTO) procedures.Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you will contribute to the department's research, teaching and professional development activities, as well as relevant administrative and organisational tasks.What we offer
  • The opportunity to work in a busy university hospital with an established PCI service and a broad range of specialised cardiology services.
  • Professional development: Opportunities to further develop your interventional skills and, where appropriate, expand your expertise into complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
  • A strong multidisciplinary team: Close collaboration with cardiologists across subspecialties, cardiothoracic anaesthetists and cardiac surgeons.
  • An academic environment: Opportunities to participate in clinical research, teaching and the development of new treatment pathways.
  • Supportive colleagues and leadership: We value professional respect, constructive collaboration and a positive working environment.
  • Flexible working arrangements: Working hours and duty schedules are organised within the applicable employment framework.
  • An international perspective: The opportunity to join a university hospital committed to clinical excellence, research, education and continuous improvement.
Qualifications and experienceEssential requirements
  • You hold specialist certification in cardiology.
  • You have or are able to obtain a Danish Authorization to practice medicine
  • You are fluent in or command a professional working proficiency in Danish. Norwegian or Swedish (B2/C1 level)
  • Or are willing to learn Danish
  • You can perform PCI procedures independently.
  • You have the clinical judgement and professional skills required to manage patients with ischaemic heart disease.
  • You communicate effectively and work constructively with colleagues across clinical disciplines.
  • You can maintain an overview and make sound clinical decisions in a demanding and sometimes unpredictable environment.
  • You are committed to high standards of patient care, patient safety and continuous professional development.
  • You are willing to contribute to the department's clinical, organisational and educational activities and to take on the leadership and supervisory responsibilities associated with a consultant position.
Desirable qualifications
  • Experience participating in a PCI on-call service.
  • Experience from a university hospital or another highly specialised cardiac centre.
  • Experience in complex PCI, TAVI or CTO procedures.
  • A PhD, or other research qualifications or a strong record of scientific publications.
  • Experience in clinical research, teaching or quality improvement.
  • Experience in a PCI on-call service is an advantage but is not essential, provided you are an independent PCI operator and are motivated to acquire the necessary competencies following an appropriate period of training and induction.
About the DepartmentThe Department of Cardiology at Aalborg University Hospital is a large, specialised and research-active department providing advanced care across a broad range of cardiovascular conditions, including ischaemic heart disease, cardiac arrhythmias, heart failure, valvular heart disease, thoracic aortic aneurysms, pericardial diseases, thromboembolic disorders and dyslipidaemia.Our department performs approximately:
  • 6,000 invasive procedures annually
  • 8,000 inpatient admissions annually
  • More than 30,000 outpatient consultations annually
  • Approximately 14,000 echocardiographic examinations annually
Our medical team comprises doctors at different stages of postgraduate training and 32 consultant cardiologists, including two professors.We provide inpatient and outpatient services, operate a cardiac catheterisation laboratory and maintain a dedicated cardiology research unit.Our work is guided by a shared commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety and involving patients and their families in shared decision-making. We also have a strong responsibility for undergraduate medical education and postgraduate specialist training.The department operates across three hospital sites in Aalborg, Thisted and Hobro, with the vast majority of clinical activity based at the newly built Aalborg University Hospital.Salary and terms of employmentThis is a full-time position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable Danish collective agreement.The position includes participation in the department's PCI on-call service.Further details regarding the on-call arrangement and employment conditions can be discussed with the Head of Department or Lead Senior Physician Bent Raungaard tlf. 27201096, e-mail: b.raungaard@rn.dk ApplicationApplications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be arranged continuously. The advertisement will be withdrawn once the position has been filled.Please submit your application by email to:Ljubica Vukelic AndersenHead of Department of CardiologyAalborg University Hospital, DenmarkEmail: ljubica.andersen@rn.dkTelephone: +45 30 38 25 10Please include:
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV).
  • Letter of motivation
  • Proof of specialist certification in cardiology.
  • List of publications, if applicable.
The assessment process will follow the applicable Danish requirements for consultant appointments, including assessment of competencies across the seven physician roles.

title: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

  • PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

  • Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

  • Expertise in visual attention and perception

  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

  • Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

  • Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

  • Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

  • Good command of statistics

  • Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

  • Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

  • Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be in English and submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". 

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • A letter of motivation (max. 1 page)

  • A detailed CV

  • Master and PhD degree certificates, if available

  • A complete and numbered list of publications 

  • Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

  • Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Work tasks: Hausing is a dedicated property management software platform that helps commercial property managers and owners save time through automation and gain a real-time overview with centralized portfolio data. The solution replaces manual and unreliable spreadsheets, allowing users to track lease changes, special agreements, work orders, utilities, and analytics in one place. title: Autoremondilukksepp
description:
Varasem kogemus autoremondi vallas vähemalt aasta.

Tööülesanded: Meil on töökojas tõstukid, tööriistad, õli, rooste, katkised autod ja aeg-ajalt ka klient, kes vannub, et “enne teie juurde tulekut oli kõik korras”.Kui sa ei minesta rooste peale, ei hakka nutma kinnise poldi pärast ja tead, et “kliendi sõber juba vaatas” tähendab tavaliselt uut õudusfilmi kapoti all — siis räägime. Puudu on veel üks **autoremondi lukksepp**, kes ei hakka nutma, kui polt on kinni, käsi on must või kapoti alt vaatab vastu järjekordne “kodune remont”.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie poolt:🔥 normaalne palk — kui oskad, siis saad ka raha; 🔥 päris töö, mitte niisama kapoti silitamine; 🔥 seltskond, kus nalja saab ja lumehelbekesed sulavad kiiresti; 🔥 tööriided, lisasoodustused; 🔥 autod, mille kallal saad oma viha seaduslikult välja elada.

Muud nõuded: Ootame sind, kui:✅ tead, et haamer ei ole alati vägivald — vahel on see diagnostikavahend; ✅ saad aru, et “klõbin ees vasakul” võib tähendada kõike alates kondist kuni täieliku katastroofini; ✅ ei arva, et piduritoru paikamine teibiga on loominguline lahendus; ✅ oskad autot remontida nii, et see pärast ka päriselt töötab; ✅ sul on töötahe suurem kui soov reede pärastlõunal kella vaadata.

title: Breakfast Cook
description:
Work tasks: Kolm Õde boutique hotel (Pikk 71, Tallinn Old Town) is looking for a breakfast chef to join our team. Our breakfast is a buffet focused on Estonian produce and bread and pastries baked on site, and it is open to guests of the hotel and our apartments as well as to outside visitors. Your main duties: - preparing hot and cold breakfast dishes (egg dishes, porridges, hot sides, salads, cold cuts, smoked fish, etc.); - baking bread, buns and morning pastries on site; - setting up the buffet before opening and keeping it replenished during breakfast; - taking care of the taste, freshness and attractive presentation of the food; - preparing for the next day (doughs, prep work, etc.); - monitoring stock, preparing orders and receiving deliveries; - following food hygiene and self-monitoring (HACCP) requirements, checking temperatures and shelf life; - keeping the kitchen, equipment and tools clean and in order; - working closely with the breakfast server and reception, and helping develop the menu. You are responsible for making sure every morning starts with a tasty, fresh and beautifully presented breakfast for our guests.

We offer: - Work in a unique setting: Kolm Õde boutique hotel is housed in three medieval merchant houses in the heart of Tallinn Old Town.- The opportunity to bring your own ideas to the menu. - Morning working hours – your evenings stay free. - Work uniform. - A small, friendly team and international guests. - A central location that is easy to reach by public transport.

Other requirements: - Previous experience as a cook (experience with breakfast service, hotel kitchens or baking is a big plus). - Valid health certificate (tervisetõend). - Willingness to work early mornings, as well as on Saturdays and Sundays. - Cleanliness, accuracy, independence and good time management. - A desire to cook tasty, beautifully presented food and to help develop our new breakfast concept.

Option to work from home: No

Tööülesanded: Otsime kohusetundlikku, hoolikat ja kogenud koristajat pikaajaliseks koostööks.📍 Töö asukoht: Mustamäe, Sääse tänav, Tallinn. või 📍 Töö asukoht: Kesklinn, Türi tänav, Tallinn. description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas. Otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt. Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

title: P2P IT Project Support Specialist
description:
For our client were looking for a P2P IT Project Support Specialist.

The P2P IT Project Support Specialist provides additional capacity to the existing P2P IT team during a period of high project activity and multiple concurrent go-lives.

The role supports project delivery by coordinating and executing testing activities, investigating and resolving application and integration issues, managing project risks, and collaborating with stakeholders across multiple IT workstreams, suppliers and business users. The position complements the existing team, which provides the business knowledge, application expertise, and historical project context.

This role requires an experienced professional who can quickly become productive, work independently, coordinate stakeholders, and proactively drive assigned activities to completion.

Key responsibilities:
· Support multiple P2P-related projects, enhancements, and go-live activities.
· Plan, coordinate, and execute testing activities, including integration testing, end-to-end testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing support.
· Investigate application issues, process failures, data discrepancies, and integration errors, and drive resolution with relevant teams.
· Analyze error logs, identify root causes, and coordinate corrective actions.
· Follow up on open defects and ensure timely resolution before go-live.
· Collaborate closely with other IT teams, application owners, developers, vendors, and project stakeholders.
· Identify project risks, dependencies, and potential impacts, and proactively escalate when needed. · Perform Finance master data maintenance activities, including data creation, updates, validation, issue resolution, and data quality monitoring.
· Contribute to process improvements and automation opportunities.
· Ensure solutions comply with information security and data privacy requirements.

Required experience and competencies:

Functional and technical skills:
· Experience working with enterprise applications and IT projects.
· Understanding of Finance and Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) processes.
· Knowledge of Finance master data and experience with master data maintenance.
· Experience of Basware, Infor LN and M3 would be an advantage.
· Strong understanding of integrations, interfaces, and data flows.
· Experience with testing, defect management, and issue resolution.
· Ability to analyze application errors, integration failures, and data issues.
· Understanding of project risk management.Personal capabilities:
· Self-driven and able to work independently with limited supervision.
· Strong can-do attitude and ownership mindset.
· Curious, analytical, and eager to investigate and solve problems.
· Comfortable working in a fast-paced project environment with multiple parallel activities.
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
· Ability to coordinate activities across different IT teams and stakeholders.
· Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Preferred qualifications:
· Experience with e-invoicing mandates and compliance requirements.
· Experience with invoice automation or P2P applications.
· Understanding of RPA and automation technologies.
· Experience working in multinational environments.
· Exposure to IT Service Management processes.

Seniority level: Experienced Specialist (Mid-level to Senior)
This role is intended for an experienced professional who can independently manage support activities, contribute to projects, and act as a trusted partner to IT stakeholders. The role is particularly suited for a resource who can rapidly contribute during intensive project and go-live phases without requiring significant day-to-day guidance.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have hands-on experience working with Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) and Finance processes in an IT/project environment?*

title: Autonasentaja
description: **Autonasentaja, määräaikainen - hakusessa Laihialle** M. Laulajan Autokorjaamo Oy, LaihiaM. Laulajan Autokorjaamolla on korjattu autoja Laihialla jo **50 vuoden ajan.** Olemme paikallinen Bosch Car Service -monimerkkikorjaamo, ja nyt etsimme porukkaamme yhtä tekijää lisää määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.Työsuhde on **perhevapaan sijaisuus,** ja se alkaa 2.11.2026. Työtä on tarjolla vähintään **31.08.2027 saakka.****Mitä työ pitää sisällään?** Työ on monipuolista henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustyötä. Päivittäisiin töihin kuuluu osaamisesi mukaan esimerkiksi määräaikaishuoltoja, jarru- ja alustatöitä, jakopäätöitä sekä vianetsintää ja muita korjaamotöitä.Työskentelemme useiden automerkkien parissa, joten arvostamme kykyä tarttua erilaisiin töihin itsenäisesti.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?** Toivomme sinulta autoalan koulutusta ja/tai tehtävään soveltuvaa aiempaa työkokemusta. Tärkeintä meille on käytännön osaaminen, huolellinen työnjälki ja kyky hoitaa annetut työt itsenäisesti.B-ajokortti on tehtävässä välttämätön.Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta monimerkkikorjaamosta sekä osaamista esimerkiksi vianetsinnästä, alusta- ja jarrutöistä tai moottorin mekaanisista korjauksista.Jos diagnostiikka, sähkö- ja hybridiautot tai jokin muu osa-alue on erityisesti sinun juttusi, kerro siitä meille.Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata, mutta **odotamme, että sinulla on jo valmiudet työskennellä autonasentajan tehtävissä.****Mitä meiltä sitten saa?** Tarjoamme kokoaikaisen määräaikaisen työn pitkään toimineessa paikallisessa autokorjaamossa, monipuoliset työtehtävät, asianmukaiset työvälineet ja kokeneen työporukan tuen.**Palkka**: **15-20 €/h osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan, vähintään sovellettavan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.**Kyseessä on ensisijaisesti perhevapaan sijaisuus, mutta **mahdollisesta jatkosta voidaan keskustella tilanteen mukaan.****Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaiset huolto- ja korjaustyöt ovat sinulle tutuimpia.****Hakuaika päättyy 31.10.2026** Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. **Paikka voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.****Täytä hakemus lomakkeen kautta, tai lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ja ansioluettelo liitteenä sähköpostitse: laulaja.korjaamo@anvianet.fi****M. Laulajan Autokorjaamo Oy** 50 vuotta paikallista autokorjaamista Laihialla.

title: Service Instructor
description: **Join Us as a Cleaning Services Instructor – Commercial Cleaning -Lahti, Heinola, Hartola / Päijät-Häme**Are you an experienced cleaning professional interested in a supervisory role where you can support the team in its daily work and ensure high-quality service? At N-Clean, we work responsibly as part of a reliable and supportive team.You will work as a Cleaning Services Instructor under the guidance of a manager, playing a key role in ensuring that cleaning operations at customer sites run smoothly and meet quality standards. You will work responsibly, ensuring that tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with our shared quality standards and procedures. You will act as a key link between employees, operational management and customers, supporting your manager. However, the role does not include formal managerial responsibilities.Customer service is central to this position. Success in the role requires a customer-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills. title: Asumisen ohjaaja, Vammaispalvelut, Someron asumisyksikkö
description: Asumisen ohjaajana olet mukana rakentamassa 14 asukkaan omannäköistä ja mahdollisimman itsenäistä arkea Someron asumisyksikössä. Saat monipuolisen työn, jossa yhdistyvät ohjaus, hoiva, yhteistyö ja asukkaiden toimintakyvyn tukeminen. Tehtäväsi Someron asumisyksikkö tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista täysi-ikäisille vammaisille, kehitysvammaisille, neurokirjolla oleville tai vastaavia haasteita omaaville henkilöille. Vuonna 2023 valmistuneessa yksikössä asuu 14 asukasta, ja se sijaitsee kävelymatkan päässä Someron palveluista. Asumisen ohjaajana ohjaat ja avustat asukkaita päivittäisissä toiminnoissa sekä tuet heidän hyvinvointiaan, toimintakykyään ja itsemääräämisoikeuttaan. Työsi tavoitteena on mahdollistaa jokaiselle asukkaalle mahdollisimman itsenäinen, mielekäs ja hänen omannäköisensä arki. Vastaat yhdessä muun työryhmän kanssa asukkaiden päivittäisen toiminnan toteutumisesta, aktiivisen arjen mahdollistamisesta sekä hyvästä ja laadukkaasta hoidosta. Työhösi kuuluu ohjaus- ja perushoitotyötä sekä tarvittaessa terveydenhuollon tehtäviä, kuten lääkehoidon toteuttamista ja asukkaiden avustamista itsehoidollisissa tehtävissä. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asukkaiden omaisten ja läheisten sekä muiden yhteistyötahojen, kuten päiväaikaisen toiminnan kanssa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu lisäksi asukkaiden erilaisten hakemusten ja toteuttamissuunnitelmien laatiminen ja päivittäminen sekä niiden toteutumisen seuranta. Työskentelet osana työryhmää, jossa yhteistyö, toisten arvostaminen ja hyvä työilmapiiri ovat keskeisiä. Tarvittaessa työskentelet myös noin kilometrin päässä sijaitsevan Tuulentuvan asumisyksikön tukena. Työ on kolmivuorotyötä. Mitä tarjoamme sinulle Saat tehdä monipuolista työtä, jossa osaamisellasi on konkreettinen merkitys asukkaiden arjen jatkuvuudelle ja hyvälle elämälle. Työn vaihtelevissa tilanteissa pääset käyttämään omaa ammattitaitoasi ja kehittämään sitä edelleen. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden osallistua työnantajan järjestämiin koulutuksiin ja vahvistaa osaamistasi työn ohessa. Työskentelet vuonna 2023 valmistuneissa nykyaikaisissa tiloissa, ja voit vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi. Mitä odotamme sinulta Toivomme sinulta aktiivista ja kehittämismyönteistä työotetta sekä halua rakentaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa asukkaille hyvää arkea. Tehtävässä tarvitset hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ihmissuhdetaitoja sekä kykyä ymmärtää ja hyväksyä erilaisuutta. Muutosvalmius ja hyvät tietotekniset taidot tukevat onnistumistasi tehtävässä. Arvostamme perehtyneisyyttä kehitysvammaisalaan ja vammaispalveluihin. Eduksi luetaan sosionomin koulutus sekä voimassa olevat lääkehoidon LOVe-suoritukset. Edellytämme sinulta hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa sekä tyydyttävää suullista ja kirjallista ruotsin kielen taitoa. Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on soveltuva sosiaali- tai terveydenhuoltoalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto tai vastaava aikaisempi opistoasteen tutkinto tai ammatillinen tutkinto. Hae tehtävään ja liity joukkoomme rakentamaan asukkaille parempaa, heidän omannäköistään arkea. Odotamme hakemustasi!

title: Lähihoitaja, Elontien ryhmäkoti (ruotsinkielinen)
description: Etsimme lähihoitajaa Elontien ruotsinkieliseen ryhmäkotiin Helsinkiin vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Työ on jaksotyötä.Elontie on ryhmäkoti aikuisille vammaisille henkilöille, joiden palveluntarpeet vaihtelevat. Useat asiakkaistamme osallistuvat päivätoimintaan arkipäivisin. Ryhmäkodissa on kahdeksan asuntoa sekä yhteisiä tiloja, kuten keittiö, olohuone ja pyykkitupa. Yksikkö sijaitsee Länsi-Pakilassa rauhallisella pientaloalueella hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella.Tarjoamme kodinomaista ja asiakaslähtöistä asumispalvelua, joka perustuu jokaisen asiakkaan omiin toiveisiin ja tarpeisiin. Rakennamme yhdessä turvallista ja virikkeellistä kotiympäristöä, jossa asiakkailla on mahdollisuus mielekkääseen tekemiseen.Lähihoitajana olet tärkeä osa asiakkaidemme arkea. Työ on monipuolista ja sisältää hoitoa ja huolenpitoa, kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, ulkoilua, retkiä ja yhteisiä hetkiä asiakkaiden kanssa. Teet myös yhteistyötä asiakkaiden läheisten kanssa ja kirjaat asiakastyötä.Työskentelymme lähtökohtana ovat asiakkaan osallisuus, itsemääräämisoikeus ja valinnanvapaus. Arvostamme henkilökohtaista soveltuvuutta ja etsimme sinua, joka olet kiinnostunut työskentelemään vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa ja nautit ihmisten parissa työskentelystä. Olet empaattinen, kohtaat ihmiset arvostavasti ja sinulla on avoin asenne. Arvostamme myös myönteistä työotetta ja herkkyyttä asiakkaiden yksilöllisille tarpeille. Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen työhön.Saat yhteensä 1 000 euron rekrytointilisän: 500 euroa työsuhteen alussa ja toiset 500 euroa, kun työsuhteesi on jatkunut kuusi kuukautta.Mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen työn lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle kattavat koulutus- ja kehittymismahdollisuudet. Kaupungin työntekijänä voit hakea Auroranlinnan vuokra-asuntoa, jossa vuokrataso on markkinahintoja edullisempi ja kaupungin työntekijöiden hakemukset ovat etusijalla.Koska elämä on muutakin kuin työtä, haluamme tukea työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa. Saat käyttöösi Epassi Flex -kokonaisuuden, joka sisältää liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedut. Edun arvo voi olla enintään 550 euroa kalenterivuodessa, ja käytettävissä olevan saldon määrä riippuu työsuhteesi kestosta. Lisäksi saat lounasedun. Henkilöstöetuna käytössäsi on myös kaupunkipyöräetu, ja halutessasi voit viettää vapaa-aikaa kaupungin henkilöstön omalla virkistyssaarella.KelpoisuusehdotTehtävän kelpoisuusehtona on lähihoitajan ammatillinen tutkinto. Edellytämme rekisteröitymistä Lupa- ja valvontaviraston (entinen Valvira) terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöiden keskusrekisteriin.Kielitaitovaatimuksena on hyvä ruotsin kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito sekä tyydyttävä suomen kielen taito.Valittavan henkilön tulee ennen valintapäätöstä esittää työterveyshuollon arvio edellytyksistään hoitaa tehtävää. Lisäksi edellytetään huumausainetestiä koskevaa todistusta, joka tulee esittää työnantajalle ennen työsuhteen alkamista.Tehtävässä edellytetään tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa.Edellytämme LOVE/LOP-lääkehoitoluvan suorittamista hyväksytysti viimeistään koeajan aikana.Tehtävään valittavan, vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevän henkilön on esitettävä rikosrekisteriote (laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

title: Research fellow (University Researcher) in AI for Population Health and Genomics
description: Research fellow (University Researcher) in AI for Population Health and GenomicsThe Faculty of Science and the Finnish Institute for Molecular Medicine Finland (FIMM), HiLIFE at the University of Helsinki invite applications for a joint (50%:50%) position asRESEARCH FELLOW (UNIVERSITY RESEARCHER) IN AI FOR POPULATION HEALTH AND GENOMICSfor a fixed-term appointment of maximum 4 years with starting date as soon as possible.POSITION DESCRIPTIONThe position relates to the Sustainable Wellbeing Across Lifespan (SWAN) (https://www.swan-helsinkiuni.net/) research action that conducts cutting-edge research to promote health span by identifying individual risks and susceptibilities, aiming to clarify mechanisms of degeneration across the lifespan and exploring new approaches to detecting, monitoring and treating remodeled metabolism associated with ageing.The candidate is expected to develop an independent research program within this scope, focusing on methodological innovation and the application of modern AI approaches to large-scale biomedical data. Research topics may include foundation models for longitudinal electronic health records and genomics, multimodal learning integrating health records with molecular data, causal representation learning, in-context learning and amortized inference for healthcare decision-making, and AI-assisted scientific discovery workflows.The work will be done together with the Ganna Lab (https://www.dsgelab.org/) at FIMM and the Probabilistic Machine Learning Lab (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/researchgroups/probabilistic-machine-learning; groups of Acerbi and Klami) at the Department of Computer Science, aligning with concurrent projects developing foundation models for healthcare. The groups are active members of the ELLIS Institute Finland (https://www.ellisinstitute.fi/), providing opportunities for collaboration with leading researchers in artificial intelligence across Finland and Europe.The position offers access to globally unique research resources, including nationwide longitudinal health records from Finland covering more than five billion healthcare events, FinnGen with genomic data from over 500,000 participants, and extensive multi-omics datasets including proteomics and single-cell transcriptomics. Researchers also benefit from access to world-class computing infrastructure through CSC and LUMI, one of Europe's most powerful supercomputers.RESPONSIBILITIESThe appointed researcher is expected to pursue independent research on methodological innovation in developing and applying AI methods, in collaboration with existing research groups at the university, and will have the opportunity to be part of ELLIS Institute Finland activities. They will also participate in university-wide activities advancing the use of AI in scientific research, together with other researchers working in the intersection of AI and other scientific disciplines.The daily working activities of the appointed researcher will be split between the Faculty of Science and FIMM. Opportunities for contribution to teaching (up to 5-10% of annual working time) will be provided.QUALIFICATIONSWe require a doctoral degree and postdoctoral research experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or computational statistics, with demonstrated interest in applications to population health and/or human genetics.The candidates need to have: * A doctoral degree in a suitable field * Research activity after PhD (typically 2-4 years of postdoctoral research), ideally with evidence of independent research contributions, ability to lead a research group, experience in research funding acquisition, and public engagement. * Scientific competence in developing and/or applying artificial intelligence methods with proven publication record in scientific venues in the field. We expect publication record in top-tier venues in AI and machine learning (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or similar) and/or publications with clear AI contributions in leading biomedical journals (e.g. Nature Genetics, Nature Medicine, Nature Machine Intelligence or similar). * Personal research interest that relates to the scope and topic of the position and connects to existing research groups at the University of Helsinki.WHAT WE OFFERUniversity of Helsinki is an equal opportunity employer and offers an attractive and diverse workplace with a variety of development opportunities and benefits. The appointees monthly salary varies between 4800-6000€ depending on their previous experience and qualifications. The employment contract will include a probationary period of six months.The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by the University of Helsinki. International staff are supported in relocating to Finland.HOW TO APPLYPlease submit your application, together with the required attachments, through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System via the link "Apply now" (Hae nyt). Use your current email address to register to the Recruitment System. The closing date for applications is 16 November 2026.The following documents in English are required and must be included in the application:1) A curriculum vitae2) List of publications3) An accompanying 2–5-page document covering both qualifications for the Research Fellow level, and description of the planned research.If you are invited to an interview, you will be asked contact details of 2 referees.FURTHER INFORMATIONFurther information about the positions and the research project may be obtained from Professor Arto Klami at the Faculty of Science (arto.klami(at)helsinki.fi), and from Professor Andrea Ganna at FIMM (andrea.ganna(at)helsinki.fi).

title: Granlund: Senior Full Stack Developer (C#, React)
description: **Type**: Full-time, permanent**Location**: Malminkaari 21, 00700 Helsinki**Application deadline**: 26.10.2026Experienced with C#/.NET and React? Join Granlund to take ownership of a growing software platform and shape its future development!**What will you be doing?**Granlund is looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to further develop its Design Data Management (DDM) platform. DDM transforms building information models into structured, usable data for cost, lifecycle, and 4D calculations. The platform is already in production, with new features and use cases actively being explored. Your work will help turn these opportunities into practical solutions for the construction and real estate industry.In this role, you will develop the DDM platform, focusing mainly on C#/.NET backend development and SQL Server, while also working with React and TypeScript on the frontend. You will develop new features end-to-end, improve existing functionality, and propose practical technical and architectural solutions. Your responsibilities will also include maintaining code quality through automated testing and controlled releases.You will collaborate with colleagues across different business areas to develop solutions that address real business needs. Beyond implementing new features, you will evaluate technical feasibility and help prioritize development efforts. Initially, your focus will include turning existing proofs of concept into usable features.**What makes you a great fit?**We are looking for an experienced developer who has a strong background in software development and actively uses AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. You understand software architecture, can critically evaluate AI-generated code, and enjoy building software.You take ownership of your work and approach development with a practical, business-oriented mindset. You can assess business needs, identify what is worth developing, and suggest technical solutions that make sense. You also know when something is not worth implementing and can explain why.You are comfortable working independently in a small team and collaborating with others to make technical decisions. You don't need previous experience in construction or real estate; we welcome applications from developers across all industries.**We hope you have:**- Several years of backend development experience, ideally with C#/.NET, and strong SQL skills - Experience with React and TypeScript, and the ability to develop frontend features independently - A good understanding of software architecture, clean code, and automated testing - Hands-on experience building software with AI coding agents, and the judgement to review their output - Good communication skills in English or Finnish **We consider as an asset:**- Experience with Python and data processing tools, such as FastAPI, pandas, pyarrow, or IfcOpenShell - Experience working with large language models or developing AI-powered features - Familiarity with Azure services and CI/CD pipelines - Experience combining data from different sources into structured, usable information - Experience in product development, startups, or other environments requiring broad technical ownership. **What does Granlund offer you?**- An opportunity to take ownership of a growing software platform and directly influence its technical development. - Meaningful work turning complex building data into solutions that support smarter and more sustainable construction. - The freedom to shape technical solutions and see your ideas progress from early concepts into working features. - A small, collaborative team within an established company, with potential to grow into product or team leadership. - Flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements that allow you to combine independent development with in-person collaboration. - Comprehensive employee benefits, including occupational healthcare, sports and cultural benefits, and professional development opportunities. **Practicalities**This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements. Still, we hope you are based in the Helsinki metropolitan area or nearby to make it easier to meet in person for collaboration and workshops at Granlund's office in Malmi when needed. We hope you can start as soon as possible, but the exact start date is negotiable.Salary in this position is approximately 6000-8000 €/month. The final salary will be determined based on your experience and expertise. Granlund also offers a company-wide performance bonus scheme.**Recruitment process**- Remote interviews with aTalent - Two rounds of interviews with Granlund, conducted remotely and/or in person **Interested? We'd love to hear from you!**Submit your application and CV in PDF-format latest by the 26th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/390936/create/.We review applications throughout the application period in the order they are received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process. We will accommodate individual accessibility needs whenever possible. You can learn more about Granlund at www.granlund.fi. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Sofia is unable to answer your call, please leave a text message and she will get back to you.

title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik, Västerskog daghem
description: Ligger småbarnspedagogik dig varmt om hjärtat?Vill du vara med och utveckla pedagogiken i en varmhjärtad och omtänksam kommun?Om svaret är ja, är detta ditt drömjobb!Vi söker nu till vårt team en LÄRARE INOM SMÅBARNSPEDAGOGIK för en visstids anställning för tiden 7.1.2026- 31.7.2027. Arbetsplatsen är Västerskogs daghem och arbetet inleds enligt överenskommelse från och med 7.1.2026. Vill du arbeta i en varm, kreativ och flerspråkig miljö där leken står i centrum? Västerskog daghem söker nu en engagerad lärare inom småbarnspedagogik som vill bli en del av vårt professionella och dedikerade team. Vårt daghem ligger nära naturen, och våra lokaler är trivsamma och funktionella. Gården inbjuder till mångsidig lek och aktivitet. Våra värderingar är- närvaro- arbetsglädje- barncentrerad pedagogik- en varm famnHär får både barn och vuxna vara sig själva — och växa tillsammans.Vi söker dig som:- är entusiastisk, flexibel och positiv- är genuint närvarande i barnens vardag- möter barnen med värme och sensitivitet, både som individer och som gruppmedlemmar- har goda samarbetsfärdigheter och en lösningsfokuserad arbetsstil- vill utveckla småbarnspedagogiken med hjälp av lekpedagogikVi lägger stor vikt vid att du trivs i ett team och tycker om att arbeta i en miljö där humor, gemenskap och öppen kommunikation är en naturlig del av vardagen.Leken är en central del av vår pedagogik. Som lärare inom småbarnspedagogik deltar du aktivt i leken och finns nära barnen i deras utforskande och lärande. Du ansvarar för den pedagogiska verksamheten i din grupp enligt planen för småbarnspedagogik- enhetens verksamhetsplan- barnets individuella plan (vasu)Du planerar, genomför, dokumenterar och utvärderar verksamheten tillsammans med ditt team och barnen. Du får en god introduktion och kontinuerligt stöd av kollegor, daghemsföreståndaren och vår speciallärare inom småbarnspedagogik.Vi erbjuder ett engagerat och stöttande arbetslag och en varm och inkluderande arbetsmiljö samt dagligt samarbete och kollegialt lärande. Med oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas och påverka pedagogiken genom lek.  Varför skulle du välja just Sibbo?I småbarnspedagogiken i Sibbo är utvecklingsarbetet smidigt, långsiktigt och övergripande. I det betonas en verksamhetskultur som uppmuntrar till lek och rörelse. Närheten till naturen och tvåspråkigheten är våra styrkor. Vi satsar på kunnandet samt på ett arbetssätt som beaktar barnets bästa.Vi erbjuder dig:- en varmhjärtad, kunnig arbetsgemenskap och en omtänksam chef - starkt stöd av din chef, ditt team och speciallärarna- en arbetsgivare som bryr sig om just din välfärd- många möjligheter att utbilda dig och utveckla din yrkeskunskap- mångsidiga digitala verktyg, utlåning av idrottsredskap - idrotts-, kultur- och välfärdsförmån (epassi) Välkommen till vårt varmhjärtade och innovativa team som förverkligar småbarnspedagogiken i Sibbo med stort hjärta! Behörighetskravet för uppgiften är minst behörighet i enlighet med i lagen om småbarnspedagogik (540/2018), dock så att ikraftträdandet av 74 § och 75 § samt övergångsbestämmelserna tas i beaktande. Läraren inom småbarnspedagogik som väljs ska ha utmärkta muntliga och skriftliga färdigheter i svenska. Lönen och villkoren för anställningsförhållandet bestäms enligt UKTA Undervisningspersonalen inom småbarnspedagogiken (Del G).I arbetsförhållandet tillämpas en prövotid. Den uppgiftsrelaterade nivålönen är 3111,76 euro/månad + eventuella tillägg. Den som väljs ska visa upp ett straffregisterutdrag enligt lagen om kontroll av brottslig bakgrund hos personer som arbetar med barn (504/2002) samt ett godtagbart intyg över sitt hälsotillstånd. Enligt lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar ska den som arbetar med barn under skolåldern utreda risken för tuberkulossmitta. Välkommen med din ansökan! Vi ser fram emot att få en ny kollega som tillsammans med oss vill skapa en trygg, lärorik och glädjefylld vardag för barnen. Ansökningarna ska lämnas in senast 3.11.2026 kl. 16. Studie- och arbetsintyg i original ska visas upp vid en eventuell intervju.

title: R&D Project Manager, Bluefors, Helsinki

title: AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA
description: **AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA**Ekodrive Oy etsii **itsenäistä ja vastuullista automekaanikkoa** pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keravalle.Työvoiman tarve on arviolta **loka–marraskuussa 2026**, mutta etsimme sopivaa henkilöä jo nyt. Jos olet tällä hetkellä töissä mutta harkitset työpaikan vaihtoa myöhemmin syksyllä, voit myös ottaa yhteyttä.Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy hoitamaan tavallisia korjaamotöitä itsenäisesti, tekee työnsä loppuun sovitussa ajassa ja **kantaa vastuun työnsä lopputuloksesta**.Työhön kuuluu mm.- määräaikaishuollot ja öljynvaihdot - jarrujen huolto ja korjaus - alustan ja ohjauksen korjaukset - katsastuskorjaukset - moottori- ja vaihteistoöljyjen vaihdot - jakohihnojen ja jakopään osien vaihdot - vikojen etsintä ja perusdiagnostiikka - rengastyöt - ilmastointihuollot - muut tavalliset henkilöautojen korjaamotyöt Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea, mutta **tavalliset korjaamotyöt pitää pystyä tekemään itsenäisesti**.Arvostamme mekaanikkoa, joka osaa ajatella käytännöllisesti: vika tutkitaan, korjataan järkevällä tavalla ja työ saatetaan loppuun ilman tarpeetonta asioiden monimutkaistamista.Odotamme sinulta- B-luokan ajokorttia - vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta - oma-aloitteista työotetta - kykyä tehdä päätöksiä oman työn yhteydessä - kiinnostusta autoihin ja korjaamiseen - halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa - kykyä työskennellä normaalisti osana pientä työporukkaa **Autosähkön, diagnostiikan ja hitsauksen osaaminen on selvä etu.**Aikaisempi työkokemus autokorjaamolta ja suomen kielen taito ovat plussaa. Työpaikalla voidaan kommunikoida **suomeksi tai venäjäksi**.Meillä arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä, keskinäistä kunnioitusta ja sitä, että jokainen hoitaa oman työnsä kunnolla.Meille asiakkaan auto on tärkeä riippumatta sen merkistä, iästä tai arvosta. **Jokainen auto on asiakkaalle tärkeä ja meille työtä.**Tarjoamme- vakituisen työn sopivalle henkilölle - työajan **37,5 h/vko** - ma–pe **klo 8.00–16.00** - 6 kuukauden koeajan - pienen ja kehittyvän työyhteisön - mahdollisuuden saada enemmän vastuuta ja kehittyä yrityksen kasvaessa - palkka: **kerro palkkatoiveesi** Myös **oppilaitoksen kautta tuleva työharjoittelu tai virallinen työkokeilu** voi olla mahdollinen, jos hakijalla on hyvä tekninen perusta, oikea asenne ja realistinen mahdollisuus jatkaa myöhemmin työntekijänä.HAKEMINEN – VAIN SÄHKÖPOSTITSEPuhelinhakemuksia emme käsittele.Pitkää hakemusta ei tarvita. Lähetä lyhyt sähköposti **suomeksi tai venäjäksi** ja vastaa seuraaviin kysymyksiin:1. Kuinka paljon sinulla on kokemusta automekaanikon työstä? 2. Mitkä korjaukset pystyt tekemään täysin itsenäisesti? 3. Oletko tehnyt jakohihnan/jakopään vaihtoja itsenäisesti? 4. Millainen kokemus sinulla on diagnostiikasta ja autosähköstä? 5. Onko sinulla kokemusta rengastöistä ja ilmastointihuolloista? 6. Onko sinulla voimassa oleva B-ajokortti? 7. Mikä on palkkatoiveesi? 8. Milloin voisit aloittaa? 9. Miksi etsit uutta työpaikkaa ja millaista työpaikkaa etsit pidemmällä aikavälillä? **Hakemukset ja yhteydenotot ainoastaan sähköpostitse ekodrivepro@gmail.com****Ekodrive Oy Kerava**

title: Senior T24 Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior T24 Architect to shape the evolution of a large and complex Core Banking environment. You will define and guide the architecture of the Temenos T24 landscape, making sure that business capabilities, technology platforms and long-term strategic goals stay aligned.

You will work with business stakeholders, engineers, architects and external partners across multiple markets, providing architectural leadership over several initiatives and delivery streams. Your goal is to protect the stability and resilience of business-critical banking services while enabling platform modernisation and simplification.

Key Responsibilities:
 Shape and evolve the architecture roadmap for Temenos T24 and surrounding Core Banking capabilities, defining target-state architecture, principles and standards in line with business and technology strategy
 Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across complex initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability and sustainability of the Core Banking landscape
 Translate business requirements into robust, implementable solutions, including integrations between Core Banking and payments, digital channels, lending, deposits, customer management and data platforms
 Identify interfaces, data flows and dependencies across applications, infrastructure and external services
 Evaluate architectural alternatives and make clear trade-offs between business value, delivery risk and technical complexity
 Drive modernisation and simplification of the Core Banking ecosystem, promoting API-first, event-driven and cloud-enabled patterns where appropriate
 Improve platform maintainability, testability and operability, and identify opportunities for reuse, automation and standardisation across markets and delivery teams
 Define functional and non-functional requirements for availability, security, performance, scalability, resilience and operability
 Guide architecture reviews to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations, and maintain the architectural runway for sustainable delivery
 Assess architectural risks, technical debt and lifecycle concerns, and guide proportionate remediation
 Act as a trusted advisor for strategic Core Banking initiatives and technology investment decisions, communicating complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Mentor architects and engineers, fostering collaboration and accountable decision-making within teams

Required Skills and Experience:
 Significant experience with Temenos T24 / Temenos Transact in architecture, solution design or senior engineering roles
 Deep understanding of Core Banking processes, platform capabilities and integration dependencies
 Proven record of leading architecture for large-scale transformation, migration or modernisation initiatives
 Experience working across multiple teams, products or markets in a complex enterprise environment
 Banking experience involving demanding availability, security, resilience and regulatory requirements

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

title: Sales Manager
description: We are looking for an experienced _Sales Manager_ to join us on our journey toward zero-emission shipping!**About WE Tech Solutions**WE Tech Solutions is a Finnish marine technology company leading the way in marine electrification. We develop and deliver advanced energy solutions that help the global shipping industry improve energy efficiency, reduce fuel consumption and lower emissions.Our technologies combine variable frequency drives, permanent magnet generators, DC power distribution and intelligent energy management into integrated solutions for modern vessels.Our offering covers Shaft Generator Solutions, Electrification Solutions and Retrofits & Conversions, serving customers across a wide range of vessel types worldwide. With solutions installed on more than 300 vessels, WE Tech combines proven marine technology with an ambitious drive to shape the next generation of efficient and increasingly electrified shipping.**Sales Manager**We are looking for a technically strong and commercially driven Sales Manager to grow WE Techs business globally.The role covers both our Shaft Generator Solutions and Electrification Solutions, ranging from our established variable-speed shaft generator business to hybrid and full-electric propulsion, energy storage integration, DC power distribution and shore power solutions.The Sales Manager will work directly with shipowners, shipyards, ship designers and technology partners to develop technically and commercially competitive solutions and convert customer needs into successful projects.**Responsibilities**The Sales Manager is responsible for designated Sales projects and is reporting to the Sales Director. The Sales Manager is expected to actively sell and develop business across both WE Techs Merchant Marine and Electrification Solutions, combining commercial responsibility with sufficient technical competence to develop solutions together with customers and WE Tech Engineering.- Actively sell and promote WE Techs complete solution portfolio across both Merchant Marine and Electrification business - Identify customer needs and develop technically and commercially competitive system solutions together with customers and WE Tech Engineering - Understand customer vessel electrical architecture, operational requirements and interfaces - Prepare and negotiate Technical Agreements with customers - Negotiate and sign Sales Agreements within given authorization - Represent WE Tech Solutions at trade shows, customer meetings and industry events - Prepare quotations, technical proposals and other sales documentation - Calculate and keep up to date Sales project-specific Sales Calculations - Identify requirements from customer technical specifications, both documented and verbally - title: Sähkö- ja automaatioasentaja, Algol Technics Oy
description: _Algol Technics on teollisuuden kumppani ja materiaalinkäsittelyn asiantuntija. Algol Technics on osa suomalaista Algol-konsernia, jolla on kokemusta kansainvälisestä kaupasta vuodesta 1894 alkaen. Uskomme, että asiakkaidemme maailma automatisoituu, nopeutuu ja muuttuu aiempaa kompleksisemmaksi. Olemme vahvasti mukana tässä muutoksessa tarjoten asiakkaillemme sisälogistiikan ratkaisuja, mm. nostureita, robottisoluja, kuljettimia ja automaatiovarastoja sekä laajan valikoiman teknisiä tuotteita. Kaikkiin toimittamiimme ratkaisuihin tarjoamme kattavat kunnossapito- ja huoltopalvelut.__Algol-konsernin yhteistyökumppaniverkosto on maailmanlaajuinen ja yhtiöllä on toimipisteitä kymmenessä eri maassa._Miltä kuulostaisi vaihtelevat työtehtävät huollon ja kunnossapidon saralla? Lue eteenpäin, mitä Algol Technicsillä on tarjolla ja työllisty heidän kirjoilleen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!**Mitä tulisit tässä tehtävässä tekemään?**Kunnossapidon ja huollon tavoitteena on pitää laitteistot toiminnassa keskeytyksittä. Algol Technicsin huoltoverkosto huolehtii siitä, että huoltotyöt sekä käynnissäpito hoidetaan ammattimaisesti ympäri Suomen.Algolilla toimit huolto- ja kunnossapitotehtävissä eri asiakaskohteissa Varsinais-Suomen alueella. Päiviisi kuuluvat vaihtelevat tehtävät, jotka sisältävät monipuolisia sähköasennus- ja huoltotöitä pääsääntöisesti teollisuusnostureiden parissa. Huolehdit asiakasyrityksissä, että hommat etenevät ja linjastot liikkuvat. Pääset toimimaan itsenäisesti ja työssä liikkumiseen saat Algolilta käyttöösi auton. Toimit osana osaavaa tiimiä, jolta saat myös kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään. Työaikasi on arkisin 7:00–15.30.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**Sinulla on taustaa teollisuussähköstä, mutta tartut mielelläsi myös mekaanisiin töihin. Sähköalan osaamisen olet voinut hankkia koulutuksen tai käytännön työkokemuksen kautta. Työssä tehdään paljolti myös mekaanista asennusta, joten esimerkiksi autojen, koneiden tai muun tekniikan parissa harrastaminen antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan.Arvostamme omatoimista ja palveluhenkistä työotetta. Turvallisuussyistä tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työn mielenkiintoisissa tehtävissä ja osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja työllistyt suoraan Algol Technicsin palvelukseen.Pääset osaksi osaavaa ja sitoutunutta työyhteisöä, jossa tekeminen perustuu yhteistyöhön ja keskinäiseen luottamukseen. Työntekijöiden viihtyvyys näkyy arjessa ja vaihtuvuus on poikkeuksellisen pientä.Algol Technics tarjoaa vakaan työympäristön osana pitkän historian omaavaa perheyritystä, jossa asiat tehdään suunnitelmallisesti ja luotettavasti. Taustalla on yli 130 vuoden historia saman perheen omistuksessa, mikä näkyy pitkäjänteisyytenä ja varmuutena arjessa.Saat käyttöösi nykyaikaiset työkalut ja järjestelmät sekä kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten työterveyshuollon ja Epassin.**Kiinnostuitko?**Tahdomme kuulla sinusta! We value a diverse workplace where different language and cultural backgrounds are considered a strength - a valid work permit if you are not a Finnish citizen **We offer you:**- a permanent, part-time employment contract of 30 hours per week - shifts on weekdays and weekends, including morning, daytime and evening shifts - a starting date to be agreed together - comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding path and N-Clean Academy - fair employment terms, a safe working environment and support for employee wellbeing - competitive pay in accordance with the collective agreement for employees in the property services sector, €2,235/month **Equality and responsibility**Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect, and we do not accept discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to providing a safe and healthy working environment.**Did you know?**Employees enjoy working at N-Clean, and our employee eNPS is at an excellent level of **55**! title: P2P IT Project Support Specialist
description:
For our client were looking for a P2P IT Project Support Specialist.

The P2P IT Project Support Specialist provides additional capacity to the existing P2P IT team during a period of high project activity and multiple concurrent go-lives.

The role supports project delivery by coordinating and executing testing activities, investigating and resolving application and integration issues, managing project risks, and collaborating with stakeholders across multiple IT workstreams, suppliers and business users. The position complements the existing team, which provides the business knowledge, application expertise, and historical project context.

This role requires an experienced professional who can quickly become productive, work independently, coordinate stakeholders, and proactively drive assigned activities to completion.

· Support multiple P2P-related projects, enhancements, and go-live activities.
· Plan, coordinate, and execute testing activities, including integration testing, end-to-end testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing support.
· Investigate application issues, process failures, data discrepancies, and integration errors, and drive resolution with relevant teams.
· Analyze error logs, identify root causes, and coordinate corrective actions.

· Experience working with enterprise applications and IT projects.
· Understanding of Finance and Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) processes.

· Experience of Basware, Infor LN and M3 would be an advantage.
· Strong understanding of integrations, interfaces, and data flows.
· Experience with testing, defect management, and issue resolution.
· Ability to analyze application errors, integration failures, and data issues.
· Understanding of project risk management.Personal capabilities:
· Self-driven and able to work independently with limited supervision.
· Strong can-do attitude and ownership mindset.
· Curious, analytical, and eager to investigate and solve problems.
· Comfortable working in a fast-paced project environment with multiple parallel activities.
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
· Ability to coordinate activities across different IT teams and stakeholders.
· Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Preferred qualifications:
· Experience with e-invoicing mandates and compliance requirements.
· Experience with invoice automation or P2P applications.
· Understanding of RPA and automation technologies.
· Experience working in multinational environments.
· Exposure to IT Service Management processes.

This role is intended for an experienced professional who can independently manage support activities, contribute to projects, and act as a trusted partner to IT stakeholders. The role is particularly suited for a resource who can rapidly contribute during intensive project and go-live phases without requiring significant day-to-day guidance.
