title: Kita-Begleitung (m/w/d) – mit oder ohne pädagogische Erfahrung (Kinderbetreuer/in)
description: BITTE BEWIRB DICH DIREKT ÜBER UNSERE KARRIERESEITE, NICHT PER E-MAIL:https://karriere.begleithelden.de/o/kita-begleitung-mwd-mit-oder-ohne-padagogische-erfahrung-1Nur so können wir deine Bewerbung vollständig erfassen und dir schnell antworten.Die Begleithelden GmbH ist ein junger und herzlicher Kita- und Schulbegleitdienst – gegründet von Menschen, die aus Überzeugung in der Eingliederungshilfe arbeiten. Wir begleiten Kinder und Jugendliche mit besonderem Unterstützungsbedarf in der Rhein-Neckar-Region, in der Pfalz sowie in den Landkreisen Bergstraße, Darmstadt-Dieburg, Alzey-Worms und Aschaffenburg. Dabei wird jedes Kind bedürfnisorientiert und einfühlsam unterstützt und in seiner Entwicklung gefördert.Für unser wachsendes Team suchen wir Menschen, denen Inklusion genauso am Herzen liegt wie uns – und die Freude daran haben, sich mit echtem Interesse auf jedes Kind einzulassen und es auf seinem eigenen Weg zu begleiten.Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir für ein Kind eine engagierte Kita-Begleitung (m/w/d) in 63853 Mömlingen in der Kita Sonnenschein.Der voraussichtliche Stundenumfang beträgt 25 Stunden pro Woche.Darauf darfst du dich freuen- Bezahlung angelehnt an TVöD SuE mit Sonderzahlungen- Stundenlohn 17,14 bis zu 26,55 € inklusive Sonderzahlungen, angelehnt an TVöD SuE Stufe 1 bis 4; begleitest du mehrere Kinder, bekommst du für jedes weitere Kind einen Zuschlag auf den Stundenlohn, den wir für deinen Einsatz konkret berechnen- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge durch Entgeltumwandlung, mit unabhängiger Beratung- Betriebsärztliche Vorsorge (Angebots- und Wunschvorsorge) und kostenlose Schutzimpfungen- Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten von Montag bis Freitag- Während der Kita-Schließzeiten hast du frei (bitte Bundesland beachten)- Fundierte Einarbeitung über unsere Begleithelden-Akademie sowie regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungen- Feste Ansprechperson im Unternehmen, die dich bei fachlichen Fragen unterstützt- Regelmäßiger Austausch mit deiner Koordination- Erste-Hilfe-Trainings- Vollständig digitale Dokumentationsprozesse- Ein kollegiales Miteinander auf Augenhöhe mit offener und ehrlicher Kommunikation- Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit, bei der du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst – deine Leistung wird gesehen und wertgeschätzt- Bei uns bist du ein wichtiger Teil eines engagierten Teams. Wir haben immer ein offenes Ohr für dich!Welche Qualifikation passt zu dir?Die Vergütung ist angelehnt an den TVöD SuE und richtet sich nach deiner Qualifikationsstufe:- QuereinsteigerIn (Nicht-Fachkraft/ angelernte Kraft): Du brauchst keine pädagogische Ausbildung. Was zählt, sind persönliche Eignung, Einfühlungsvermögen und verlässliche Kommunikation, z. B. als QuereinsteigerIn, StudentIn, ErzieherIn in Ausbildung oder mit viel Lebenserfahrung. Das nötige Rüstzeug bekommst du über unsere Begleithelden-Akademie.- QuereinsteigerIn mit Erfahrung (Nicht-Fachkraft/ angelernte Kraft): Du bringst zusätzlich Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern mit, etwa aus einer Weiterbildung zur Teilhabeassistenz (Schulbegleitung, Integrationsfachkraft, InklusionsbegleiterIn) oder aus mindestens einem Jahr Tätigkeit als Begleitkraft.- SozialassistentIn oder Fachkraft mit 1-jähriger Ausbildung: auch eine gleichwertige, einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern und Jugendlichen zählt.- Pädagogisches Gespür und Interesse, auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse von beeinträchtigten Kindern einzugehen- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern wünschenswert (keine Voraussetzung)- Eine 1-jährige pädagogische Ausbildung (z. B. als SozialassistentIn) ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung- Vorlage von Ausbildungsnachweisen, Abschluss- und Arbeitszeugnissen- Vorlage eines erweiterten polizeilichen Führungszeugnisses ohne Eintragungen- Masern-Immunitätsnachweis (2 Impfungen gegen Masern oder Titer-Bestimmung) für alle Personen, die nach 1970 geboren sind- Volljährigkeit- Deutsch-Kenntnisse: mindestens B2/ C1-Niveau mit Nachweis- Soft Skills: Einfühlungsvermögen, Teamfähigkeit, offene und ehrliche Kommunikation, selbständiges und zuverlässiges Arbeiten- Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen sowie zu regelmäßiger Weiterbildung und Qualitätsverbesserung- Bereitschaft zur Selbstreflexion und persönlichen WeiterentwicklungKlingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns sehr darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Nutze bitte den „Bewerben-Button“, um deine Unterlagen digital bei uns einzureichen. Solltest du vorab Fragen haben, wende dich gerne telefonisch an:Jan-Florian Wagner: 0173 5357176Du bist schon Schul- oder Kitabegleitung bei einem anderen Träger? Dann sprich uns an: begleithelden.de/traeger-wechselnSo bewirbst du dich:https://karriere.begleithelden.de/o/kita-begleitung-mwd-mit-oder-ohne-padagogische-erfahrung-1

title: Client Service Administrator (m/w/d) (Informatiker/in)
employer: Hays Professional Solutions GmbH Standort Nürnberg
description: Ihre Vorteile:- Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem renommierten Unternehmen- Flexible Arbeitszeiten- Flache Hierarchien- Hohes Maß an EigenverantwortungIhre Aufgaben:- Verantwortung für den stabilen Betrieb der Windows-Client-Landschaft sowie der zugehörigen Workplace-Services- Steuerung und Koordination externer IT-Dienstleister im Bereich Client Management- Abstimmung von Software- und Security-Updates, Patchstrategien sowie Lifecycle-Maßnahmen mit den verantwortlichen Providern- Analyse, Bearbeitung und Eskalation komplexer Incidents und Problems im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Umfeld- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Service Levels (SLAs) sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung der Servicequalität- Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen IT-Teams, insbesondere der zentralen Organisation in Frankreich- Unterstützung bei der Planung und Umsetzung neuer Workplace- und Client-Services- Bewertung technischer Anforderungen hinsichtlich Sicherheit, Stabilität und Benutzerfreundlichkeit- Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen, Prozesse und StandardsIhre Qualifikationen:- Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare IT-Ausbildung- Erfahrung in der Administration oder Steuerung von Enterprise-Client-Umgebungen- Gute Kenntnisse im Microsoft-Umfeld (Windows 11, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Entra ID, Intune oder SCCM/MECM)- Erfahrung im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Support- Kenntnisse im IT Service Management nach ITIL- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen IT-Dienstleistern und Service Providern- Gute analytische Fähigkeiten und strukturierte Arbeitsweise- Sehr gute Deutsch- und EnglischkenntnisseÜber Hays:Der Bereich IT ist unsere Kernkompetenz, auf deren Grundlage sich Hays entwickelt hat. Wir sind das größte privatwirtschaftlich organisierte IT-Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen in Deutschland und haben für jede Karrierestufe das passende Angebot – egal ob Sie an Vakanzen in agilen KMUs oder starken DAX-Konzernen interessiert sind. Wir beherrschen die komplette IT-Klaviatur von Support bis zur Softwarearchitektur oder Digitalisierung – dank unseres umfangreichen Portfolios ist für jeden etwas dabei. Probieren Sie es aus und erfahren Sie, was der Markt Ihnen zu bieten hat – völlig kostenfrei, diskret und unverbindlich! Wir freuen uns auf Sie.

title: Sozial-, Heilpädagoge oder Pädagoge (m/w/d) als pädagogische Leitung mit Fachdienstaufgaben (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
description: Wir suchen daher ab sofort oder späterSozial-, Heilpädagoge oder Pädagoge (m/w/d)als pädagogische Leitung mit Fachdienstaufgaben(Kennziffer: PL-WÜ)für zwei Wohngruppen in Würzburg (28 Wochenstunden)Der Verein Evang. Kinder-, Jugend- und Familienhilfe e.V.  ist eine überregionale Jugendhilfeeinrichtung, in der verhaltensauffällige und psychisch kranke junge Menschen betreut werden. Wir integrieren Heilpädagogik und Therapie in das Alltagshandeln und erziehen in christlicher Verantwortung. In unseren Wohngruppen leben Kinder und Jugendliche aus konfliktbelasteten familiären Beziehungen, mit emotionalen Beeinträchtigungen und/oder Auffälligkeiten im Sozial- und Leistungsverhalten. Ziel der Arbeit ist es, Kinder und deren Eltern so zu unterstützen, dass ein Weiterbestehen des Familiensystems ermöglicht bzw. eine Lebensperspektive erarbeitet werden kann.Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:- Leitung und Organisation des pädagogischen Teams- Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen pädagogischen Arbeit- Entwicklung und Umsetzung von pädagogischen Konzepten und Maßnahmen- Betreuung und Förderung der Kinder (Einzelförderung und Gruppenangebote)- Zusammenarbeit mit den Eltern, Schulen, Ärzten und Therapeuten- Personalführung, -entwicklung und -planungAnforderungen:- abgeschlossenes pädagogisches Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen- mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Jugendhilfe von Vorteil- soziale und kommunikative Kompetenzen sowie Teamfähigkeit- Organisationsgeschick und Durchsetzungsvermögen- wertschätzende, ressourcenorientierte und heilpädagogische Grundhaltung- Führerschein Kl. B- Deutschkenntnisse auf dem Niveau B2Wir bieten:- ein faires und leistungsgerechtes Gehalt/Einstiegsgehalt nach AVR Bayern- vermögenswirksame Leistungen, arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge, eine Beihilfeversicherung, 85 % Weihnachtsgeld und Zulagen- bezahlte Inhouse-Schulungen und externe Fortbildungen- Supervision- vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit im wertschätzenden multiprofessionellen Team- MitarbeitereventsWir möchten darauf hinweisen, dass die Bewerbungsunterlagen nach Abschluss der Einstellungsverfahren nicht zurückgesandt werden.Schwerbehinderte Bewerber/innen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Bei Bedarf bieten wir schwerbehinderten Bewerber/innen unsere Hilfe an.Wenn Sie eine Leitungsperson sind, die Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern hat und gerne in einem dynamischen Umfeld tätig ist, dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!Für Rückfragen stehen wir Ihnen gerne zur Verfügung:Evangelische Kinder-, Jugend- und Familienhilfe e.V.Frau Nicole BeutlingLindleinstraße 7, 97080 WürzburgTel.: 0931/250 80-23, Mail: info.jugendhilfe@diakonie-wuerzburg.de (https://mailto:info.jugendhilfe@diakonie-wuerzburg.de)

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description: Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.What your job includes- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes What we expect from you- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures- Autonomy in decision-making - Strong communication and presentation skills - Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficialWhat we offer youWe are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.Other benefits depending on the location

description: Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.What your job includes- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes What we expect from you- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures- Autonomy in decision-making - Strong communication and presentation skills - Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficialWhat we offer youWe are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. title: Field Service Specialist
description: Location: Europe – preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania.DTE is a fast-growing deep-tech company transforming how the metals industry controls and optimises its production. Our real-time melt chemistry technology gives aluminium producers immediate insight into their process, unlocking operational efficiency, higher yields and more sustainable production.As DTE expands its international operations, we are looking for a Field Service Specialist based in Europe to support future customer deployments and help establish our field service capabilities in the region.This is an opportunity to join a growing international team, work hands-on with innovative industrial technology and play an important role in building DTE's presence in the European market.Position SummaryThe Field Service Specialist will be part of DTE's Service, Production and Delivery team, supporting the installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of DTE's industrial analytical equipment as new customer deployments are established.You will work closely with customers during installation, start-up and service visits, configuring equipment to meet operational requirements, training operators and providing remote and on-site technical support.The role also involves close collaboration with DTE's Engineering and Service teams in Iceland and internationally, contributing practical field experience to product improvements and the development of service procedures.We are looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, understands demanding industrial environments and takes ownership of solving technical challenges.This is a hands-on technical role in demanding industrial environments involving heat, noise, dust and heavy machinery, requiring a strong commitment to safety, quality and reliable operation.Key ResponsibilitiesInstall, commission and service DTE's analytical equipment at customer sites as new deployments are established.Ensure installations and service work meet DTE's standards for quality, safety and reliability.Configure equipment, perform functional testing and train customer operators.Troubleshoot, maintain and repair equipment, providing both remote and on-site technical support.Assess customer site readiness ahead of installation, including power, utilities, access, lifting arrangements and safety requirements.Participate in an on-call rota for technical support as required.Collaborate with DTE's Engineering and Service teams to identify technical issues, implement improvements and support product development.Contribute to the development of service procedures, checklists, spare parts lists and troubleshooting documentation.Help establish and develop DTE's field service capabilities in Europe as the company expands into the region.Qualifications, Knowledge & ExperienceAt least 3 years of experience in field service, equipment assembly or technical support involving electronic or industrial equipment.A degree or vocational qualification in engineering, electronics, electrical technology or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.Experience troubleshooting automated control systems and industrial equipment.Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills.Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage technical challenges in the field.Comfortable working in demanding industrial environments, including foundries and aluminium production facilities.Strong commitment to safety, quality and customer service.Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.Knowledge of Polish, Czech, Romanian, German, Spanish, or other European languages is an advantage.Valid driving licence and passport.Legal authorisation to work or provide services in the country of residence.Experience in the metals industry, foundries or industrial automation, as well as electrical qualifications or certifications, would be an advantage.Location & TravelEmployment Type: We are open to both direct employment and independent contractor arrangements, depending on the candidate's location, experience and the most suitable contractual setup.Location: Preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania. This is a home-based field service position field service position, requiring regular international travel to support customer deployments, installations, training and technical service activities. The role is expected to involve approximately 50% travel, depending on project schedules and customer requirements. Travel will support DTE's international operations and future customer deployments in Europe, with visits to DTE headquarters in Iceland for training, product familiarisation and collaboration with Engineering and other teams.The successful candidate should live within convenient driving distance of a major international airport.For applications & inquiries send to: agusta@dte.aiLast application date is October 31st, 2026.Why DTE?We are past proving that the technology works. DTE's systems are already operating in production environments, and we are now scaling from individual installations to plant-wide deployments.We are solving a fundamental blind spot in one of the world's largest industries: metals producers cannot optimise what they cannot measure in real time.Our technology provides the foundation for real-time process control, higher recycling rates, lower emissions and the future of autonomous metals manufacturing.As we expand into Europe, you will have the opportunity to help build our regional service capabilities from the ground up, while working closely with an experienced international team.Our core values are purpose, excellence and empowerment. We look for people who are driven, resilient and motivated by building technology with real industrial impact.We encourage people of all genders to apply. DTE is committed to being an inclusive workplace where employees feel empowered, supported and able to do their best work. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Assistant driller
description: Seeking an assistant drillerIceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.Key Responsibilities:• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.• Assisting with cementing.• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.Qualifications & Requirements:• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.Employer can assist with housing.Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description: **Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi - nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia - saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun - vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;- toiminta uusiin maihin - markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille - elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiäYhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Ræsting/Cleaning
description: *Job Title:** Housekeeping & Breakfast Attendant**Location:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógar, Iceland**Position:** Full-Time**Start Date:** November 15, 2026Hótel Skógafoss and Hótel Anna, located in the beautiful surroundings of South Iceland, are seeking a dedicated and versatile individual to join our team in a full-time capacity. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and reliable professional responsible for maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and ensuring our guests have a wonderful start to their day.**Key Responsibilities:*** Performing comprehensive cleaning of guest rooms and public areas to ensure a comfortable and welcoming environment.* Managing all aspects of the daily breakfast service, including setting up and replenishing the buffet, and ensuring the dining area is clean and well-presented.* Handling the hotel's laundry services, including washing, drying, and folding linens.* Providing excellent customer service, assisting guests with inquiries, and processing payments for breakfast when required.**The Ideal Candidate:*** Has proven experience in housekeeping and/or food and beverage service.* Is fluent in English and possesses excellent communication skills. Proficiency in other languages is a strong asset.* Holds a valid B-category driver's license.* Is a dependable team player with a positive attitude and a strong work ethic.* Is flexible and willing to work a varied schedule.**What We Offer:*** A stable, full-time position in a friendly and dynamic work environment.* Competitive wages according to the collective bargaining agreement with the VLFS union.* **On-site accommodation is available for a fee.*** The opportunity to live and work in one of Iceland's most scenic areas.**How to Apply:**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.Interested parties are requested to send an application along with a CV to the email address: applications@ejhotels.isLast application date is November 15th , 2026.*****Starfsheiti:** Umsjónaraðili herbergja og morgunverðar**Staðsetning:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógum**Starfshlutfall:** Fullt starf**Starf hefst:** 15. nóvember 2026Hótel Skógafoss og Hótel Anna, staðsett í hinu fallega umhverfi Suðurlands, óska eftir að ráða þjónustulundaðan og fjölhæfan einstakling í fullt starf. Leitum að ábyrgum og traustum aðila sem hefur metnað til að viðhalda ýtrustu kröfum um hreinlæti og tryggja að gestir okkar fái frábæra byrjun á deginum.**Helstu verkefni og ábyrgðarsvið:*** Umfangsmikil þrif á herbergjum og sameiginlegum rýmum hótelsins til að tryggja snyrtilegt og notalegt umhverfi.* Fullnaðarumsjón með morgunverðarþjónustu, þ.m.t. undirbúningur og áfylling á hlaðborð.* Umsjón með þvotti hótelsins, s.s. þvottur, þurrkun og frágangur á líni.* Veita framúrskarandi þjónustu, aðstoða gesti og taka við greiðslum fyrir morgunverð þegar við á.**Hæfniskröfur:*** Sönnuð reynsla af þrifum og/eða störfum í veitingaþjónustu er skilyrði.* Mjög góð enskukunnátta og framúrskarandi samskiptahæfni. Kunnátta í öðrum tungumálum er mikill kostur.* Gilt ökuskírteini (B-flokkur) er skilyrði.* Áreiðanleiki, jákvæðni og hæfni til að vinna vel í hóp.* Sveigjanleiki og vilji til að vinna á breytilegum vöktum.**Það sem við bjóðum:*** Öruggt fullt starf á vinalegum og lifandi vinnustað.* Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi við VLFS.* **Húsnæði er í boði á staðnum gegn gjaldi.*** Einstakt tækifæri til að búa og starfa á einum fallegasta stað landsins.**Umsóknir:**Farið er yfir umsóknir jafnóðum.Áhugasamir vinsamlegast sendið umsókn ásamt ferilskrá á netfangið: applications@ejhotels.isUmsóknarfrestur er til og með 31.okt 2026.

title: Sjúkraþjálfari - Physiotherapist
description: Physiotherapist – Akureyri HospitalWe are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description: **Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi - nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia - saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun - vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;- toiminta uusiin maihin - markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille - elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiäYhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

description:

·  Need to be familiar with programme and budgets for the project, fully understanding the impact any overruns shall have on the project

title: Experienced Grounds Maintenance Operative
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit.  Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.   About the job
We are looking for a hardworking, reliable and practical person to join us in carrying out garden maintenance and lawn care throughout Mid-Kerry and Killarney.
This is a hands-on, outdoor role for someone who enjoys physical work, takes pride in doing a good job and is comfortable working in changeable Irish weather.
Some previous gardening or grounds maintenance experience is essential, but we are happy to train the right person who has a positive attitude, is willing to learn and takes their responsibilities seriously.
You will work at different properties throughout the area, helping to maintain gardens and outdoor spaces to a high standard.

Main duties;
Lawn mowing, strimming and general lawn care.
Hedge trimming, pruning and weeding.
General garden maintenance and seasonal work.
Safe use and care of gardening machinery.
Keeping gardens and work areas tidy.
Working efficiently and taking pride in the quality of your work.
The person we're looking for

The ideal candidate will be:
Reliable, punctual and hardworking.
Experienced in basic gardening, lawn care or similar outdoor work.
Physically fit and comfortable with practical, outdoor work.
Happy to work in rain, cold and changeable weather when conditions are safe.
Willing to learn new skills and operate machinery safely.
Attentive to detail and committed to doing a good job.
Able to work well with others and follow instructions.
A full driving licence is an advantage.

Working hours and weather;
This is a full-time position, with a typical working week of approximately 39 hours, depending on workload and weather conditions.
Hours may vary from week to week, and working hours may reduce during the winter months when weather conditions are unpredictable.
We work outdoors throughout the year where conditions allow. However, we do not work during storms or flooding, and work may be postponed when conditions are unsafe.
Flexibility and an understanding of the seasonal nature of gardening work are important.

Travel and equipment;
Work takes place at different locations throughout Mid-Kerry and Killarney. We meet at an agreed base and travel to the day's jobs together.
All main gardening machinery and equipment are supplied by the business. You do not need to purchase or bring your own lawnmower, strimmer, hedge trimmer or other main machinery.
We will explain any requirements for suitable work clothing and footwear before you start.

What we offer;
Full-time outdoor work.
Main gardening machinery and equipment provided.
The opportunity to develop your gardening and grounds maintenance skills.
Hands-on training for the right candidate.
A varied role working at different properties throughout the area.
Pay will be discussed based on experience and suitability for the role.

How to apply
Please send us your CV and a short description of your gardening, grounds maintenance or other practical outdoor work experience.
We are looking for someone dependable who takes pride in their work.

Hayes Mechanical Engineering Ltd., based in Drumminoe West, Ballintubber, Claremorris, Co. Mayo, is seeking experienced Pipe Fitters to join its team.

- Ability to operate soldering, welding and rigging equipment and apply metal-bending techniques.

description:

RBK is seeking a high-performing Transfer Pricing Senior to join our International Tax – Transfer Pricing (TP) Team. Working directly with our Transfer Pricing Director, you will support a varied portfolio of multinationals, mid-market companies and fast-growing international businesses across transfer pricing, tax compliance and advisory.

The role can be tailored to your experience and career goals, whether you wish to broaden your consultancy experience across tax, focus on compliance or develop a specialist area.

Responsibilities

Manage end-to-end TP projects, including scoping, benchmarking, documentation (local and master files) and financial/economic analysis.

Draft and review TP reports, technical memoranda, intercompany agreements, intangible pricing, intra-group services and cost allocations.

Handle client queries and conduct functional, industry and economic analyses to support pricing models.

Support TP audits and disputes, defend documentation before tax authorities and contribute to dispute prevention and resolution.

Apply and monitor OECD/G20 BEPS guidance, EU and local TP regulations.

Build client relationships, understand business models, value chains and risks, and align TP policies with commercial strategies.

Collaborate across tax, finance, legal and operations on structuring, cross-border transactions, supply chains, IP and intra-group financing.

Review junior colleagues' work, provide coaching and feedback, and contribute to training and knowledge sharing.

Manage project budgets, billing and WIP, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery.

Support business development through proposals, client pitches and practice growth.

Requirements

2–4 years' relevant TP experience in a professional services consulting firm.

Strong knowledge of OECD guidelines, the BEPS framework and local TP regulations.

Experience in TP documentation, benchmarking, financial modelling and technical report writing. Exposure to audits, dispute resolution or advisory projects (e.g. supply chain, IP or restructuring) is advantageous.

Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and economic data.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders.

Experience with TP databases (e.g. Capital IQ, RoyaltyStat or TP Catalyst) preferred.

Proficiency in MS Office, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines and maintain high-quality work.

Teamwork, leadership potential and willingness to coach junior colleagues.

Proactive, detail-oriented and committed to keeping up with international tax and TP developments.

Commercial awareness and understanding of how TP interacts with business strategy, risk and cost structures.

This is a full-time position based in Dublin, with a 37.5-hour working week.

Are you a purpose driven individual who is passionate about making a difference and helping some of society’s most vulnerable children? At Barnardos, we pride ourselves on delivering impactful services that make a difference to the lives of children and families across Ireland. 

We believe that childhood lasts a lifetime. As trauma informed specialists our core purpose is to provide the necessary support for children to overcome childhood adversity, embedding a trauma informed ethos and practice into every service we provide. 

What we can offer you?

As a Programme Assistant we appreciate the value of your time when providing essential support to our services, that’s why we have the necessary support structures and network in place that will allow you to make a real impact on the lives of children across Ireland. We also offer the following:

Barnardos offers a competitive salary – recognising the experience you bring to the role
Generous annual leave entitlements plus discretionary Company days
Employee pension scheme with employer contribution/ Company Sick Pay Scheme
Access to regular trauma informed support, supervision, training and many other professional development opportunities
Tax saver and bike to work schemes in operation
Access to the Employee Assistance/Wellbeing programme for employees and their immediate family members 

What’s the role and service?

In your role as a Programme Assistant, you will provide a safe, child centred environment/experience to children in the context of the service in which you work and appropriate to the role. 

What will my day to day look like?

Provide a safe and appropriate environment for children to participate in the service.
Ensure all children attending the service receive an appropriate level of supervision.
Support children attending to play and interact positively with other children.
Be vigilant for signs of physical, sexual and emotional abuse and neglect and any concerns regarding the welfare of children.
Immediately, bring any concerns to the attention of the child’s Key Worker and the Designated Person and in keeping with Barnardos Child Protection Policy.
Record concerns promptly and accurately.
Gather information statistics and prepare reports as required, including administration of databases as appropriate to the role
Supervise students and volunteers where necessary and to ensure they are aware of all Barnardos policies and compile placement reports as appropriate.
Provide a flexible service on a day-to-day basis within the Early Years’ team.
Experience or understanding of working with vulnerable children and families.  

What experience do I need? 

Experience of working with children for a minimum of 6 months is essential
Relevant voluntary work/work experience may be considered

Do I need a qualification?

Recognised qualification (minimum Level 5 on the QQI/ FETAC) that is approved under the Early Years’ (Pre-school) Regulations.

title: consulente in energia solare
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite-enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-90K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. description: The future of automation needs your hands. And your brain. Do you have a natural passion for mechanics, electronics, and technology? Does the thrill of troubleshooting a fault, solving the issue, and watching an entire industrial plant scale back up to speed get you excited? For a solid, international manufacturing leader in the Food & Beverage / Pharma sectors, with a state-of-the-art facility in Florence (Italy), we are looking for a key player to join the technical team: ELECTROMECHANICAL / ELECTRICAL MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN Your typical day in the workshop and on the line: You will never get bored. You will be the go-to person to ensure plant efficiency and safety through: Pure Problem Solving: Fast diagnosis and corrective maintenance during breakdowns to get the line running safely again. Strategy: Preventive and predictive maintenance during scheduled shutdowns. Continuous Improvement: Small optimization tweaks on machinery and equipment to make a real difference. Teamwork & Networking: Supporting external technicians during installations and testing, and managing shift handovers. Knowledge Sharing: Providing basic training to line operators (set-ups, format changes, OPL procedures). Organization: Keeping the workshop and spare parts warehouse in perfect order. The ideal profile we are looking for: We want someone eager to learn with a solid technical foundation: Education: Technical diploma (Electrical, Electrotechnical, Mechanical, or Mechatronics). Experience: Already worked in industrial maintenance? Great. If you are a junior profile but have high motivation and a strong technical base, we still want to meet you and invest in your growth. Hard Skills: Ability to read electrical schematics, knowledge of components (sensors, motors, wiring), and a good grasp of mechanics and pneumatics. Soft Skills: Strong teamwork attitude, flexibility, and a result-oriented mindset. Pluses: Basic English and any specific technical certifications are highly valued. What's in it for you (The Offer): Top-tier Environment: Join a well-structured, clean corporate environment equipped with modern technologies. Real Growth: Structured initial onboarding and a continuous technical development path. Solid Contract: Italian 'CCNL Metalmeccanica Industria' (Indicative classification D2 - C2 based on your experience). Competitive Salary: Indicative Gross Annual Salary (RAL) €25,000 - €35,000 + allowances (shifts, on-call, overtime) + company benefits and annual bonuses. Hours and Location: Shift Pattern: Full-time, organized on shifts (06-14 / 14-22 / 08-17). Location: Florence, Italy. Ready to power up your career? description: Ti piace lavorare con precisione su impianti di automazione, interpretando schemi elettrici e intervenendo per garantirne il corretto funzionamento? Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante realtà industriale specializzata nella progettazione e realizzazione di impianti di automazione industriale, con clienti a livello internazionale, per potenziamento organico, è alla ricerca di un/una Service Automation Engineer Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza e passione per l'automazione industriale, autonomo nelle attività di collaudo e commissioning, con spiccate capacità di problem solving e una naturale predisposizione al lavoro in squadra. Requisiti - Diploma tecnico con almeno 2-3 anni di comprovata esperienza nel settore dell'automazione industriale Attività previste (dopo periodo formativo): - Collaudo interno di impianti di automazione industriale. - Testing e validazione di software PLC e Robot. - Commissioning e avviamento presso il cliente. - Ricerca guasti e problem solving su impianti installati. - Supporto tecnico da remoto ai clienti. - Interventi di assistenza tecnica e service on-site. - Formazione e affiancamento del personale del cliente durante le attività di avviamento. - Collaborazione con i reparti Software, Elettrico e Meccanico per la risoluzione delle problematiche tecniche. - Redazione di report di intervento. Disponibilità alle trasferte: la posizione richiede un'elevata disponibilità a trasferte, con permanenze di durata variabile presso clienti situati prevalentemente in Italia, Europa e Nord America. Competenze tecniche (Hard Skills) - Esperienza nella programmazione e diagnostica di PLC Siemens tramite TIA Portal. - Conoscenza dei sistemi Robot Fanuc. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di schemi elettrici e pneumatici. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese tecnica. Costituiscono un plus - Conoscenza dei PLC Omron. - Conoscenza dei sistemi Robot KUKA. - Conoscenza di linguaggi di programmazione ad alto livello Retribuzione: La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra 30.000 € e i 40.000 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Il corso ha una durata di 40 ore e approfondirà le seguenti tematiche: - Introduzione alla lingua spagnola (Saluti, presentazioni, numeri, date e orari) - Vocabolario quotidiano (oggetti comuni, ambienti della casa, colori, cibo, bevande, famiglia) - Struttura delle frasi - Formazione di frasi affermative, negative e interrogative - Grammatica base - Conversazioni pratiche - Espressioni di cortesia Requisiti: Requisito per la partecipazione al corso è il possesso dell'Assegno Gol rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego. Alcune specifiche in più: Il percorso avrà una durata di 40 e si svolgerà in Modalità Mista (lezioni online e in presenza) presso LM Space in via Isonzo 6 a Cittadella. Le lezioni si terranno in orario 9:00-13:00 o 9:00-14:00, nel periodo tra il 12 novembre e il 4 dicembre. La partecipazione attiva al corso prevede la possibilità di richiedere un Bonus di Formazione, rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego competente del territorio. Il corso è finanziato con fondi del PNRR nell'ambito del Programma GOL ed è rivolto a persone disoccupate domiciliate in Veneto. Al termine del corso di formazione i partecipanti saranno seguiti e supportati da un Consulente Gi Group esperto nel Mercato del Lavoro che li accompagnerà nel reinserimento nel mondo del lavoro. Alcune specifiche in più: Il percorso avrà una durata di 90 ore e si svolgerà in Modalità Mista (lezioni online e in presenza) presso LM Space, via Isonzo 6, Cittadella (PD) Le lezioni avranno luogo 2 o 3 giorni a settimana in orario 8:30-13:30 oppure 9:00-13:00. La frequenza al corso di formazione dà diritto a ricevere il Bonus di Formazione rilasciato dal Centro per l'Impiego su specifica richiesta della persona. Il valore del Bonus varia in base alla specifica situazione personale. Il corso è finanziato con fondi del PNRR nell'ambito del Programma GOL ed è rivolto a persone disoccupate domiciliate in Veneto. Al termine del corso di formazione i partecipanti saranno seguiti e supportati da un Consulente Gi Group esperto nel Mercato del Lavoro che li accompagnerà nel reinserimento nel mondo del lavoro. Al Termine del corso verrà rilasciato Attestato di Partecipazione. Se sei interessato/a a partecipare a questo percorso, inviaci la tua candidatura!

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per Startup in fase di sviluppo che sta costruendo una piattaforma europea di connettività satellitare con focus su capacità wholesale, servizi di connettività gestita e applicazioni IoT abilitate dal satellite, ricerchiamo un/una Responsabile Downstream, Wholesale e Connettività Satellitare IoT (percorso Co-founder) La figura riportando alla direzione, affiancherà e collaborerà con il responsabile Upstream & Space Systems già inserito nel progetto, portando esperienza concreta, verificabile e diretta nel settore satcom. Obiettivo della ricerca Inserire un profilo senior in grado di guidare lo sviluppo downstream e commerciale dell'iniziativa, con responsabilità primaria nella costruzione del mercato, delle partnership e dell'offerta per la vendita di connettività satellitare all'ingrosso e dei servizi collegati. Il ruolo è pensato per una figura con forte attitudine imprenditoriale, credibilità industriale e capacità di esecuzione in una fase iniziale di impresa. Responsabilità principali La persona selezionata avrà il compito di: definire e guidare la strategia downstream e wholesale per servizi di connettività satellitare, airtime e capacità integrata; costruire e gestire relazioni commerciali con operatori satellitari, service provider, distributori, teleporter, integratori, OEM e partner industriali; trasformare capacità satellitare e servizi di rete in offerte vendibili, incluse soluzioni airtime, connettività gestita, white-label, wholesale e applicazioni IoT abilitate dal satellite; identificare i segmenti di mercato prioritari e i casi d'uso in cui il satellite offra un vantaggio competitivo rispetto alle reti terrestri; collaborare con il responsabile Upstream & Space Systems per tradurre i bisogni del mercato in requisiti di capacità, copertura, terminali, gateway, SLA, API e supporto. Profilo ricercato Esperienza diretta e verificabile nel settore delle telecomunicazioni satellitari. Esperienza commerciale / business development nella vendita B2B di almeno uno tra: capacità satellitare, air-time, connettività satellitare gestita, servizi satellite IoT, terminali satellitari, backhaul satellitare, soluzioni satcom per clienti industriali. Conoscenza concreta della filiera satcom: operatori, capacità, segmenti di terra, terminali, gateway, provisioning, SLA, supporto e modelli di distribuzione. Esperienza nella negoziazione di accordi wholesale, distribuzione, white-label, rivendita o managed connectivity in ambito satellitare. Seniority coerente con responsabilità autonome su partner, mercato, pipeline commerciale o risultati economici. Disponibilità a contribuire alla costruzione della società come co-founder operativo. Titoli preferenziali Esperienza presso operatori satellitari, service provider satcom, distributori specializzati, aziende satellite IoT o integratori specializzati in connettività satellitare. Familiarità con modelli GEO/MEO/LEO, servizi MSS, satellite IoT, NTN, VSAT o connettività in aree remote. Esperienza in mercati: marittimo, logistica, energia, agritech, monitoraggio remoto, infrastrutture critiche, mobilità, connettività in aree non servite. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description: The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineerRequired:-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)-German Endorsement for COC Master Course-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card-Excellent and fluent English language skills-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.Desired:- Previous SAR experience- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisor (H/F)
description: LA CHAMBRE DE COMMERCE SE PROPOSE D'ENGAGER POUR LA HOUSE OF SUSTAINABILITY : Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisorà temps plein et à durée indéterminée La Chambre de Commerce est l'institution phare des entreprises et de l'économie du Luxembourg, regroupant l'ensemble des entreprises luxembourgeoises exerçant des activités industrielles, commerciales, financier/ières, de services et émanant du secteur de l'Horeca. Elle représente aujourd'hui quelques . entreprises, intervenant à raison de % dans le PIB luxembourgeois et occupant % du total de l'emploi salarié.La promotion de l'entrepreneuriat et de l'esprit d'entreprise, le soutien au développement et à l'internationalisation des entreprises, le développement de la formation professionnelle initiale et continue ou encore la promotion d'un cadre législatif et réglementaire propice au développement économique constituent quelques missions légales clés de cet établissement public au service des entreprises et de l'économie. La House of Sustainability est une initiative de la Chambre de Commerce visant à soutenir et à faciliter la transition durable des entreprises luxembourgeoises. Elle informe, sensibilise et accompagne les entreprises sur les enjeux de durabilité au moyen d'une offre de services dédiée. Celle-ci comprend notamment des événements, des ressources, des formations, des programmes d'accompagnement et des aides financier/ières. Au-delà de sa propre offre, la House of Sustainability constitue également un premier point de contact sur les questions de durabilité et oriente les entreprises vers les initiatives et les acteurs pertinents de l'écosystème. Au sein de la House of Sustainability de la Chambre de Commerce, le Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisor accompagne les entreprises ressortissant/antes dans leurs démarches de décarbonation et de transition énergétique, dans le cadre du programme Klimapakt fir Betriber (KPB).En tant que point de contact privilégié, il/elle sensibilise les entreprises aux enjeux et opportunités liés à la décarbonation et la transition énergétique. Il/elle fournit un conseil de premier niveau, identifie les besoins et les potentiels d'amélioration, et aide les entreprises à prioriser des mesures adaptées à leur situation. Il/elle accompagne ensuite les entreprises dans la mise en œuvre des actions identifiées en les orientant vers les dispositifs de soutien, outils et mécanismes de financement pertinents. Le rôle consiste ainsi à convaincre les entreprises ressortissant/antes de la Chambre de Commerce des opportunités offertes par la transition énergétique et la décarbonation, afin de réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation, de renforcer leur compétitivité et leur résilience, tout en diminuant leur dépendance aux énergies fossiles. RESPONSABILITÉS Réaliser des visites d'entreprises afin de présenter aux entreprises membres de la Chambre de Commerce les possibilités liées à la décarbonation et à la transition énergétique, et de formuler des recommandations adaptées à leur secteur d'activité, leur taille et leur niveau de maturité.Contribuer par son expertise à la conception d'événements thématiques en partenariat avec les parties prenant/antes du Klimapakt fir Betriber afin de promouvoir les opportunités liées à la décarbonation et à la transition énergétique, ainsi que les dispositifs d'accompagnement existants.Orienter les entreprises vers les outils et dispositifs du Klimapakt fir Betriber afin de leur permettre d'évaluer leur situation, de définir des plans d'action adaptés à leurs besoins et d'assurer le suivi de la mise en œuvre de leurs actions de transition.Développer des supports de conseil permettant d'informer les entreprises sur les dispositifs d'aide étatiques disponibles pour leurs investissements dans des mesures de protection du climat et de les accompagner dans leurs démarches administratives.Collaborer avec les partenaires institutionnels afin de faire évoluer et d'adapter les solutions et dispositifs d'accompagnement existants aux besoins des entreprises.Contribuer au développement de contenus thématiques et sectoriels mettant en avant les bénéfices économiques, environnementaux et stratégiques de la transition énergétique et de décarbonation.Alimenter les différents canaux de communication de la House of Sustainability (site web, newsletter, réseaux sociaux, publications spécialisées).Participer activement aux groupes de travail et réunions de coordination avec les partenaires du Klimapakt fir Betriber. title: Orthophoniste (H/F)
description: CDI à temps partiel ou à temps plein (% - %) Le Pontalize offre aux s la possibilité de bénéficier d'une prise en charge intégrale et d'un accompagnement spécialisé non limité dans les différents moments de sa vie et ce sur un même et unique site. La mission est de trouver pour toute personne qui lui est adressée, une place dans la société qui marie le plus d'autonomie et de liberté avec les besoins et les capacités de l'individu. Ce que nous offrons : Un emploi motivant dans un environnement respectueux, dynamique et stimulant ;Poste conventionné CCT-FHL ; heures hebdomadaire (équivalent temps plein) ;Rémunération sur  mois ;Formation continue ;Pécule de vacances ; jours de congés (équivalent temps plein), congé social, .Salle de sport, restauration à tarifs avantageux, . ;Possibilités de stationnement sur site et à proximité. title: Gestionnaire administratif de formations (m/f/d) (H/F)
description: Gestionnaire administratif de formations (m/f/d) (réf. description: SD-26154-POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN LAND SURFACE MODELLING OF FOREST ECOSYSTEMSFixed term contract | Belvaux | 12 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join usThe Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organization (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/How will you contribute?The researcher will participate in two complementary projects focused on modelling forest ecosystem responses across seasonal to decadal timescales: SORTIE (Seasonal Forecast of Forest Status in Luxembourg), funded by the National Collaboration Program (NCP) of the Copernicus Climate Change Services, and HiDRATE (Integrating High resolution Data from Remote sensing And land surface models for Transpiration and Evaporation mapping), funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR). The overarching objective is to quantify the predictive capabilities of land surface models in capturing forest ecosystem responses under stress and to translate their outputs into diagnostic indicators. To address these challenges, both projects will jointly employ the latest version of the Community Terrestrial Systems Model (CTSM), multiple in situ measurements (e.g., sap flow, eddy-covariance fluxes, dendrometers), various Earth Observation (EO) data streams, and climate information across multiple temporal scales. The selected candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling group of the Environmental Sensing and Modelling unit and will collaborate closely with the national project partner MeteoLux and the international project partner CESBIO.The selected candidate will play a central role in both projects and their scientific outputs. The primary mission is to: (1) implement the CTSM model across multiple forest monitoring sites; (2) develop a robust analytical framework to assess model sensitivity to environmental drivers using in situ and EO data; and (3) synthesize model outputs into diagnostic indicators that integrate meteorological conditions, forest fluxes, phenological dynamics, biomass productivity, and forest health status. To accomplish these objectives, the candidate will apply advanced statistical methods and leverage high-performance computing (HPC) resources. The candidate will actively contribute to the dissemination, valorisation and transfer of project results. This will include presenting findings at national and international scientific conferences, publishing in reputable peer-reviewed journals, and communicating outcomes to relevant stakeholders. title: Telecoms Software Engineer (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:Telecom Software EngineerWith our groundbreaking satellite 5G constellation, OQ Technology is a global leader in satellite IoT connectivity and next-generation non-terrestrial network (NTN) services. As the first company to seamlessly integrate standardized cellular technology with satellites, OQ Technology is transforming how connected devices communicate beyond the reach of terrestrial networks.Our technology enables secure, scalable connectivity for industries including Oil & Gas, Utilities, Mining, Agriculture, Maritime, Logistics, Transport, and Environmental Monitoring, helping organizations monitor and manage critical assets anywhere in the world. We are now extending this capability to 5G NR-NTN direct-to-device (D2D) services, connecting commercial smartphones and dedicated terminals directly to satellites.As we continue to develop our 5G NR-NTN D2D missions, we are looking for an experienced Telecom Software Engineer to join our Telecom Team at our facility in Luxembourg, reporting to the Team Lead. You will develop, integrate and test the OQ 5G gNodeB protocol stack adapted to run onboard our satellites, working across 3GPP specification study, NTN adaptation of L2 and L3, C/C++ implementation, and porting to space-representative processing platforms. You will validate your work hands-on in our telecom lab against commercial smartphones and D2D terminals, and collaborate closely with a multi-disciplinary team spanning the 5G Core, user equipment, and the satellite payload.Job Location:  LUXEMBOURGStarting Date:  Start ImmediatelyJob Type:  UNLIMITEDTasks:  The tasks below are representative and not exhaustive. The Company may assign the post holder to other tasks where it considers this in its interests.General and Teamwork• Contribute to OQ's 5G NR-NTN D2D projects, delivering assigned tasks to the agreed schedule and quality.• Carry out hands-on experiments in the Telecom Lab to test and validate new implementations and theoretical concepts.• Take part in Telecom Team brainstorming sessions and technical discussions, and share relevant findings with the team.• Report task progress and completion status to the Team Lead at regular intervals.• Support colleagues on other project tasks and on hands-on troubleshooting.• Take on additional work on the 3GPP NTN NB-IoT protocol stack, eNodeB and UE sides, including end-to-end and interoperability testing with third-party and commercial devices.Technical• Review mission and project documentation to understand scope, objectives and technical baseline, including statements of work, proposals, 3GPP discussion notes and progress reports.• Study the NR-NTN direct-to-device problem across the use cases, protocol layers and procedures each mission depends on, including services such as SMS over NAS and emergency broadcast, the L2 and L3 adaptations NTN requires, TDD DL-UL pattern design, initial access and system information acquisition, and the effects of long propagation delay and Doppler shift on the link.• Review the relevant 3GPP specifications to extract requirements, confirm compliance and identify technical constraints.• Build working knowledge of the open-source gNodeB stack: code structure, software architecture, build, installation, configuration and execution.• Port and adapt the stack to onboard processing environments, covering cross-compilation, embedded Linux targets, real-time performance, CPU and memory budgets, and interfaces to the FPGA/SDR physical layer.• Develop new C/C++ code blocks from the preceding studies, and carry out unit, functional and end-to-end testing in the lab on representative hardware.• Gain knowledge of the other system elements: the 5G Core Network (5GC), the UE (commercial smartphones or dedicated D2D terminals), and the satellite platform (onboard processing units, FPGA, SDR and RF front-end).• Maintain continuous documentation of research, analysis, requirements, design, proposed solutions and evaluation results.• Commit work to the project GitLab repositories under version control on a continuous basis.• Raise concerns, open questions, risks and critical issues with the team as soon as they are identified.RequirementsEssential• MSc or equivalent in telecommunications, electronic, embedded systems or computer engineering, or a related discipline.• Minimum five years of professional software development experience in telecoms or embedded systems.• Commercial experience in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux, in a real-time or embedded context, including multithreaded and latency-sensitive code.• CMake-based build systems.• Working knowledge of 5G NR Higher L1 and L2 (MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC) and of the cell search, system information and random-access procedures.• Ability to read 3GPP specifications and translate them into design and code.• Automated unit and integration testing with GoogleTest/GoogleMock or Catch2, run through CTest within GitLab CI, with JUnit XML test reports and code coverage (gcov, lcov or gcovr) published to merge requests.• GitLab workflows: merge requests, code review, and CI/CD pipelines using containerised (Docker) build and test runners.• Debugging and runtime analysis with GDB and sanitisers (AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer).• Protocol and log analysis using Wireshark and UE or terminal diagnostic tools.• Professional written and spoken English.Desirable• Experience with open-source RAN stacks (for example srsRAN or OpenAirInterface).• Familiarity with 3GPP Release 17 and later NTN features.• MAC scheduler, carrier aggregation or TDD pattern design experience.• Embedded Linux build systems (Yocto, Buildroot) and cross-compilation for ARM targets.• Static analysis tools (clang-tidy, cppcheck) and performance profiling (perf, Valgrind).• SDR platforms (for example USRP) and FPGA-to-software PHY interfaces.• Understanding of satellite systems and orbital effects on the radio link.• Exposure to ECSS software standards (ECSS-E-ST-40C, ECSS-Q-ST-80C).• NB-IoT or NB-IoT NTN protocol experience.• Integration and verification, field testing or interoperability testing with commercial smartphones or dedicated D2D terminals.• Python for test automation (for example pytest).Additional Information:  As part of the recruitment process, candidates may be required to provide a criminal record certificate issued within the last three (3) months.Benefits• Enjoy a 50% income tax exemption on your salary - an exceptional incentive for top talent relocating to Luxembourg, subject to eligibility conditions.• Flexibility to work remotely one day per week.• Opportunity to work on flagship EU space mission projects.• A dynamic, high-growth environment with career development opportunities.• Regular company events and team activities.Études:  Master (Bac+5)Métier / domaine de formation:  MSc or equivalent in telecommunications, electronic, embedded systems or computer engineering, or a related discipline.

description: Description des tâches:The European Volleyball Confederation (CEV) is the institution responsible for governing 56 National Federations throughout Europe and is recognised as such by the Fédération Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB).Our ultimate goal is to promote Volleyball and Beach Volleyball and to raise the status of our sport to a higher level.Whether the game is played indoors or on sand, Volleyball connects and brings people together from children playing in their free time up to professional and elite athletes.We cultivate a strong sense of togetherness with all stakeholders, the Member National Federations, their national leagues, clubs, players, coaches, organisers and other partners of European Volleyball, from grassroots level to the top events.We are currently looking to recruit a:CRM ManagerLocation: Luxembourg headquartersType of contract: Full time - PermanentDepartment: Digital & TV DepartmentReporting to: Digital, Content & OTT ManagerSalary: CompetitiveStart date: ASAPThe RoleThe European Volleyball Confederation (CEV) is seeking a highly analytical and strategic CRM Manager to join the Digital & TV Department.
