title: PhD Positions in Systems Engineering (Up to 2 positions)
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) has two vacancies for PhD candidates within different disciplines of Systems Engineering/New Product Development, funded through the Centre for Research-based Innovation, SFI-CELECT (Research Centre for Effective Engineering and Learning in Complex Systems).

The positions are 3-year doctoral research fellowships starting in 2026/2027. Each PhD candidate will be embedded in the research activities of SFI-CELECT and will work closely with NTNU, University of Sout-Eastern Norway (USN), University of Agder (UiA), Technical University of Denmark (DTU), and leading industrial partners in the product manufacturing, defence and aerospace, and maritime sectors.

You will be supervised by Professor Torgeir Welo.

About the project

SFI-CELECT (Research Centre for Effective Engineering and Learning in Complex Systems) started in 2026 and is funded by the Research Council of Norway and industrial partners. The centre is led by the University of South-Eastern Norway (USN) in close collaboration with NTNU and UiA, and involves a broad consortium of leading companies across multiple industrial sectors. Through research on new methodologies for effective engineering and learning in complex systems, we aim to accelerate innovation and value creation in industry by developing better methods and smarter tools to ‘do more with less— and faster’. SFI-CELECT runs from 2026 to 2033 and is Norway’s most ambitious research initiative within innovation in complex systems.

The primary objective of SFI-CELECT is to leap the innovation and product realization capabilities in some of Norway’s leading industries by enhancing how new products are developed and managed. Operating within an integrated academic-industry ecosystem, SFI-CELECT will generate research-based methodologies, methods and tools for effective and efficient product innovation and realization, embracing the complexity and dynamics in today’s business environments where digitalization and AI tools play an increasingly important role.

A key aim of CELECT is to establish an integrated academic-industry learning and educational ecosystem, where PhDs and researchers work together across disciplines to solve complex problems of high industrial importance using industry-as-a-laboratory as the research context.

Education and competence building are central pillars of CELECT. The centre will educate more than 30 PhD and postdoctoral researchers and over 120 MSc students, strengthening Norway’s international position in new-product innovation. Work location for the two positions posted here is NTNU - Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, Trondheim, Norway.

PhD position 1: Strategies for leveraging cross-functional knowledge flows in digitally supported NPD processes

Since the outcome of NPD processes is not only the physical artifact but also the creation, acquisition and transfer of knowledge, cross-functional knowledge flows are central to NPD effectiveness in (quality of decisions and solutions) and efficiency (speed and ‘first-time-right’). This PhD will research how such cross-functional knowledge flows can be enabled, managed and leveraged in contemporary NPD settings where collaborations are increasingly mediated by shared digital tools rather than co-located interaction. Accordingly, s/he will investigate how organizations can make NPD work processes more productive by better understanding where digital tools has their limitations. Moreover, the candidate will determine which countermeasures that can be established to stimulate and improve interactions across functional boundaries to make work flows more tangible and transparent with regard to identifying potential waste sources and lack of value.

PhD position 2: Optimizing product design for efficient manufacturing using digital tools throughout the New Product Development (NPD) process

The aim of this PhD is to develop knowledge-based, Design for Manufacturing (DfM) strategies for improved decision support in integrated product and process development. The PhD will develop, test and verify new DfM platforms, bridging theory, practices, processes, people and digital tools, and equipping companies with the capability necessary to effectively integrate manufacturing considerations, including product-service lifecycle responsibility, early in the product development process. 

This position will complement PhD position 1 above, which focuses more generally on cross functional knowledge flow in multidisciplinary NPD teams. Some key research questions are:

  • How can manufacturing considerations and requirements be efficiently and effectively integrated into the early stages of NPD?
  • How can we integrate AI into our digital thread to automatically retrieve DfM data, specifications, and essential knowledge for NPD?
  • How can we design modern learning frameworks to build a digital Design for Manufacturing (DfM) knowledge base?
  • What role does externally captured information play in design support related to DfM?
  • How can organizations utilize formal decision-support frameworks to operationalize and leverage their strategic Design for Manufacturing (DfM) capabilities?
  • How can organizations enable interoperability between people, processes and IT/AI tools within such frameworks? 
Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate within a 3-year timeframe
  • Carry out high-quality research within the framework described above
  • Academic publications in high-quality journals and conferences
  • Participate in activities in associated research groups
  • Actively work companies in an industry-as-laboratory environment, combining qualitative and quantitative research
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Active involvement in SFI CELECT’s doctoral team across NTNU, USN and UIA, including research school INRESCOS and participate in common workshops, learning events and courses

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information*
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Management or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Strong academic background relevant to the topic
  • Good written and oral English skills
  • You must meet the requirements to obtain NATO security clearance for access to the facilities of the partner companies
  • The hiring of each PhD candidate must be approved by the board of SFI-CELECT

*Final year master students at the IV-faculty at NTNU can apply and start in a part-time position, no later than January 1st 2027. This will be considered as an integrated PhD at NTNU. Then Section 23-2 of the PhD regulations apply for admission requirements.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Academic or industrial experience from knowledge-based development
  • Knowledge in using G/AI/digital tools
  • Competence in modelling and data programming
  • Knowledge and skills in executing case studies and qualitative research studies
  • General industrial work experience
  • Experience from design/new product development/value chain/manufacturing as practitioner
  • International work experience
  • Scandinavian language skills
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Highly motivated
  • Systematic and structured
  • Able to work independently
  • Curious and enthusiastic
  • Strong ability to systematically carry out goal-oriented work
  • Passion for interdisciplinary research
  • Eager to learn and work in teams
  • Good skills for sharing and communicating research results
  • Strong interest in combining theory and practice using the industry-as-laboratory concept

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Exciting and stimulating tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • CELECT facilities, industrial network, a joint PhD environment and access to PhD school Inrescos
  • Excellent research infrastructure (experiments and modelling)
  • Industry-as-laboratory possibilities
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Which position you are applying for
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • For master students from NTNU at the IV faculty, you must submit temporary transcript and a description of your master thesis project
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Torgeir Welo, e-mail: torgeir.welo@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 07.11.2026

title: Industrimekaniker
description:
Din innsats holder samfunnet i gang

I Remiks jobber vi hver dag med å forvalte samfunnets ressurser på en smartere og mer bærekraftig måte. Avfall er ikke bare avfall, det er ressurser som kan brukes på nytt og en viktig del av det grønne skiftet.

Remiks er et konsern med flere selskaper og ulike forretningsområder, og vi er avhengige av driftssikkert utstyr for å løse vårt samfunnsoppdrag. Nå søker vi en industrimekaniker som vil bidra til sikker og effektiv drift gjennom vedlikehold, feilsøking og tekniske forbedringer av våre anlegg og maskiner.

Hvorfor jobbe i Remiks?

Hos oss får du en jobb med både faglig tyngde og mening. Som industrimekaniker er du med på å sikre at anlegg, maskiner og utstyr fungerer som de skal, hver eneste dag. Din kompetanse er avgjørende for at vi kan utføre vårt samfunnsoppdrag på en trygg, effektiv og bærekraftig måte.

Du blir en del av et fagmiljø med høy kompetanse og godt samarbeid, der du får mulighet til å bruke og videreutvikle mekanikerfaget i en virksomhet med stor betydning for mennesker og miljø.

I tillegg får du:

Et tydelig samfunnsoppdragDin innsats bidrar til at viktige avfallstjenester fungerer for innbyggerne, og til bedre ressursutnyttelse i et mer bærekraftig samfunn.

Varierte og meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaverDu jobber med vedlikehold, feilsøking og reparasjon av maskiner og tekniske anlegg som er avgjørende for den daglige driften.

En kompleks og spennende virksomhetDu blir en del av et konsern med flere selskaper, ulike anlegg og varierte tekniske utfordringer.

Ansvar og faglige utfordringerDu får en viktig rolle i arbeidet med å sikre driftssikkerhet, kvalitet og kontinuerlig forbedring.

Et kompetent fagmiljøDu jobber sammen med dyktige kolleger som deler kunnskap, finner løsninger og er stolte av faget sitt.

Om stillingen

Stillingen er et vikariat til 1.november 2027, med mulighet for fast ansettelse. Oppstart er snarest mulig, og lønn etter avtale.

Som en del av Remiks-konsernet er du opptatt av det store bildet. Vil du ha en jobb med mening, så er du på vei til rett plass. Du aksepterer kollegaer og kunder som de er, med alle de ulikheter vi mennesker bærer på.

Som industrimekaniker i Remiks får du en sentral rolle i arbeidet med å sikre stabil og effektiv drift av våre anlegg og vårt tekniske utstyr. Du får et bredt og variert ansvarsområde, og vil jobbe tett med kolleger på tvers av virksomheten for å holde maskiner og anlegg i best mulig stand.

Du vil være en viktig bidragsyter i det daglige vedlikeholdsarbeidet gjennom feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og forebyggende vedlikehold. Samtidig vil du bidra til å identifisere forbedringsmuligheter som styrker driftssikkerheten, reduserer nedetid og sikrer en effektiv ressursutnyttelse.

Du kan forvente å jobbe både med akutte utfordringer som krever raske løsninger, og langsiktig vedlikehold som bidrar til at Remiks når sine mål, og at vi som konsern kan levere på vårt viktige samfunnsoppdrag.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagbrev som mekaniker
  • Ryddig, ansvarsbevisst og pålitelig
  • Førerkort kl. B
Vi tilbyr
  • Muligheten til å påvirke og styre egen hverdag, i et kompetent og tverrfaglig fagmiljø
  • Svært gode muligheter for faglig utvikling
  • Dyktige og engasjerte kollegaer i et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Det er høyt under taket og lav terskel i Remiks-konsernet
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Blant de beste pensjons- og forsikringsordninger som er å oppdrive
  • Velferdsordninger som kantinetilbud, tilgang til treningsrom og muligheter for trening i arbeidstida
  • Mulighet for å delta i et aktivt og allsidig bedriftsidrettslag

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Remiks er et avfallsselskap som samler inn, håndterer og behandler avfall i Nord-Norge. Vi tilbyr avfallsløsninger for næringslivet og utfører lovpålagte oppgaver gjennom innsamling av husholdningsavfall i Tromsø og Karlsøy kommune.

Vi jobber med utgangspunkt i våre verdier miljøbevisst, pålitelig, nyskapende og tilgjengelig. Disse verdiene er forankret i alt vi gjør og våre ansatte er våre fremste ambassadører for disse verdiene.

Remiks er et aksjeselskap som eies i sin helhet av Tromsø og Karlsøy kommune. Konsernet har ca. 150 ansatte og vi har holder til i moderne lokaler ved Miljøparken på nordspissen av Tromsøya. I våre lokaler er det lav terskel og høyt under taket.

Remiks Miljøpark AS er moderselskapet for Remiks Husholdning AS og Remiks Næring AS. Likevel ser vi på oss selv som ett - én familie - med felles mål og interesser.

Vi er underlagt offentlighetsloven, og vi gjør oppmerksom på at du som søker kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. CV kan også bli benyttet til utvidet søkerliste. Du vil i søknadsprosessen kunne anmode om å ikke bli oppført i søkerlisten, og må da angi en begrunnelse. I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, 2. ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. Du vil bli varslet om anmodningen ikke tas til følge.

Du kan lese mer om oss på remiks.noHva Remiks jobber med finner du også mer om her.

title: Associate Professor (100 %, three years) in snow science / snow avalanches
employer: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
description:
The position

We are seeking a three-year fixed-term Associate Professor with a focus on snow science at the Department of Geosciences at The Faculty of Science and Technology, UiT the Arctic University of Norway. The position is attached to the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group.

Tromsø is a vibrant Arctic city surrounded by dramatic mountains, fjords and accessible wilderness — an exceptional living laboratory for snow and mountain research. The region offers year-round opportunities for fieldwork, easy access to skiing and mountaineering, and outstanding nature experiences (midnight sun in summer, northern lights in winter). We value work-life balance and outdoor culture here, which many researchers find inspiring for both research and personal life.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. You must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer.

The department

The Department of Geosciences has currently 16 permanent scientific staff positions, 21 post-doctoral fellows and researchers, 24 PhD students and 15 technical/administrative positions. The Department includes three scientific groups: (1) Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards group, (2) Sedimentary Systems, Paleoclimates and Environments group, and (3) Geophysics, Glaciology and Oceanography group. It also hosts the Centre of Excellence iC3: Centre for ice, Cryosphere, Carbon and Climate . The Department is also a member of iEarth - Centre for Integrated Earth Science Education. We offer courses at all levels from bachelor to PhD studies and hosts approximately 150 students.

Over the last decade, the department has strategically built up expertise and research and education activities in geohazards. Geohazards is now a key focus area for the department, with established networks, ongoing projects and ambitions to further expand capabilities in snow science, avalanches and related processes. Earlier work has focused on rock slopes, slush flows, wet snow avalanches, climate adaptation and hazard/runout modelling. We would like to develop this research direction. The position benefits from active connections to the Department of Physics and Technology, Department of Technology and Safety and the Center for Avalanche Research and Education (CARE), and interdisciplinary research is encouraged to strengthen UiT’s position as a driver of Arctic knowledge, such as incorporating elements of psychology, preparedness and climate research.

The position’s field of research/field of work

The successful candidate is expected to:

  • Conduct high-quality research that strengthens UiT’s snow science portfolio within the snow science and geohazards thematic area. Research may also be interdisciplinary, and a connection with CARE and other UiT institutes is encouraged.
  • Teach undergraduate and advanced graduate courses, as well as participate in teaching of the field courses organized by the scientific group. The successful candidate will be expected to fulfil basic pedagogical competence within two years.
  • Supervise students at all levels, including MSc and PhD students.
  • Build external networks and represent the department at meetings, conferences and community outreach events.
  • Respond to media enquiries within your field.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to secure external funding and contribute to establishing permanent snow science capability at UiT.

It is expected that the participant will participate in disseminating research to a wider public. 

Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting

Associate Professor Louise Daines-Vick, phone + 47 90 47 30 83, email: louise.m.vick@uit.no

Professor/Head of Department (interim) Anders Schomacker, phone + 47 95 52 34 64, email: anders.schomacker@uit.no

Qualifications

For this three-year fixed-term position as Associate Professor with a focus on snow science the applicants

  • must have a PhD in geosciences, physics, mathematics or a closely related field and a documented publication record in snow science and/or related geohazards. 
  • must have experience in, and a strong dedication to, field-based research and navigating snowy terrain. A track record or commitment to acquisition of external funding is desired.  The research should complement the existing research strengths within the fields of the Solid Earth Science, Mineral Resources and Geohazards scientific group, which includes the field of geohazards. 
  • must have an ability to communicate effectively in English. 
  • documented pedagogical competence. All applicants for teaching and research positions shall document their pedagogical competence. You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at higher education level. This includes basic skills in planning, conducting, evaluating and developing teaching and guidance. Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years.
  • Norwegian language skills: The position requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

The applicants should have expertise in one or several aspects of snow avalanches and geohazards. Research approaches may include, for example, remote sensing, numerical and physical modelling, laboratory experiments, and field measurements on snow, slush, debris, or mixed materials. 

At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA).

Pedagogical competence

All applicants for teaching and research positions must document their educational competence in their application.

Those who do not meet the requirements for pedagogical competence upon employment will be required to meet them within two years. UiT offers courses in educational competence to employees.

You must have acquired basic competence for teaching and supervision at university and college level.This entails basic skills in planning, implementing, evaluating and developing teaching and supervision. 

See how to document educational competence: About the pedagogical portfolio - Result  (English guide at the bottom of the page)

We offer
  • A stimulating international research environment within the geohazards theme and opportunities for collaboration across UiT.
  • Support for career development, supervision of students and external funding applications
  • Access to university research infrastructure, administrative and technical support, and professional development (mentoring, courses and workshops)
  • You will join a thriving geosciences environment with active projects, a strong student cohort and close interdisciplinary collaboration. You will have access to relevant laboratory and field equipment, opportunities to participate in and lead field campaigns, and support for outreach and stakeholder engagement
  • Allocated funds to support your research, travel and equipment needs
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Good arrangements for pension, insurance and loans in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Access to the department cabin Heiahytta for a reasonable rental fee
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services.

Work- and salary conditions 

The successful candidate must be willing to get involved in the ongoing development of their department and the university as a whole.

The allocation of working hours is flexible and allocated on a case-by-case basis. In general, Associate Professors will spend an equal amount of time on teaching and research and development work after time spent on other duties has been deducted. As a norm, the time resources spent on administrative duties constitutes 5 % for academic staff. 

The remuneration for Associate Professor is in accordance with the State salary scale code 1011, with a gross annual salary ranging from NOK 700000,-  to 900000,- in a 100 % position. In special cases, a higher salary may be considered. 

As a state employee, you have one of the best pension schemes available. For more information see: spk.no.

Application

The application must include: 

  • Cover letter including a short description of interests and reasons for applying for the position  
  • CV containing a complete overview of education, experience and professional work 
  • Diplomas, diploma supplements and transcripts (all degrees, in original language and translated) 
  • Letter(s) of recommendation if applicable
  • Two references with contact details 
  • Documented pedagogical competence. Brief description of teaching philosophy/documentation of educational competence in the form of a pedagogical map or course certificate of completed university pedagogical basic competence such as UNIPED 100 at UiT or equivalent from other universities 
  • A list of your academic production 
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important 
  • Academic works, up to ten. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Documentation of English proficiency.  

Proficiency in the English language can be documented in the following ways: 

  • Diploma from a Norwegian upper secondary school with both spoken and written English (140 hours) 
  • TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) 
  • IELTS (International English Testing Service) 
  • Completed university degree in the field of English language or literature 
  • One year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or USA, for which English was the language of instructions. 

Documentation has to be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no 

Assessment

The applicants will be assessed by an expert committee. The committee's mandate is to undertake an assessment of the applicants' qualifications on the basis of the written material presented by the applicants, and the detailed description drawn up for the position.

The applicants who are assessed as best qualified will be called to an interview. The interview shall among other things, aim to clarify the applicants personal suitability for the position and motivations. A trial lecture may also be held.

General information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for applicants.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment.

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

​According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

In case of discrepancies between the Norwegian and the English version of this description, the Norwegian version takes precedence.

UiT The Arctic University of Norway is an internationally leading broad-based university. Our vision is to be a driving force in the North. The Northern Sami term eallju, which means diligence, sets the tone for UiT's drive. Together with students, staff, and society at large, we will utilizeour location in Northern Norway and Sápmi, our academic breadth, and interdisciplinary advantages to shape the future. 

UiT has approximately18,000 students, more than 4,000 employees, and is established across four main campuses and seven additional study locations in Northern Norway and on Svalbard. title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!
description:
Er du en dyktig mekaniker som brenner for at maskiner skal fungere 100 %, yte maksimalt og se skikkelige ut? Motiveres du av varierte dager, god tillit og friheten til å legge opp din egen hverdag slik at arbeidet flyter best mulig? Da vil du trives hos oss i Cramo.

 

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: Richard.taylor@randstad.noMobil: 982 95 163

For å søke:Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Søknadsfrist - Senest 30.10.26. (Ansettelse kan bli gjort før frist)

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

Den vakte stor interesse og fikk blant annet byggeskikkprisen for 1994. Morten så snart potensialet i å bygge et turistanlegg med norsk kultur og historie som tema. I samarbeid med bedriften

title: Partner Manager (B2B Sales) | UK
description:
We’re looking for a Partner Manager (B2B Sales) to help us grow in the UK market! If you’re a native or near-native (C2) English speaker with a passion for sales and the drive to build strong partnerships, keep reading!

About Nettbureau

Nettbureau is a Norwegian scale-up that helps consumers across Europe make better decisions through comparison and tender services like eiendomsmegler.no, flytta.se, luz.es, and fotovoltaico.it. Today, we operate 100+ services across 15 countries.

We combine strong growth with profitability and were recently named one of the Financial Times’ Europe’s Long-Term Growth Champions 2025. In Norway, we've been named a “Gaselle” company (one of the country’s fastest-growing businesses) for ten consecutive years, earning us a spot in the Hall of Fame.

We’re a team of 95+ people, with around 50 based in Oslo. You’ll join the UK team while also being part of a larger, international sales team working across multiple markets.

We value a friendly and flexible work environment, with opportunities to connect through both social activities and professional development.

📖 Learn more about us at Nettbureau.com and check out our employee handbook.

About the UK team

We launched in the UK in 2025, starting in the green energy space with sites such as solarenergy.co.uk and evchargers.uk. We’re a small, entrepreneurial team.

The team consists today of three people: a Content & Marketing Specialist, a Partner Manager, and a Country Manager. As our team grows, you’ll join as our second Partner Manager, working alongside our existing Partner Manager to grow our partner base.

You will work in a fast-moving environment where new services and verticals are continuously launched, giving you strong exposure and the opportunity to shape how we grow the UK market.

About the Role

As our new Partner Manager (B2B Sales), you will play a key role in launching and growing our UK market by acquiring new B2B customers and building long-term commercial partnerships.

While we generate a steady flow of high-quality inbound leads through our services, this is primarily a new business role. Your success will depend on consistently driving outbound prospecting, building your own pipeline, and actively creating new sales opportunities. Alongside winning new business, you’ll manage your own portfolio of signed partners: keeping them active and satisfied, growing their accounts, and making sure invoices are paid.

Our offering gives potential clients access to warm, relevant, GDPR-compliant leads with no upfront commitment. This creates a strong foundation for meaningful sales conversations and long-term client relationships.

You will work with a wide range of clients, from small local businesses to large multinational companies, across multiple industries and product verticals. This variety means high pace, constant learning, and significant ownership of your results.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the full B2B sales cycle from prospecting to closing new business

  • Build and grow a strong pipeline through active outbound prospecting by phone and email, and follow up open prospects until they sign or decline

  • Deliver online presentations and product demos to prospective clients

  • Identify client needs and tailor solutions to match their business goals

  • Grow existing client accounts by finding ways to increase their value, such as more lead volume, new regions or additional services

  • Keep partners active and prevent churn by following up regularly and acting early on signs of dissatisfaction or reduced activity

  • Follow up on overdue invoices and work with our business operations and finance teams on cases that need escalation

  • Track and manage all sales activity in Pipedrive, our CRM system

  • Collaborate with internal teams (content, marketing and business operations) on partner feedback, lead delivery, sales processes and conversion rates

  • Contribute to the launch and scaling of new services in the UK market, by spotting new opportunities and helping ensure continued product-market fit

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a driven and proactive sales professional who enjoys building pipeline, winning new business, and taking ownership of their results.

You should be comfortable working in a high-activity environment where consistent prospecting and outreach are key to success.

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you have:

  • Native-level or C2 proficiency in British English, including the tone and conventions of UK business, with strong communication and negotiation skills

  • A proven track record of selling to UK businesses, with a good understanding of the UK business landscape

  • Documented experience in outbound B2B sales, i.e. finding and signing new clients

  • Experience working in a high-activity sales environment with clear targets

  • A proven ability to close sales remotely via phone, video calls, and email (this role is about selling remotely rather than face-to-face)

  • Strong ability to identify client needs and translate them into relevant solutions

  • Commercial understanding: the ability to assess the economics of a deal and prioritise the most valuable clients and profitable agreements

  • A disciplined and structured approach to managing your pipeline and sales process

  • Experience using CRM systems to track performance and prioritise effectively

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and motivation to continuously improve

No formal degree is required. We value proven sales skills and results over academic background.

Extra points if you have:

  • B2B sales experience in one of our verticals, such as renewable energy, real estate or telecommunications

  • Experience with performance-based or lead generation products

  • Familiarity with AI tools, sales automation or CRM automations to improve efficiency

  • A degree in business, marketing, sales or a related field

What We Offer

  • NOK 10,000/year for professional development

  • Flexible working hours at our Tøyen office in Oslo

  • Choice of Mac or PC, plus your mobile phone and home broadband paid for

  • Regular workshops with partners like Google, Meta, and Microsoft

  • A supportive and social work environment with ambitious colleagues

  • A subsidised canteen with healthy lunch options

  • Social events throughout the year, including after-work drinks, team activities, and an annual company trip

Excited about this role?

title: Driftsavtale fysioterapi 100 % - Sarpsborg kommune
description:
Sarpsborg kommune har ledig avtalehjemmel med 100 % kommunalt driftstilskudd, for offentlig godkjent fysioterapeut fra 01.01.2027. Den ledige driftsavtalen er del av gruppepraksis ved Framklinikken AS, lokalisert i Iseveien senter, Borgenhaugen. Instituttet har totalt 200 % avtalehjemler, samt 2 helprivate fysioterapeuter og 1 osteopat.  Klinikken ble etablert i 2005. Behandlere har tilgang til lukkede behandlingsrom og samarbeid med tilknyttet treningssenter med gode utstyrsfasiliteter som gir mulighet for aktiv tilnærming.   Kommunens fysioterapitjeneste består av både kommunalt ansatte fysioterapeuter og fysioterapeuter med driftsavtaler. Tjenesten er administrert under kommuneområde Velferd. Kommunen har 26 driftsavtaler og 16,6 stillinger for kommunalt ansatte fysioterapeuter, samt 6 barnefysioterapeuter som er tilknyttet familiesentrene.  Tildeling og overdragelse vil skje iht. rammeavtalen for avtalefysioterapeuter, ASA 4313. Praksis skal drives i henhold til relevant helselovgivning og på de vilkår som fremgår av forskrift om funksjons- og kvalitetskrav for fysioterapeuter med kommunal driftsavtale, samt ASA 4313, slik den til enhver tid lyder.     Arbeidsoppgaver

Stillingen er knyttet til pasientrettet arbeid innen allmenn fysioterapi på instituttet, og ved behov i pasientens hjem. 

Om lag 20 % av stillingen vil være knyttet til oppfølging av voksne personer med medfødt eller tidlig ervervet funksjonsnedsettelse innen fagområdet voksenhabilitering. Dette inkluderer oppfølging av pasienter i hjem/bolig, og samarbeid med arenaer pasientene er tilknyttet.  Stillingen gir en spennende mulighet til å kombinere bred fysioterapipraksis med spesialisert oppfølging av en pasientgruppe med sammensatte behov. Det forventes en kunnskapsbasert og oppdatert tilnærming til undersøkelse, vurdering, behandling og rehabilitering.  Det forventes at fysioterapeut følger vedtatt prioriteringsnøkkel for Sarpsborg kommune, og har en aktiv tilnærming for å gjøre pasientene i stand til å mestre egen helse. Praksis skal ha et åpent behandlingstilbud til befolkningen, med fokus på effektive pasientforløp for å redusere lange ventelister. Fysioterapeut skal samarbeide tett med andre instanser og bidra til å utvikle instituttets tilbud til kommunens innbyggere. Det forventes at fysioterapeuten ønsker å bidra aktivt ved instituttet, både faglig og sosialt. Det forventes at en stor del av behandlingen gis som gruppebehandling. Kommunen forventer at man deltar på felles fagmøter og leverer driftsrapport årlig. Dokumentasjon skal utføres i godkjent journalsystem.   

Kvalifikasjoner

Krav til utdanning :

  • Autorisert (offentlig godkjent) fysioterapeut.

Relevant videreutdanning/master vil kunne vektlegges. Kandidaten må ha:

  • Norsk autorisasjon som fysioterapeut.  HPR nummer skal oppgis 
  • Bred og relevant klinisk erfaring og kompetanse innen allmenn fysioterapi
  • Formell og oppdatert kompetanse innen allmennfysioterapi, med vektlegging av kompetanse innen ortopediske lidelser.   
  • Erfaring med eller interesse for fysioterapi til personer med medfødt eller tidlig ervervet funksjonsnedsettelse innen fagområdet voksenhabilitering
  • Erfaring og interesse for å organisere behandling av pasienter i grupper. 
  • Innsikt i inntaks- og prioriteringsarbeid, ventelister og ventelistereduserende tiltak
  • Evne til å drive fysioterapipraksis med avtalehjemmel
  • Erfaring med tverrfaglig samarbeid om pasienter
  • God kjennskap til ASA4313, og innholdet i denne

Gode skriftlige og muntlige norske språkferdigheter tilsvarende B2   Det er ønskelig at kandidaten har:    God innsikt i fysioterapeutens rolle og ansvarsområder  Et stort initiativ og engasjement for å skape og forme en god praksis.  Har god kjennskap til IKT-verktøy, journalsystem og elektronisk samhandling.  Det forventes at aktuelle søkere er kjent med nasjonale politiske føringer for fremtidens kommunehelsetjeneste. Det er viktig å gjøre seg kjent med og holde seg oppdatert på gjeldende føringer for Velferd og helsetjenester i Sarpsborg kommune. I tråd med dette legges det vekt på evne til å være med på å utvikle gode fysioterapitjenester for befolkningen i tråd med kommunens fremtidige behov.  

Personlige egenskaper

Søker må ha stor arbeidskapasitet, være faglig engasjert og motivert for kontinuerlig faglig oppdatering og utvikling. Søker må være strukturert, effektiv, selvstendig og ansvarsbevisst, samt ha gode samarbeids og kommunikasjonsevner. Søker må ha evne til å reflektere rundt egen rolle, samhandling, pasientforløp og ansvarsområder. Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt ved vurdering av kandidater I søknaden forventes det at du gjør godt rede for samlet erfaring og kompetanse innen allmenn fysioterapi, dine faglige interesseområder og planer for fortsatt faglig utvikling.   

Vi tilbyr

Viktig å vite før du starter hos oss: Som fysioterapeut med driftsavtale i Sarpsborg kommune bidrar du til å løse viktige samfunnsoppdrag gjennom verdiene våre; framtidsrettet, åpen, respektfull og troverdig (FÅRT) Du har ansvaret for tjenester som er helt sentrale i hverdagen til våre innbyggere. En stor kommune som Sarpsborg tilbyr solide fagmiljøer, fokus på innovasjon og utvikling. Som fysioterapeut i kommunen disponerer du en avtalehjemmel på de vilkår, rettigheter og plikter som følger av avtaler, reglementer og lover.  Driftsavtalen tildeles av Sarpsborg kommune som enkeltvedtak etter forvaltningsloven.   Du må sende søknaden din elektronisk innen fristen via Webcruiter. Relevante kursbevis, attester og vitnemål må lastes opp.   Politiattest :Før du tiltrer må du legge frem politiattest uten merknader som har betydning for arbeidsforhold iht. helse og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4 .   

KontaktinformasjonGrethe Lillian Strekerud Larsen, Seniorrådgiver, 47482014, grethe-strekerud.larsen@sarpsborg.com Helene Jacobsen, Avdelingsleder , 92034443, helene.jacobsen@sarpsborg.com ArbeidsstedSnekkerstubakken 26 1738 Borgenhaugen Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Sarpsborg kommune Referansenr.: 5192712467 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 11.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen skaper vi Sarpsborg! Det er vår visjon, og sammen jobber vi hver dag for at våre innbyggere skal ha gode dager. For å klare dette, trenger vi dyktige medarbeidere. 

Her i Sarpsborg kommune jobber vi etter verdiene framtidsrettet, åpen, respektfull og troverdig. For å levere gode tjenester og skape gode arbeidsmiljøer skal alle ansatte vise handling gjennom å våge, lede, lære, mobilisere og samarbeide. Dette er beskrevet i vår plattform for ledelse og medarbeiderskap, som vi har valgt å kalle for «Vi i Sarpsborg». Les hele plattformen «Vi i Sarpsborg her».

Over 60 000 innbyggere bor i Sarpsborg og hos oss i kommunen har vi cirka 6.900 fast ansatte og 4.200 årsverk (tall fra 2026). Her skal det være godt å bo, jobbe og besøke. Vil du søke jobb hos oss og være med på å utgjøre en forskjell for andre?

Sarpsborg kommune ønsker medarbeidere med ulik faglig, sosial, etnisk og geografisk bakgrunn. Dette inkluderer: ulik kompetanse, erfaring, oppvekstsvilkår, tro- og livssyn, perspektiv, nettverk, språk og dialekt, interesser, alder, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering og kjønn- og kjønnsidentitet.  Vi trenger historier, stemmer og erfaringer fra hele befolkningen.

Alle søkere må vedlegge dokumentasjon på utdanning og attester på arbeidserfaring for å dokumentere kvalifikasjoner som fremkommer i CV og  som grunnlag til lønnsfastsettelse. Ansiennitet blir vurdert og fastsatt basert på vedlagt dokumentasjon.

title: PhD Candidate in Cybersecurity Challenges in Maritime AI
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming society, and the integration of AI into the maritime industry represents a digital shift that will redefine today’s operations. The maritime industry is increasingly embracing AI, enabling a broad digital transformation. At the same time, the use of AI introduce new cybersecurity challenges that need to be understood and addressed to enable secure and trustworthy AI technology.

This PhD project will investigate cybersecurity challenges associated with the development and use of AI in the maritime domain. The project will have an interdisciplinary approach, combining insights from information security, artificial intelligence, maritime operations, and data engineering. The research may address cybersecurity risks related to the data used to develop AI models, the models themselves, or their integration and use in maritime applications.

Relevant research topics may include cybersecurity risks related to training data and AI models, data poisoning and manipulation, privacy and confidentiality, secure data sharing, and methods for assessing the security and trustworthiness of maritime AI technology. The specific research questions and methodological approach will be further developed based on the candidate’s background and interests, relevant maritime AI use cases, and collaboration with industry partners.

This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and maritime operations in close collaboration with academic and industrial partners. The research is expected to contribute new knowledge and approaches for understanding and addressing cybersecurity challenges associated with the development and use of AI in the maritime domain.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.

About the project

The candidate will work in a multidisciplinary research environment located at the heart of the maritime industry in Ålesund. Working at the NTNU department of ICT and Natural Sciences ensures close contact with the industry and research communities.

The PhD project will be part of the Norwegian Maritime AI Center that aims to accelerate operationalization of AI in the maritime value chains. The center shall position the maritime sector for accelerated and successful use of AI. The demand for safe and sustainable maritime activities, as well as the shortage of crew and engineers, are key drivers for change in the maritime sector. At the same time, there is a pull for growth, increased efficiency and profitability, while managing volatility in the markets. Moreover, the sector is critically important for global supply chains and security in a tense geopolitical situation. To demonstrate and prototype maritime AI solutions, the center will address a diverse and impactful set of use cases: Logistics, shipping and business transactions; Ship design and construction; Voyage planning and optimization; Condition monitoring and maintenance; Crew training; Maritime traffic and ship surveillance; Decarbonization and energy management; Autonomous ships and remote control.

The research partners are the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), University of Oslo, Oslo School of Architecture and Design, Royal Norwegian Naval Academy, Norwegian Mapping Authority, MET and SINTEF Nordvest. There are about 30 user partners from the maritime sector, in addition to hundreds of members of the Maritime Forum, Blue Maritime, Ocean Autonomy, and Maritime CleanTech clusters. The center will be a hub, orchestrating the interfaces with research partners and user partners to facilitate collaboration, knowledge creation, dissemination, innovation, and sharing of knowledge. The Norwegian Maritime AI Center is funded by the Research Council of Norway and the partners for the period 2026-2030. There will be approximately 25 doctoral scholarships and some postdoc positions. More information can be found here: https://www.ntnu.edu/mai

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group Cyber-Physical Systems Laboratory (CPS Lab)
  • Participate in activities in the maritime AI center
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Participate in relevant dissemination activities for the industry

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant master’s degree in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, information security, maritime studies, marine technology, risk or safety management, human factors, engineering, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. 
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme.
  • Written and oral fluency in English. Applicants with MSc degrees from institutions outside Europe are expected to document language proficiency. In extraordinary circumstances, formal documentation of language skills can be relinquished. In such cases, the candidate’s language skills will be assessed in a personal interview. 
  • The person hired must be eligible for security clearance at level CONFIDENTIAL or higher and be able to obtain such clearance within a reasonable period after employment. 

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions and Regulations for the degrees philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) and philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) in artistic development work at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) for general criteria for the position. 

Preferred selection criteria
  • Knowledge of the maritime industry
  • Knowledge of, or interest in, artificial intelligence (AI)
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian/Scandinavian equivalent level B2
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently and in research teams
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Good interpersonal skills that contribute to a friendly and inclusive work environment 

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer

 

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary.

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • CV.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page).
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work.
  • Possibly certificates.
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees. 

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Marie Haugli-Sandvik, email: marie.h.sandvik@ntnu.no or Rune Volden, email: rune.volden@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Silje Kjersem, email: silje.s.kjersem@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 19.11.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.  

Ålesund, known for its unique Art Nouveau architecture and spectacular nature, is a gem on Norway's west coast. The city offers a vibrant cultural life, modern facilities, and a dynamic business environment. With its strategic location by the sea, Ålesund provides a perfect balance between urban living and natural experiences. Here, you will find excellent schools, top-notch healthcare services, and a wide range of recreational activities. Ålesund is an ideal place for both career and family life, with a safe and inclusive community.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of ICT and Natural Sciences

Our campus in Ålesund works in a partnership with industry that is in a class of its own among Norwegian universities. This ensures a practical focus for our study programmes, while they are firmly anchored in modern theory. The Department offers programmes in automation engineering, computer engineering, electric power systems, simulation and visualization. Our research areas include autonomous vessels, robotics, cybernetics, medical technology and health informatics, and artificial intelligence. The Department of ICT and Natural Sciences is one of seven departments in the Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering .

title: Vil du forme fremtidens grønne og levende arbeidsplasser på Sunnmøre?
description:
Er du en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å skape visuelle endringer og bedre trivsel for ansatte?

 

Har du lyst til å selge et produkt alle vil ha, og som beviselig forbedrer arbeidsmiljøet? Safari Planter AS opplever solid vekst, og nå søker vi deg som vil ta eierskap til B2B-markedet vårt i Ålesund og omegn.

 

Hvorfor er dette en unik mulighet?

De fleste selger software, forsikring eller kaffemaskiner. Hos Safari Planter selger du en opplevelse, bedre inneklima og estetiske arbeidsplasser. Grønne vegger, spektakulære atriumløsninger og skreddersydd planteinteriør er i vinden som aldri før. Bedrifter investerer tungt i å få de ansatte tilbake til kontoret – og her sitter du med nøkkelen.

 

Som B2B-selger hos oss får du en sjelden kombinasjon av kreativ rådgivning og rendyrket business-to-business-salg. Du blir vårt ansikt utad mot regionens mest spennende bedrifter, eiendomsutviklere og arkitekter.

 

 

Hva vil hverdagen din bestå i?

Du vil ha stor frihet til å legge opp din egen arbeidsdag, med base fra vårt kontor i Ålesund. Hovedfokus er å fylle egen portefølje og skape grønnere rom for næringsliv og offentlig sektor:

 

  • Oppsøkende salg og relasjonsbygging: Du identifiserer muligheter, booker møter og bygger langsiktige partnerskap med beslutningstakere.
  • Kreativ rådgivning: Du lytter til kundens behov og tegner ut helhetlige løsninger i grensesnittet mellom interiør, arkitektur og biophilia (menneskets behov for natur).
  • Anbud og prosjekter: Du driver prosessene fra første kontakt og tilbudsskriving til forhandlinger og avtaleinngåelse – inkludert offentlige anskaffelser.

  • Nettverksbygging: Du representerer Safari Planter på messer, bransjetreff og i samarbeid med lokale arkitekter og interiørarkitekter.

     

 

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som trigges av å lukke avtaler, men som forstår at et godt salg starter med tillit. Du har gjerne erfaring fra prosjektsalg, kapitalvaresalg eller interiørløsninger mot bedriftsmarkedet

 

  • Du er en jeger med rådgiverhatt: Du trives med oppsøkende aktivitet, men fremstår som en profesjonell og lyttende sparringspartner for kunden.
  • Du har kommersiell teft: Du forstår B2B-markedet, hvordan offentlige innkjøp fungerer, og hvordan du posisjonerer Safari Planter som den foretrukne leverandøren.
  • Du har nettverk på Sunnmøre: Det er en stor fordel om du allerede kjenner det lokale næringslivet i regionen.
  • Språk og logistikk: Du kommuniserer flytende på norsk (skriftlig og muntlig), har gode engelskkunnskaper, og førerkort klasse B er et krav da du vil være mye på farten.

 

 

Hva kan vi tilby deg?
  • En attraktiv lønnsmodell: Konkurransedyktig fastlønn i bunn, kombinert med en provisjonsmodell som belønner gode resultater.
  • Høy påvirkningskraft: Vi er en fremoverlent organisasjon der veien fra idé til beslutning er kort. Du får være med på å forme våre fremtidige konsepter og salgsstrategier.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø: Du blir en del av et uformelt, engasjert og faglig sterkt team som brenner for det de leverer.
  • Et takknemlig produkt: Du selger løsninger som bidrar direkte til økt trivsel, lavere sykefravær og flottere visuelle rammer hos kundene dine.
