At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact. To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:     Global career opportunities     Learning & Development programs     Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)     Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being     Global Parental Leave Policy     Community involvement Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than November 4, 2026. title: Software Test Engineer

We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work. title: Application & Physics Specialist
description: RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia &amp; New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. For a strong candidate we are however willing to consider work from a home office in Denmark, Norway or Finland.About the positionAs an Application & Physics Specialist you will join a diverse and dedicated specialist group with clinical experience from different countries. The group is part of the global service organization responsible for the promotion, deployment and support of our products as well as the education of our customers.  The emphasis of the position will be on working with potential and current customers in the Nordic region to introduce them to our treatment planning system RayStation through demonstrations and training. This is done on client sites, in our training center in Stockholm, by webinars and at conferences. Another core task is creating and maintaining training materials on various formats such as interactive e-learning courses, PPT presentations and videos for students.For a candidate with medical physics competence, you will also play an important role in assisting our customers during the beam commissioning process, for example by creating beam models and advising them on measurement requirements.Up to 25% travel is required, primarily within the Nordic region and Europe.Your main tasks    Planning, performing and documenting product trainings for customers and distributors    Demonstrating RaySearch products at trade shows and onsite for prospective customers    Develop and maintain training materials    Answering tenders and explain product functionality    Collaborating with our development department through exploratory testing of new product versions     Assisting and guiding customers during the beam commissioning processYour introductionWhen starting in this position, you will get a mentor and a solid introduction to our products and ways of working following a formal certification program. You will gradually take more responsibility and start working independently.Your profileWe believe that our new Application & Physics Specialist has a great sense for service and customer support and a strong motivation to work in a highly dynamic environment. You are a social and positive person with excellent interpersonal and communication skills and enjoy presenting and teaching to bigger and smaller crowds. Further, you can quickly adapt to new contexts and appreciate various environments as well as a variety of different tasks.  You enjoy facing new challenges and solving complex problems, both independently and in collaboration with your team members. You are comfortable with working proactively, taking initiatives and have the ability to prioritize your work and adapt to sudden changes. Experience & skills    Proficiency in spoken and written English    Swedish/Danish/Norwegian/Finnish skills are meriting    BSc or MSc degree in medical physics/dosimetry/RTT or equivalent, medical physics is meriting    Clinical experience in radiotherapy, especially proton therapy or brachytherapy, is meriting    Ability to travel up to 25%     Medical device industry experience is meritingOur cultureCulture at RaySearch is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.Our offerAt RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. title: Finance Systems Business Analyst - Corporate Finance & Tagetik
description: About the jobAs our Finance Systems Business Analyst, you will be the functional expert for CCH Tagetik within Corporate Finance. You will understand how Finance processes should work and ensure that Tagetik supports them effectively. Working between Finance, IT and the platform, you will translate business needs into practical system solutions, support and train users, and help improve the platform over time.  CCH Tagetik is Alfa Laval's strategic Corporate Performance Management platform for Corporate Finance. It supports how financial information is planned, reported, controlled and governed across the Group.  This is part of Alfa Laval's broader Financial Transformation Journey, where we are building a modern and efficient environment for our financial processes. Your scope spans the full breadth of the Corporate Finance capability area at a group wide level, including how financial information is planned, reported, controlled and governed, as well as how Treasury and Tax are supported in our systems. You play a central role in making sure the platform truly serves these needs.  Key responsibilities     Act as system owner and subject matter expert for our Corporate Performance Management platform (CCH Tagetik)     Act as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, understanding their needs and advising on how this can and should work in the platform, including which data flows and setups are appropriate     Own the functional Finance perspective in discussions with the Product Owner, Solution Architect, IT teams and implementation partners.     Provide Finance expertise to the Solution Architect on business rules, data requirements and how processes should work, while ensuring that proposed solutions fit the overall architecture.     Manage master data, system controls, and user access     Act as the first point of contact for users, providing training, guidance and ongoing support     Stay close to the platform's roadmap and new features, keeping ahead of changes and guiding others through them     Perform advanced support, maintenance and administration within your area of expertise     Contribute to project activities and smaller deliveries, depending on experience, in collaboration with the Product Owner and Solution Architect     Analyze, configure, test and deploy changes to optimize existing solutions, meeting agreed time, cost and quality requirements   Who are youYou are curious, structured and comfortable working between Finance and IT. You build trust by listening carefully to stakeholders, asking the right questions and making complex topics easier to understand. You enjoy turning business needs into practical solutions and are confident challenging unclear requirements in a constructive way. You are collaborative rather than directive, and you bring people together through open dialogue, clear explanations and sound judgement. You are also patient and service-minded when supporting users, while being proactive enough to identify improvements and take ownership of issues through to resolution. What you knowTo be successful in this role, you combine a strong understanding of Corporate Finance with an interest in business systems and digital transformation. We believe our ideal candidate has:     Solid understanding of Corporate Finance processes, rules and terminology at a group-wide level.     Knowledge of Treasury and Tax processes and how they may be supported through finance systems.     Experience translating business needs and financial logic into functional system requirements.     Ability to explain complex financial concepts to non-expert technical and IT teams, and translate technical concepts into clear business language.     Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.     Experience with CCH Tagetik is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important qualities are your Finance knowledge, motivation and ability to build deep platform expertise quickly.     Experience from an international environment or a larger global company is beneficial, as is familiarity with complex, group-wide processes.     Relevant university degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related field. Your drive, curiosity, and willingness to collaborate help you turn challenges into practical solutions and contribute positively to the team's success. title: Finance Business Partner
description: We are Geely Technology Europe. A unified European R&D centre within Geely Auto Group, where world-class engineers, developers and innovators push the boundaries of intelligent mobility. Our mission is to shape the next generation of vehicle architectures, digital technologies and intelligent systems for global markets. We integrate European customer and regulatory requirements early in the development process and support multiple brands within the Geely portfolio, including Zeekr, Lynk & Co and Geely. With nearly two decades of engineering experience in Europe, we continue to build smart, sustainable and user‑centric mobility solutions.We are seeking a highly driven Finance Business Partner to support our Vehicle Line Center, with responsibility for both Operational Controlling and Program Controlling. In this role, you will partner closely with the SVP Vehicle Line Center, providing financial insights, driving decision-making, and ensuring strong governance over program spend and operational activities.You will play a key role in our planning and forecasting processes, perform proactive financial analyses, and secure that purchase requests and supplier invoices follow internal guidelines and program budgets.This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and wants to work close to product development, vehicle programs, and cross-functional leadership teams.Business Partnering    Act as the primary financial partner to the SVP Vehicle Line Center and the leadership team.    Provide clear, actionable financial insights to support strategic and operational decisions.    Challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities, and proactively drive financial performance.Operational Controlling    Lead the monthly financial closing process for the Vehicle Line Center, including variance analysis and performance reviews.    Support OPEX tracking.    Monitor operational KPIs and drive actions to meet financial targets.    Ensure compliance with financial policies and internal controls.Program Controlling    Manage program budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial plans for line-specific vehicle projects.    Monitor project spend, burn rate, and forecast accuracy; highlight deviations and corrective measures..    Ensure financial alignment between engineering functions, procurement, and program management.Governance & Approval Responsibilities    Review and approve purchase requests (PRs) and invoices, ensuring alignment with program budgets, contracts, and internal guidelines.    Maintain financial transparency across the program lifecycle.Planning & Forecasting    Lead annual budget processes and recurring forecast cycles for both operational and program areas.    Consolidate financial plans, evaluate assumptions, and prepare presentations for senior management.    Ensure accuracy and reliability of financial outlooks.Who You Are    University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or equivalent.    3 to 5+ years of experience in financial controlling, business partnering, or program controlling, ideally in the automotive or engineering sector.    Strong analytical skills and experience with budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling.    Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.    Experience with project controlling or vehicle programs is meritorious.    Strong Excel skills; experience with ERP and BI systems (e.g., SAP, Hyperion, Power BI) is a plus.    Business-oriented mindset with the ability to challenge and influence.    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.    Proactive, structured, and capable of delivering under tight deadlines.    Comfortable working in a fast-paced, innovative environment.To ensure a fair and objective recruitment process, we have chosen not to request a personal letter, though you are welcome to include one if you wish. title: Portfolio Manager - Food High Speed Separators
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.​ As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About The Job As Portfolio Manager for Food High Speed Separators, you will take ownership of the commercial performance and strategic direction of our product portfolio. With a strong business mindset, you will translate industry insights into clear priorities that ensure a competitive and profitable offering. Working cross-functionally, you will balance business opportunities with operational realities enabling effective decision-making across sales, supply, engineering, and R&D. This role requires a hands-on, commercially driven professional with interest in technology, someone who can navigate complexity and turn strategy into tangible results.  Key responsibilities:     Translate customer needs and industry insights into clear portfolio priorities and value-driven offerings     Own portfolio performance by analyzing profitability, competitiveness, and lifecycle, and initiating concrete improvement actions     Define and drive the portfolio strategy, roadmap, and product positioning in the market     Lead pricing strategy and ensure alignment with value proposition and market dynamics     Drive cross-functional alignment to balance future investments in portfolio with commercial opportunities, development cost, and resource constraints across Sales, Supply, Engineering, and R&D  This position is at our Flemingsberg office, with an expected travel commitment of approximately 45 - 50 days per year.  What You Know     University degree in industrial marketing, engineering, business development or related field, combining commercial expertise with technical understanding.     Several years of experience in portfolio management, business development, or similar commercial roles.     Strong understanding of how to develop and manage product portfolios in regulated, complex environments     Proven ability to translate market and customer insights into portfolio and business decisions that drive growth and competitiveness     Comfortable working in cross-functional, international environments, balancing technical, commercial, and operational priorities     Experience in portfolio risk management is an advantage  About You You combine strong business acumen and strategic thinking with a clear customer focus, ensuring decisions are grounded in market and value creation. You are comfortable working with incomplete or uncertain information and validate assumption through several sources and making sound decisions when needed. With strong analytical capability, you turn insights into clear actions and data driven priorities. You are a solid communicator with strong interest in technologies and industrial products. You are a self-driven, "get things done" professional who takes ownership and drives progress. Collaborative by nature, you build strong relationships across functions while keeping a long-term perspective. Curious and continuous learning, you thrive in complex environments where teamwork and shared success are key to delivering results  For more information, please contact Manager, Product Management - Food, Filip Varveris on  Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Regina García Moguel on   Union informationAnders Jansson, Unionen, Axel Scharing, Akademikerna,  Please send your application no later than 8th of November 2026. title: Head of Finance HAL
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. title: Senior Data Center Technician

collaborate to achieve shared goals, and are committed to our mission of empowering every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.Responsibilities    Apply advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve hardware, server, and network-related issues.    Install, deploy, replace, and decommission datacenter hardware in accordance with documented procedures and standards.    Perform and support complex infrastructure changes, including rack-level hardware upgrades and decommissions.    Provide technical guidance to technicians during hardware preparation, staging, installation, startup, shutdown, and replacement activities.    Coordinate planned work and downtime with relevant stakeholders to ensure quality execution and minimise operational impact.    Assist technicians with complex technical tasks and escalate issues when required.    Complete and oversee post-execution quality checks, ensuring grounding, cabling, staging, and labelling meet deployment and safety standards.    Ensure appropriate security processes are followed when decommissioning equipment and handling data-bearing devices.    Monitor operational performance through Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), dashboards, and performance reviews.    Train, coach, and mentor technicians through on-the-job training and practical technical guidance.    Participate in and support daily safety briefings and required safety training.    Promote compliance with safety procedures including PPE, equipment operation, lifting, electrical safety, and ladder or rolling stair use.    Identify opportunities to improve technical processes, procedures, service quality, and operational efficiency.    Demonstrate accountability for the quality, completeness, and reliability of work delivered.    Embody Microsoft’s culture and values in all aspects of your work.Required Qualifications    High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.    Knowledge of computer hardware, servers, networking equipment, and related components.    Experience supporting, maintaining, troubleshooting, or deploying IT equipment or related technology.    Ability to follow technical procedures and operate safely within a datacenter or similarly controlled environment.    Strong troubleshooting, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.Preferred Qualifications    Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.    Experience supporting IT infrastructure, server hardware, networking equipment, or related technology.    Experience working in a production or mission-critical 24x7x365 datacenter environment.    Experience coaching, mentoring, or providing technical guidance to other technicians.    Relevant technical certifications such as CompTIA A+, Server+, Network+, Basic Structured Cabling (BSC), Data Center Foundation Certification (DCFC), Microsoft certifications, or vendor-specific networking certifications.Background Check RequirementsAbility to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role.This position requires successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

Vi söker nu en Servicechef till vår serviceverksamhet i Zinkgruvan – en roll för dig som vill förvalta, skapa stabilitet och bygga långsiktiga relationer med både medarbetare och kund. Här blir du en viktig del av den dagliga verksamheten, nära både människor och maskiner, i en miljö där säkerhet, kvalitet och kontinuitet är avgörande. Ditt uppdrag Som Servicechef i Zinkgruvan har du det övergripande ansvaret för den lokala serviceverksamheten. Du leder och planerar arbetet för servicetekniker, administrativ/lagerfunktion samt supervisor och säkerställer att verksamheten fungerar stabilt och effektivt över tid. Rollen är operativ och närvarande, med stor del av arbetet kopplat till den dagliga driften och kundkontakten. Fokus ligger på att förvalta befintliga arbetssätt, säkerställa god leverans och skapa en trygg och välfungerande arbetsmiljö. Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden: •    Planera, leda och fördela arbetet i den lokala personalstyrkan.•    Vara en närvarande chef som stöttar, coachar och skapar struktur i vardagen.•    Säkerställa ett gott säkerhets-, arbetsmiljö- och förebyggande arbete.•    Vara kundens primära kontakt och bygga långsiktiga relationer.•    Ansvara för serviceverkstad, administration och lagerverksamhet.•    Ekonomiskt ansvar för verksamheten, inklusive budget, uppföljning och rapportering.•    Beräkna och lämna offerter vid behov.•    Arbeta för god samverkan med försäljningsorganisationen.•    Bibehålla och utveckla befintliga serviceavtal samt stötta lokal marknadsföring. Ledarskapsförväntningar På Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare ska vara inspiratörer, acceleratorer och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som leder genom att vara förebilder och som har modet att utmana status quo. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare tar en aktiv roll i att främja säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald. Utöver detta värnar våra ledare om våra anställdas välbefinnande och kontinuerliga utveckling. Vi söker dig som vågar tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar. Är du den vi söker? Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av ledarskap från arbetsledande- eller chefsroller och har en god förståelse för vad som krävs för att driva en välfungerande serviceverksamhet. Du är praktisk, strukturerad och bekväm med att ta ansvar för både människor och resultat. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha: •    Tidigare erfarenhet av ledarskap med arbetsledande- och/eller personalansvar.•    Teknisk bakgrund eller starkt tekniskt intresse.•    Grundläggande kunskaper inom ekonomi, uppföljning och rapportering.•    God datorvana och erfarenhet av affärs-/ERP-system (gärna SAP).•    God kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.•    B-körkort. Placering och resor Denna tjänst är placerad i Zinkgruvan. Resor kan förekomma i tjänsten. Ansökan och kontaktinformation Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 10 november. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.

title: Mechanical Engineer, Lund
description: Mechanical Engineer with passion for product development!At Axis, our passion is to create a smarter and safer world! We have delivered several groundbreaking products and look forward to paving the way for many more. Come join our team and help us in finding smart solutions for fantastic products!We are now seeking a mechanical engineer to join our mechanics team within System Products at Axis HQ in Lund.System Products is responsible for developing a wide and exciting product portfolio, which includes body-worn cameras, video recorders, microphone products, video decoders, sirens, and other system accessories. Your future teamWe who work in your future team are passionate engineers who love technology and tough technical challenges. We highly value creativity, collaboration, and openness. You will be overwhelmed by your colleagues' helpfulness and their willingness to help you develop.We are multiple functions working together to develop, improve, and deliver world-class products! What you'll do here as a mechanical engineerAs a mechanical engineer on System products, you will work on product development in areas such as body-worn cameras, recorders, microphone products, and other system devices. Much of your daily work is in projects where the project team consists of different functions and competencies. The length of a project typically ranges from 6 months to 2 years. In the project, you work closely with electronics, firmware, and many other internal functions such as quality, testing, production, and purchasing. In the projects, you drive the mechanical development together with a few colleagues from concept study to mass production. These tasks include designing the product, creating prototypes, communicating with suppliers, verifying the product, and preparing the product for mass production. To optimize the production of the design, you also have close contact with our suppliers around the world. The portfolio includes both large and small projects, and several of the product types we develop are new to us, so unknown challenges and opportunities for variation are promised. In your work, you will also meet and work together with product managers, project leaders, line managers, and engineers from other departments and competencies. Who are you?We are looking for a team-oriented colleague with a positive mindset. You love challenges and working together with others. You are passionate about product development from the first idea to holding the product in your hand. You like to challenge old truths and develop new innovative products. You are considerate and value good communication. Finally, and most importantly, you love being part of a creative and happy team that delivers outstanding products!In our department, we work with both mechanical designs, electromechanics, and several different types of manufacturing methods. We would like you to have experience or a strong interest in some of these areas (new graduates are welcome to apply):     Knowledge of at least one 3D CAD system, preferably Creo.    Prototype creation    Mechanical engineering background    Windchill/Creo knowledge    Injection molding/diecast/sheet metal    Design for production    Product development in telecommunications (4G, 5G), Wi-Fi, or GPS    Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written. What can Axis offer you?A fantastic team with colleagues who want to succeed together with you. We learn and develop through our work with product development, and we are not afraid to try new things. Internal courses and external education are part of your work life here. From your first day, you will have a mentor colleague who helps you and teaches you how we work at Axis. Axis also has an excellent introduction program for new employees. We strive to give each individual great personal responsibility and opportunity to grow both as a person and professionally. You become part of a well-functioning team with engaged people who like going to work in the morning. We want you to thrive with us. Therefore, we offer fantastic benefits such as flexible working hours, morning coffee every day, Friday coffee, company bonus, health insurance, paid vacation, generous parental leave, generous sick/accident insurance, and your very own Axis bike - just to mention a few. What Axis has to offerWe are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You'll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance - and even your own Axis bicycle. To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis  Ready to act?If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Engineering Manager Maiko Karlsson at phone number 046-272 1800.We review applications continuously, so don't wait to send in your application!

title: HSEQ Manager

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in strengthening our safety culture, ensuring regulatory compliance and driving continuous improvement across our operations.The RoleAs HSEQ Manager, you will be responsible for supporting and developing HSEQ activities throughout ourSwedish operations. You will work closely with managers and employees to ensure compliance, manage risks, improve processes and promote the highest standards of safety, quality and environmental performance.Key Responsibilities    Promote and strengthen a positive safety culture throughout the organization.    Provide expert advice and support to managers and employees on HSEQ matters.    Conduct risk assessments and support risk management activities.    Monitor safety, quality and environmental performance through reporting and KPI analysis.    Lead and support investigations of incidents and non-conformities.    Plan, coordinate and participate in internal audits and inspections.    Maintain and improve quality and environmental management systems.    Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, company requirements and ISO standards.    Deliver HSEQ training and awareness initiatives.    Drive continuous improvement and share best practices across the business.About youTo succeed in this role, you are a proactive and collaborative professional who is passionate about safety and continuous improvement. You have strong communication skills and are comfortable working closely with both operational teams and management.Qualifications    Relevant degree or equivalent experience within Occupational Health & Safety, Quality or Environmental Management.    Minimum 4 years of experience in an HSE/HSEQ role.    Good knowledge of Swedish health and safety legislation.    Experience with ISO management systems, particularly ISO 9001 and ISO 14001.    Experience conducting audits, investigations and risk assessments.    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.    Aviation experience is considered an advantage.What we off er    A key role within an international aviation organization.    The opportunity to infl uence and improve safety culture and operational excellence.    Professional development opportunities.    A collaborative and supportive work environment.Avincis is one of the world’s leading operators in emergency aviation services and the largest in Europe. title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Why Doktor.seDoktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. Our 25-person engineering team has startup autonomy inside a profitable, international organization with 1,000+ employees and over 1B SEK in revenue.We run OpenAI and Anthropic models in production across patient and clinician workflows, and that footprint is growing fast.What you'll doOur infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:    Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.    Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.    Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.    Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.    Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.    Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.    Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.    You will report to to, and work close with, our Head of Product and Technology. You will be the go to person in technical strategical questions and the technical sounding board — advising on complex technical decisions and translating product/business direction into what's actually feasible.Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.What we're looking for    You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.    You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.    You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.    You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.    You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.    You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.    University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.Tech stackCloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKSIaC - TerraformCI/CD - GitHub ActionsLanguages - Python, TypeScriptAI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)What we offer    Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.    Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.    Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.    Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.    AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.    Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.Practical details    Start: As soon as we find the right person. We'll accommodate your notice period.    Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.    Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.    Language: English is our working language in tech. Swedish is a bonus.    Work permit: You must already have the right to work in Sweden.    Contact: Karin Bergström, Head of Product and technologyWe handle recruitment internally — no agencies, no consultants, no external recruiters.

title: Platschef till Actic Gävle Hemsta

un dispositif d'equity est prévu. *    Equity : environ 0,5 à 3 %, à confirmer, avec un vesting sur 5 ans : une première année sans vesting, puis 4 ans de vesting mensuel.LES ATOUTS DU POSTE *    Rejoindre l'entreprise au début de son développement commercial auprès des établissements hospitaliers. *    Bénéficier d'une participation au capital, avec un potentiel de valorisation lié au développement de l'entreprise. *    Avoir une forte influence sur le front et le mobile, à un stade où de nombreuses décisions restent à prendre. *    Travailler sur des sujets associant règles métier complexes, optimisation et parcours utilisateurs. *    Couvrir un périmètre large : React, Flutter, API, CI/CD et production. *    Contribuer à un produit qui vise à améliorer le quotidien des travailleurs postés, avec un retour direct des utilisateurs. *    Évoluer dans une petite équipe avec des circuits de décision courts.PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT *    Évaluation technique avec le CTO, éventuellement accompagné d'un ingénieur front. *    Échanges sur le parcours et les dimensions humaines avec les interlocuteurs produit et l'équipe. *    2 tours d'entretien, dont le second sur site : une demi-journée au bureau avec un déjeuner d'équipe. *    Mises en situation et questions techniques pendant les entretiens. *    Durée estimée : environ 2 semaines.COMPÉTENCES TECHNIQUESIndispensables : *    React, JavaScript / TypeScript. *    Flutter / Dart, ou une solide expérience mobile équivalente. *    Architecture front, gestion d'état et intégration d'API. *    API REST. *    Tests automatisés.Bonus : *    React Query ou un outil équivalent de gestion des données serveur. *    Flutter en production et publication d'applications mobiles. *    CI/CD et déploiements en production. *    Back en Python / Django. *

description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Product Owner H/F, 80-100%, CDI - Direction de l'Insertion et soutien opérationnel---Product Owner H/F, 80\-100%, CDI \- Direction de l'Insertion et soutien opérationnel===================================================================================== **Description de l'entreprise**   **A l'Hospice général, nous œuvrons pour le mieux vivre ensemble à Genève**Fondée en 1535 à Genève, notre institution accompagne les personnes qui, à un moment de leur vie, ont besoin d'un soutien le temps nécessaire pour (re)trouver une autonomie durable. Nous favorisons la réinsertion sociale et professionnelle des personnes à l'aide sociale, nous accueillons et hébergeons les personnes issues de l'asile que nous suivons dans leur parcours d'intégration. Enfin, nous participons à la lutte contre l'isolement des seniors.Nous sommes plus de 1' 600 collaboratrices et collaborateurs répartis sur 60 sites sur tout le territoire du canton. Nous accompagnons plus de 40' 000 personnes.En rejoignant notre institution, vous participerez à la réalisation de notre mission sociale, ancrée dans nos valeurs de collaboration, de respect, d'engagement et de bienveillance.Dans un contexte où nos équipes évoluent dans des domaines exigeants et en mutation constante, nous mettons un point d'honneur à leur proposer des conditions de travail stimulantes : nous visons la diversité et l'inclusion, nous valorisons l'intelligence collective, incitons aux échanges et à l'innovation et favorisons la prise d'initiative et l'expérimentation.   **Description du poste**   **Vos missions**Rattaché\-e directement à la directrice adjointe de l'ISO, référente stratégique, vous êtes l'interface entre les besoins métiers et les capacités technologiques.En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe produit Cœur de métier de la Direction des systèmes d'information et du numérique (DirSin), vous veillez à ce que les systèmes d'information répondent aux besoins opérationnels de la fonction, qu'ils soient exprimés au travers de projets ou de demandes d'évolution.  Dans le cadre du mandat qui vous est confié par la fonction, vous disposez de l'autonomie nécessaire pour arbitrer et prioriser les besoins et évolutions fonctionnelles de votre périmètre, en veillant à la cohérence avec les orientations stratégiques de l'ISO.Vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :1\. Maximiser la valeur du produit :* Recueillir, analyser, formaliser et arbitrer les besoins et initiatives métier en explicitant leurs objectifs, résultats attendus, valeur et impacts en cas de non\-réalisation ;* Challenger et prioriser les besoins du périmètre en fonction de leur valeur métier et des priorités de la fonction ;* Maintenir et prioriser le backlog des évolutions fonctionnelles en fonction de leur valeur métier, en coordination avec le gestionnaire de produit ;* Garantir la pertinence et la valeur ajoutée des évolutions envisagées ;* Suivre les indicateurs de satisfaction, d'usage et d'efficience des solutions et intégrer les exigences légales et réglementaires.2\. Assurer l'alignement stratégique :* Traduire les orientations stratégiques de la fonction en feuille de route produit et veiller à la cohérence avec les priorités métier ;* Veiller à la bonne gestion des priorités concernant la mise en place des applications et solutions technologiques dans le périmètre concerné ;* Apporter la vision et les priorités métier aux revues de la feuille de route pilotées par le gestionnaire de produit ;* Participer aux instances de gouvernance, comités de priorisation et revues de portefeuille.3\. Contribuer et participer à l'amélioration continue :* Définir les critères d'acceptation, mobiliser les utilisateurs concernés et assurer la validation métier des solutions livrées ;* Mesurer les résultats obtenus au regard des objectifs attendus et contribuer aux revues et rétrospectives d'amélioration continue.4\. Faciliter la communication et la collaboration :* Assurer une communication fluide entre les utilisateurs, les parties prenantes métier et l'équipe du produit Cœur de métier ;* Organiser et coordonner les phases de tests et de validation ;* Contribuer à l'accompagnement au le changement lié aux évolutions des solutions numériques.   **Qualifications**   **Votre profil*** Bachelor HES, diplôme universitaire ou formation jugée équivalente dans les systèmes d'information, la gestion de projets ou un domaine métier pertinent ;* Une certification ou formation complémentaire en gestion de projet ou méthodes agiles ( , PMP, Scrum, Agile) constitue un atout ;* Expérience confirmée d'au moins 3 ans dans l'identification, l'analyse et la formalisation de besoins métier ainsi que dans la priorisation d'évolutions fonctionnelles au sein d'un système d'information ;* Expérience dans la préparation et l'organisation de tests de validation ;* Pratique des méthodes agiles telles que Scrum ou Kanban ;* Une expérience dans une organisation publique, parapublique ou institutionnelle constitue un avantage ;* Excellente capacité d'analyse et de synthèse ;* Aptitude à négocier, influencer et fédérer sans lien hiérarchique direct ;* Solides compétences de communication avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques ;* Bonne compréhension des enjeux de gouvernance des systèmes d'information ;* Connaissance des réglementations relatives à la protection des données et à la sécurité de l'information (LPD, RGPD, LIPAD) ;* Des connaissances du contexte et de l'environnement de l'Hospice général sont un atout ;* çais : excellente maîtrise orale et écrite ;* Anglais : bonnes connaissances professionnelles.   **Informations supplémentaires**   **Nous vous proposons*** Une culture d'entreprise ouverte et respectueuse ;* Un développement continu des compétences grâce à une politique de formation attractive ;* Des opportunités d'évolution de carrière et de mobilité interne ;* De nombreuses activités culturelles et sportives à vivre en collectif au sein de l'institution.Taux d'activité : 80\-100%Type de contrat : CDIClasse de fonction : 18Entrée en fonction : Dès que possibleDélai de postulation : 24\.10\.2026 **Notre processus de recrutement**Il se déroule en plusieurs phases selon le type de poste, où chaque étape conditionne la suivante : analyse de candidature, entretien téléphonique, entretiens de recrutement avec la hiérarchie et les ressources humaines et le cas échéant, test métier et/ou évaluation type assessement pour les postes de management et certains postes spécifiques. **Ce poste vous intéresse ?**Le service de recrutement de l'Hospice général se réjouit de recevoir votre candidature complète (lettre de motivation, CV, diplôme de plus haut niveau de formation atteint, certificats de travail). Pour des raisons d'optimisation du suivi des candidatures, nous vous invitons à postuler uniquement en ligne via notre espace carrière, LinkedIN ou JobUp, en réponse à une offre d'emploi spécifique. Les candidatures papier et mail ne seront pas prises en considération. ![Hospice général]( )* Cour de Rive 12 1204 Genève** ![Hospice général]( )* Cour de Rive 12 1204 Genève** jid5f43bf8jm jit1042jm jiy26jm

description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Business Analyste / Chef de projet Odoo (H/F) 100 %---Business Analyste / Chef de projet Odoo (H/F) 100 %=================================================== *Entreprise familiale active dans toute la Suisse, acteur incontournable de la distribution de vins et de boissons aussi bien aux privés qu'aux professionnels, le Groupe Alloboissons englobe une société de distribution de boissons (Alloboissons), un club de vin (DIVO), une chaîne de magasins spécialisés (Halle aux Boissons) et une société de négoce de vins (Les Vins ).* *Notre succès est avant tout dû au formidable travail de nos 184 collaborateurs qui s'activent au quotidien, sur 14 sites distincts, pour viser l'excellence de nos services. Le tout dans une démarche de dynamique participative où chacun peut et doit prendre sa place pour le bien de l'entreprise.* *Afin de renforcer notre équipe informatique, nous recherchons au plus vite (mais nous sommes prêts à attendre quelque peu si vous êtes la bonne personne) pour notre siège de Givisiez :* *Afin de faciliter la lecture, le masculin est utilisé dans cette annonce. Le poste est ouvert à toute personne, quel que soit son genre.*  Business Analyste / Chef de projet Odoo (H/F) 100 %===================================================Notre ERP Odoo est le cœur opérationnel du Groupe : il orchestre l’ensemble des processus liés à la distribution, aux magasins, au négoce et au e\-commerce. En tant que business analyste et chef de projet, vous faites le lien entre les métiers et l’équipe IT. Vous transformez les besoins de nos 184 utilisateurs en solutions concrètes et vous pilotez les projets qui font évoluer notre ERP. **Votre environnement technique*** Odoo 16 à 20 hébergé on\-premise, 184 utilisateurs actifs  * Une équipe IT composée de : 1 business analyste, 3 développeurs, 2 supports (applicatifs/infrastructure), 2 apprentis.  * Vous rapportez au responsable informatique du Groupe Alloboissons   **Vos premiers défis***  **Fiabiliser notre reporting :** Recenser les besoins des métiers, définir des indicateurs clairs et partagés, puis accompagner la construction des tableaux de bord dont ils ont besoin chaque jour, sans passer par un export Excel.  *  **Remettre le standard au centre :** Revoir nos processus à la lumière du standard Odoo, challenger les demandes de développement spécifique et accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’adoption des bonnes pratiques.  *  **Conduire la migration Odoo 16 vers Odoo 20 :** Piloter le volet fonctionnel et organisationnel du projet, de l’analyse des écarts entre versions aux recettes avec les métiers, jusqu’à la formation des utilisateurs et au basculement en production. Le chantier le plus visible de votre première année.   **Vos missions***  **Analyser les besoins :** animer des ateliers avec les métiers (vente, logistique, magasins, achats, finance, etc.), cartographier les processus et identifier les axes d’amélioration.  *  **Concevoir les solutions :** rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles, privilégier le paramétrage standard d’Odoo et arbitrer avec les développeurs lorsque du spécifique est nécessaire.  *  **Piloter les projets :** planifier, prioriser et suivre les projets de bout en bout (périmètre, délais, budget, risques) et coordonner les intervenants internes et les partenaires externes.  *  **Garantir la qualité :** préparer et conduire les recettes avec les utilisateurs clés et valider les livrables avant mise en production.  *  **Collaborer :** travailler en synergie avec les développeurs (traduire les besoins métiers en solutions), le support (remontées du terrain, bugs et ergonomie) et la direction (priorités et arbitrages).  *  **Former et accompagner le changement :** rédiger la documentation utilisateur, former les équipes internes et assurer l’adoption des nouvelles fonctionnalités.  *  **Assurer la veille fonctionnelle :** suivre les évolutions d’Odoo et proposer les améliorations de processus qui en découlent.   **Votre profil*** Plusieurs années d’expérience comme business analyste, consultant fonctionnel ou chef de projet ERP, idéalement sur Odoo.  * Vous maîtrisez les principaux modules d’Odoo (logistique, ventes, achats, comptabilité, point de vente, etc.) et vous savez tirer le meilleur du standard avant de recourir au spécifique.  * Vous avez déjà mené des projets ERP de bout en bout, du recueil des besoins à la mise en production, avec des méthodes de gestion de projet éprouvées (agiles ou classiques).  * Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données : vous savez définir un indicateur, vérifier un chiffre et challenger un rapport.  * Vous savez écouter les métiers, reformuler leurs besoins et expliquer les contraintes techniques, avec pédagogie et diplomatie.  * Organisé et rigoureux, vous faites avancer plusieurs projets en parallèle sans perdre de vue les priorités.  * Langues : français courant ; l'allemand et l'anglais sont un atout.   **Un plus*** Expérience de migration entre versions majeures d'Odoo.  * Certification fonctionnelle Odoo ou certification en gestion de projet (Scrum, PMP, etc.).  * Notions de SQL ou d’outils de BI pour analyser les données.  * Connaissance du secteur de la distribution, de la logistique ou du retail.   **Ce que nous offrons*** Un ERP au centre de l'entreprise et une vraie latitude pour décider comment il évolue.  * Une entreprise familiale où les décisions se prennent vite, sans strates hiérarchiques.  * 1 jour de télétravail par semaine.  * 5 semaines de vacances.  * Formation continue et certification Odoo prises en charge.  * Des rabais collaborateurs sur l'ensemble de notre assortiment de vins et de boissons.  Chez Alloboissons, nous croyons qu'un bon système informatique, c'est avant tout une équipe soudée, curieuse et tournée vers l'avenir. Si vous partagez cet état d'esprit, **rejoignez\-nous !** **Nos valeurs :** bienveillance – intégrité – engagement – respect – esprit d'équipe **Intéressé ?** Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation et diplômes, etc.). Les postulations doivent nous être transmises uniquement via JobUp.  ![Alloboissons SA]( )* Rte du Tir Fédéral 18 1762 Givisiez** ![Alloboissons SA]( )* Rte du Tir Fédéral 18 1762 Givisiez** jid413a3fcjm jit1041jm jiy26jm

title: Primary French Teacher
description: Primary School Teacher: French as a Second Language (FSL)  Professeur de français Langue étrangère (FLE)  Full\-time (100 %)Closing date for applications: 6th November 2026  Role start date: **11th January 2027****Applicants must have a valid Swiss work permit or an EU passport in additional to a recognised teaching qualification****Job Context:**  French teachers at Geneva English School fulfil a crucial role in our school community and the education of our pupils. The Primary French department takes responsibility for the French academic and pastoral needs of the children and are the first point of contact for parents about French. They work closely with class teachers, learning assistants and the leadership team, planning together and sharing ideas. At Geneva English School French is a considered a core subject in the curriculum, with Primary school pupils taught French in levelled ability groups. Close collaboration is encouraged, and we look for links to integrate French across different areas of the Primary curriculum.Key Tasks and Responsibilities:? Teach the lessons assigned to you, from Reception to Year 6, planning appropriately to meet the needs of all pupils, making effective use of resources, and securing the highest possible standards of learning and achievement.  ? Take an active role in the pastoral care of all pupils in the class, monitoring behaviour, relationships, personal and social development.  ? Promote through encouragement and a positive approach the general welfare of the class to ensure that the social and academic needs of the pupils are met.  ? Encourage the social and cultural development of all pupils.  ? Establish professional and effective communication with parents, reporting to them formally and informally on the development, progress and attainment of pupils.  ? Show commitment to and be actively involved in extracurricular activities and in the wider life of the School.  ? Act in accordance with the policies of the School and in particular with the principles laid down in the Staff Handbook, Staff Code of Conduct and Safeguarding \& Child Protection Policy.  Essential Experience and Qualifications:  ? Experience, in a school context, of teaching French as a foreign language (FLE) to children aged 5\-11 years old.  ? A caring and compassionate approach to teaching ensuring every child fulfils their individual potential  ? Excellent command of both spoken and written French and English  ? Ability to work in a way that ensures the safety and well\-being of children  ? Excellent communication skills with colleagues, pupils and parents 1  ? Enthusiasm, creativity, independence, drive to demonstrate a real passion for teaching, training and learning to the highest standards  ? An undergraduate degree qualification  ? An international recognised teaching qualification  ? Valid Swiss work permit or European/Swiss passport How to apply: Please apply by submitting a letter of application and a copy of your CV via the advertisement on JobUp.In your application letter you should outline your professional impact in the classroom and how you fulfil the job description and person specification. Due to the large number of applications we get for every role, it may not be possible to contact every candidate but we thank you in advance for your interest in our school.  Safer Recruitment: GES is committed to equalities, safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Médecin adjoint-e---Médecin adjoint\-e===================Vous aimeriez contribuer au développement du canton de Fribourg, avez l'esprit du service public, et cherchez un poste varié qui fait sens ? A l'Etat de Fribourg vous travaillerez pour le plus grand employeur du canton. A l'écoute, dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, l'administration cantonale, et ses établissements, sont au service de la population fribourgeoise.Médecin adjoint\-e=================== **Qui sommes\-nous?**Le Réseau fribourgeois de santé mentale (RFSM) est rattaché à la Direction de la santé et des affaires sociales (DSAS). Le RFSM est un pôle de compétences médicales, infirmières et psychosociales spécialisé en santé mentale. Le RFSM recherche, pour son Secteur hospitalier de psychiatrie et psychothérapie de la personne âgée, **un\-e médecin adjoint\-e**. Dans le cadre de cette fonction de médecin cadre et sous la responsabilité du médecin directeur du secteur, vous participez activement à la conduite clinique, au développement des prestations et au fonctionnement du secteur. Le RFSM emploie 800 personnes et reste une institution à taille humaine avec une ambiance de travail chaleureuse et bienveillante. Fribourg est un canton de 350 000 habitants doté d'une université accueillant 11 000 étudiants. Marsens est situé à 50 km de Lausanne et à 30 km de Berne et dispose d'un parc immobilier non saturé avec des loyers bien inférieurs aux cantons de Vaud et Genève. **Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**L'Etat\-employeur encourage la conciliation vie professionnelle et vie privée et offre un environnement et des conditions de travail attractifs à ses collaborateur\-trice\-s. Pour en savoir plus, suivez ce .  **Avantages RFSM : Affilié à Swibeco \- Promotion de la santé \- \- Rabais Nestlé Shop \- Cours de langues interne** **Label ISFM / Family score 2026\-2028 / Entreprise formatrice** **Vos missions*** Assurer la responsabilité médicale et clinique des entités qui vous sont confiées et veiller à la qualité ainsi qu'à la continuité des prises en charge* Participer à la conduite, à l'organisation et à la coordination des activités médicales du secteur, en collaboration étroite avec le médecin directeur et les autres cadres* Garantir la cohérence du cadre thérapeutique et contribuer à l'élaboration, à l'application et à l'évolution des concepts de prise en charge* Soutenir et superviser les médecins chefs de clinique et médecins assistants dans leur activité clinique* Participer activement à la formation postgraduée des médecins et, selon les besoins, aux activités d'enseignement du RFSM* Favoriser une prise en charge interdisciplinaire et interprofessionnelle, en collaboration avec les équipes soignantes, psychologiques, sociales et thérapeutiques* Développer la collaboration avec les partenaires du réseau sanitaire, médico\-social et ambulatoire afin d'assurer des parcours de soins coordonnés pour les patients âgés* Participer au développement de nouvelles prestations, de nouveaux concepts thérapeutiques et aux projets d'amélioration de la qualité du secteur* Contribuer aux activités institutionnelles du RFSM et assurer, sur délégation, des représentations du secteur auprès des partenaires internes et externes* Participer au dispositif de référence médicale selon l'organisation en vigueur au sein du RFSM **Profil souhaité*** Diplôme fédéral de médecin ou titre reconnu par la MEBEKO* Titre de spécialiste FMH title: Project Quality Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
description: The opportunity Join our international project organization and  drive quality across large and complex projects. In this role, you will work closely with project teams, customers, suppliers, and site organizations to ensure that quality requirements are understood, implemented, and continuously improved. You will act as a trusted quality partner to the Project Manager, helping the team achieve project objectives, manage risks, and deliver a high level of customer satisfaction. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines technical quality expertise with strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the confidence to influence stakeholders across a global matrix organization. How you’ll make an impact Plan, organize, lead, and monitor quality-related project activities, resources, objectives, KPIs, and deliverables Develop, implement, and maintain the Project Quality Plan and ensure compliance with contractual requirements and the ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System Collaborate closely with project teams, suppliers, site organizations, and other key stakeholders Lead and follow up on project quality audits, non-conformances, corrective actions, lessons learned, quality risks, and continuous improvement activities Monitor and report relevant quality indicators, including non-conformance reports, customer complaint resolution, cost of poor quality, project savings, and customer satisfaction Coordinate quality requirements for critical equipment, including supplier documentation, Inspection and Test Plans, Master Test Plans, inspections, and shipment-release reviews Support site quality activities, including training, audits, inspections, documentation handover, and project close-out Promote a strong quality culture and use structured problem-solving and lean methodologies to improve quality throughout project execution Your background Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related field; a master’s degree is an advantage At least five years of professional experience in EPC project quality management within a large and complex organization; experience in the power, energy, renewable energy, or oil and gas sectors is preferred Sound knowledge of ISO 9001; internal-auditor certification is considered an advantage Good understanding on SAP Quality Module as well as  project and risk management; knowledge of PMI methodologies or CAPM-PMI certification is beneficial Experience with supplier and site quality processes, including Inspection and Test Plans, PPAP, inspections, testing procedures, punch lists, mechanical completion, and lessons learned Knowledge of quality and problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, root cause analysis, PDCA, 5 Why, Lean Six Sigma, and FMEA Excellent English communication skills, combined with a structured, proactive, solution-oriented, and collaborative working style; German or other additional languages are an advantage Confidence working in an international matrix environment and willingness to travel to project construction sites and supplier locations when required More about us  Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

description: Ref 2586476 \\\| Date: 20 Oct 2026 !\[AIGLON COLLEGE SA\]( ) \*\*Aiglon College\*\* seeks to appoint a suitably qualified \*\*Head of Junior Curriculum \\\& Academics (Up to Year 8\\)\*\* to join the school from: \*\*August 2027\*\* \*\*Your profile\*\* The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification. Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application. \*\*About us\*\* Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not\\-for\\-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world\\-class education in a stunning alpine setting. The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom. There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes. \*\*What we offer\*\* Aiglon is dedicated to the well\\-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages. \*\*How to apply\*\* Deadline for applications: Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered. \*\*Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.\*\* \*\*Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.\*\* You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School's \[Privacy Notice\](\< \>). JOB PURPOSE Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 500 students aged 5\\-18 representing 65 nations. In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The Junior School is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the Senior School with a dedicated focus on students up to Year 8\\. The school wishes to appoint, for August 2027 (possibly January or April 2027 for the right candidate), an innovative and dynamic Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics (Up to Year 8\\) who will take a whole school role in leading the educational provision of the Junior School and the inspirational 'wonder' curriculum for students up to Years 6 including Mountain School. The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced Junior/Prep school specialist with leadership experience, ideally in an international setting, who has expertise in the creation and implementation of junior specific curriculum programmes. A knowledge of project based learning, inquiry based learning or biophilic education would be preferable. This position involves a teaching component but this is a unique opportunity to introduce, develop and promote a world leading junior curriculum. KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES \* To put the students first. \* To lead the junior school and the educational provision, deputising for the Director of Junior school when required and being a key member of the Junior School Leadership Team. \* To take a lead role in establishing and implementing a vision for world\\-class education at Aiglon. \* To work with the Director of Junior School and to ensure that an Aiglon student's education is relevant, broad, balanced and effective across all aspects of school life. \* To carry out tasks as delegated by the Director of Junior School and Deputy School Director (Academics) to the planning, monitoring and promotion of academic and student welfare matters. \* To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff Leadership Team, including the Academic Leadership Group. \* Be involved in discipline matters and ensure students behave appropriately and in line with the school's expectations. \* To line manage and work in close partnership with the Head of Year (Up to Year 4\\) (who directly manages the teachers and teaching assistants in these year groups and the Mountain School for those years), maintaining oversight across curriculum implementation, pastoral care, and operational leadership for the lower junior years, as well as line managing Year 5\\-6 classroom teachers. \* To liaise closely with Assistant Heads and Heads of Department in the senior school to ensure that the curriculum for Years 7 and 8 is exciting, dynamic, and of a high standard, effectively preparing students for IGCSE and IB programmes. \* To ensure the Guiding Principles are embedded throughout the school, and specifically within the provision for junior school students. \* To be actively involved in staff recruitment as required by the School Director and Director of Junior School. \* To be a teacher with a reduced teaching load (approx 50%). \* To embrace innovative forms of assessment and holistic reporting. Responsibility for the Wellbeing and Safeguarding of Students \* To lead strategic interventions for junior school students and ensure consistent tracking of student progress from an academic point of view. \* To appreciate the key role of safeguarding in managing student interventions and work closely with the Director of Junior School and wellbeing team to ensure all students are supported. \* To work with the Director of Junior School, Deputy School Director (Pastoral) and Junior School DSL in the implementation of policies and statements of good practice for safeguarding, wellbeing and health care. \* To ensure there is a comprehensive Wellbeing curriculum that is sequential through all years up to Year 8 and links with the Years 9\\-13 programmes. \* To work with the Deputy School Director (Pastoral) to help ensure Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are taught formally within the Spirit Curriculum to help promote a positive, kind and inclusive culture at school. \* To develop service opportunities for junior students within a structured service programme. \* To liaise with the Director of Junior School, Director of Character and Junior Activities Coordinator to help ensure there is a challenging co\\-curricular programme in place that includes activities, sports and expeditions for the junior school. Academic Responsibilities \* To manage and develop the Junior curriculum (Up to Year 8\\) at Aiglon. \* To work closely with the Head of Junior Expeditions and the Head of Years (Up to Year 4\\) to plan, deliver, and oversee an experiential Mountain Curriculum spanning up to Year 6\\. \* To champion sustainability, environmental stewardship, and biophilic education within the junior curriculum and Mountain School programme. \* To ensure the Guiding Principles for learning are embedded throughout the academic side of the school as a member of the Academic Leadership Group (ALG) \* To take the lead on overseeing junior cohorts and courses. une expérience avec CARL Source / CARL Software est fortement appréciée, ServiceNow constituant également un atout.* Posséder de bonnes connaissances des bases de données et des outils de reporting ou de Business Intelligence tels que BIRT, WEBI ou Power BI.* Justifier d'une expérience en gestion de projets fonctionnels, rédaction de spécifications, animation d'ateliers multidisciplinaires, tests, recettes et coordination avec des éditeurs ou fournisseurs.* Faire preuve de capacités d'analyse, de structuration et de communication permettant d'interagir efficacement avec les métiers, les équipes IT et les partenaires externes ; une connaissance des environnements industriels, techniques ou aéroportuaires est appréciée. **Notre proposition** * Conditions de travail avantageuses : 6 semaines de vacances par an et un plan de prévoyance attractif* Développement et mise en valeur du potentiel : vaste gamme de formations professionnelles et personnelles proposées par l'Académie Bechtle*   Diversité : des tâches intéressantes et changeantes dans un secteur tourné vers l'avenirNuméro d'emploi : BYLXK342  \| \|  Bechtle Suisse SA-----------------Bechtle Suisse SA dispose de compétences certifiées dans les domaines stratégiques : Infrastructure IT, Virtualisation, Information Management, Managed Services, Skills Management, Data\& Analytics, Printing Solutions et E\-Commerce. Grâce à ces compétences et à de solides et durables partenariats avec les principaux acteurs du marché, nous proposons une gamme modulaire et parfaitement cohérente de produits et de services pour couvrir l'ensemble des besoins de nos clients.  Notre proximité, notre vision globale de l'infrastructure et de la gestion de projets font de nous un acteur incontournable du marché.
