title: Key Account Manager OOH
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Key Account Manager OOH---Key Account Manager OOH=======================Be a part of Nestlé. Be a force for good.Help us make a real difference on a global scale. With a presence in almost 185 countries, we're dedicated to our purpose of unlocking the power of food and beverages to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. Whether you're starting or continuing your career, explore how you can work with us.Key Account Manager OOH======================= **Location and work model:** Home\-based position in Switzerland, with regular travel to visit clients across the country and regular visits in our head office in La Tour\-De\-Peilz   **Contract type / duration:** Permanent   **Activity rate:** 80\-100%    **Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet**As a Key Account Manager at Nestlé Professional, your mission is to acquire, develop and strategically manage key accounts across the out\-of\-home food and beverage channel, delivering sustainable sales growth and profitability through tailored culinary and beverage solutions. You'll make a difference by identifying new business opportunities and building trusted partnerships with customers, operators and distributors, in close collaboration with , Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain teams. This is an opportunity to combine strategic account leadership with an entrepreneurial and consultative approach in a dynamic market.  **How you'll make an impact as a** **Key Account Manager** * Developing existing and new out\-of\-home key accounts by translating customer, channel and market insights into tailored growth opportunities* Identifying and converting new business opportunities across out\-of\-home foodservice environments* Building trusted relationships with customers, operators and distributors to co\-create culinary, coffee and beverage solutions that respond to their operational and commercial needs* Leading consultative commercial discussions and business reviews that strengthen customer performance, profitability and long\-term partnerships* Using distributor networks and cross\-functional expertise to expand Nestlé Professional's presence and bring customer solutions successfully to market* Acting with an entrepreneurial mindset, taking ownership from opportunity identification through implementation and measurable commercial results   **What will make you successful*** Bringing solid key account management and business development experience in foodservice, HoReCa or another out\-of\-home environment* Understanding the out\-of\-home ecosystem, including the role of operators, distributors and different foodservice channels, and using these insights to identify growth opportunities* Applying consultative and solution\-based selling, commercial planning and negotiation capabilities to create tailored customer propositions and sustainable value* Demonstrating a strong hunting mindset and the ability to acquire new customers while developing long\-term strategic partnerships* Communicating fluently in and French. English is a plus.* Working with autonomy, commercial curiosity and resilience, while collaborating across functions to turn opportunities into measurable results and shared value   **At** **Nestlé,**  **we place people at the heart of everything we do** Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life: * Paid holidays beyond legal requirements* Learning and development opportunities to grow your career* Performance based bonus* Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program* Strong employer contribution to your pension plan* Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions* Attractive employee discounts across various products and services   **What to expect from our hiring process** We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone. The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.  *Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.*  **Ready to Be a Force for ?** Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.******jid8a2c9e9jm jit1043jm jiy26jm

title: Infirmier responsable de site
description: À la Fondation Belle Saison, reconnue d’intérêt public, nous avons une mission claire : offrir un accompagnement humain, respectueux et innovant à ceux qui en ont le plus besoin. Présente sur tout le territoire de La Côte, notre Fondation regroupe 5 établissements médico\-sociaux (EMS), 4 centres d’accueil temporaire (CAT) et 3 structures de logements adaptés avec accompagnement (LADA) , offrant un éventail de services adaptés à chaque situation.Chez nous, Respect, Écoute et Communication se vivent au quotidien. Nous agissons avec réactivité pour répondre aux urgences ; nous visons la performance pour assurer la qualité, et nous cultivons innovation et créativité pour inventer les solutions de demain.Rejoindre la Fondation Belle Saison, c’est intégrer une équipe engagée, solidaire et motivée par une seule ambition : améliorer chaque jour la vie de nos bénéficiaires.Pour compléter ses équipes, la Fondation Belle Saison recherche un **Infirmier responsable de site** pour l’un de ses établissements médico\-sociaux dans la région de La Côte.Sous la supervision de la Directrice des soins et de l’accompagnement et de l’Adjoint de votre pôle, vous assurez le bon fonctionnement quotidien de l’établissement et la qualité des soins et de l’accompagnement.Par votre présence sur le terrain et votre leadership de proximité, vous fédérez les équipes et coordonnez les différents secteurs du site, en collaboration étroite avec leurs responsables. Vous veillez à un accompagnement personnalisé, respectueux des résidents et ouvert à leurs proches.**Infirmier responsable de site**  **Activités principales :*** Assurer la mise en œuvre des orientations institutionnelles et du concept d’accompagnement;* Coordonner les secteurs soins, hôtellerie, cuisine, socio\-culturel et technique, et animer les échanges interdisciplinaires;* Encadrer l’équipe des soins, soutenir les collaborateurs et contribuer à un climat de travail respectueux;* Superviser l’organisation des soins, les projets de vie et la tenue des dossiers informatisés;* Suivre les indicateurs cliniques, mettre en œuvre les actions correctives et veiller au respect des standards de qualité et de sécurité;* Développer une relation de confiance avec les résidents et leurs proches, conduire les entretiens de famille à l’admission et accompagner les situations sensibles;* Collaborer avec les médecins et les autres partenaires de l’accompagnement;* Participer à l’élaboration des plannings;* Contribuer aux recrutements, aux évaluations et à l’identification des besoins de formation, et veiller à la qualité de l’encadrement des étudiants, apprentis et stagiaires;* Veiller à une utilisation adéquate des ressources et au bon fonctionnement du matériel médical;* Participer aux projets de la Fondation;* Management participatif par au travers d’une présence active au sein de son équipe.**Vous possédez :*** Diplôme d’infirmier HES ou diplôme étranger reconnu par la Croix\-Rouge suisse ;* Expérience professionnelle d’au moins 5 ans, avec expérience de la conduite d’équipe d’au moins 2 ans ;* Formation de cadre intermédiaire au minimum; (ex: CAS, brevet fédéral en gestion d’équipe)* Une pratique auprès d’une population âgée (EMS/CMS) en Suisse ;* Compétences avérées en leadership et capacité à superviser et piloter la qualité des prestations en interdisciplinarité ;* Bonnes connaissances et maitrises des outils informatiques et du français (à l’oral et à l’écrit) ;* Formations PLAISIR® / PLEX® / Formateur en entreprise / CAS\-DAS utile à la fonction (PAA, gériatrie), un atout ;* Permis de conduire et voiture indispensable ;* Domicile privé à 35 minutes maximum d’un de nos sites (en cas de service de piquets).**Nous offrons :*** Un cadre de travail dynamique;* Un concept d’accompagnement favorisant la créativité et le développement des compétences professionnelles et interdisciplinaires ;* Rémunération attractive, conforme à la CCT SAN Vaudoise ;* Des possibilités de formation continue, dans une Fondation formatrice qui soutient activement le développement des compétences ;* Parking disponible sur chaque site, à petit prix ;* Un crédit mensuel offert pour vos consommations dans nos cafétérias ;* Repas à des tarifs très avantageux ;* Plan mobilité durable :    + Participation au demi\-tarif CFF,    + Participation à l'abonnement mensuel ou annuel des transports publics,    + Subvention à l'achat d'un vélo électrique,* Participation financière sur vos abonnements (fitness, yoga, pilates, tennis, etc.) ;* Caisse de pension performante et avantageuse, pour préparer sereineme j4id10447229jm j4it1043jm j4iy26jm

title: Assistant social en EMS

missions temporaires un\-e **Assistant\-e social\-e****.****Assistant\-e social\-e en EMS***  ### Votre mission :    + Accompagnement social individualisé des résidents et de leurs proches    + Évaluation de la situation sociale, administrative et financière des bénéficiaires    + Gestion et suivi des démarches administratives liées à l’entrée, au séjour et à la sortie des résidents    + Information, conseil et orientation vers les ressources sociales, juridiques et médico\-sociales adaptées    + Coordination avec le réseau socio\-sanitaire, les familles, les assurances et les institutions partenaires    + Soutien dans les démarches liées aux assurances sociales (AVS, AI, prestations complémentaires, aides financières, etc.)    + Accompagnement lors de situations complexes ou de vulnérabilité sociale    + Participation à l’élaboration et au suivi des projets d’accompagnement individualisés    + Contribution au maintien de l’autonomie, de la qualité de vie et de l’intégration sociale des résidents    + Participation aux réunions interdisciplinaires et aux réflexions d’équipe    + Collaboration à l’amélioration continue des prestations et au bon fonctionnement de l’établissement    + Tenue et mise à jour des dossiers administratifs et sociaux ### Compétences requises :    + Bachelor HES en Travail social ou titre jugé équivalent    + Expérience confirmée dans un poste similaire, idéalement auprès d’un public âgé ou vulnérable    + Connaissance du réseau socio\-sanitaire suisse et des assurances sociales    + Expérience dans l’accompagnement de personnes en situation de fragilité ou de dépendance    + Maîtrise des démarches administratives et des dispositifs d’aide sociale    + Expérience souhaitée dans la gestion administrative des résidents en EMS ou expérience administrative au sein d’un établissement de soins palliatifs ou d’une structure médico\-sociale similaire    + Capacité à gérer des situations complexes avec professionnalisme et discrétion    + Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles et administratives    + Sens de l’organisation, autonomie et rigueur    + Aptitude au travail interdisciplinaire et en réseau    + Excellente maîtrise du français (oral et écrit)    + Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques et de la suite MS Office ### Votre profil :    + Professionnel·le engagé·e, bienveillant·e et à l’écoute    + Excellentes capacités relationnelles et sens du contact humain    + Empathie et capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance    + Sens des responsabilités et respect de la interdisciplinaire    + Flexibilité, adaptabilité et résistance au stress    + Intérêt marqué pour l’accompagnement des personnes âgées ou fragilisées    + Motivation à contribuer à un environnement de travail humain, respectueux et de qualité ### Nous vous offrons :    + Une mission de plusieurs mois avec possibilité d’embauche à terme    + La possibilité d’intégrer directement un poste fixe title: ICLS - Infirmier clinicien spécialisé
description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: ICLS - Infirmier clinicien spécialisé (H/F)---ICLS \- Infirmier clinicien spécialisé (H/F)==============================================Nos centres Médico\-Sociaux (CMS) offrent à la population Lausannoise des prestations pluridisciplinaires de qualité et leurs interventions reposent sur des valeurs d’humanité et d’équité.En rejoignant la **Fondation Soins Lausanne,** vous vous engagez de manière concrète en faveur de la santé et du bien\-vivre dans le canton de Vaud, au sein d’équipes expertes, motivées et enthousiastes, dans une activité variée et riche en contacts humains.Sur le terrain, vous intervenez sur le lieu de vie ou d’activité des bénéficiaires. Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Faisant partie d’une équipe soudée et soutenante, l’exercice de ces métiers permet une grande autonomie mais nécessite de grandes responsabilités et une flexibilité de la part de nos collaborateurs. **Notre service des prestations** a pour mission de garantir la mise en œuvre des prestations d’aide et de soins à domicile pour assurer à chaque client un accompagnement coordonné et intégré afin de respecter son projet de vie à domicile. C'est au sein de cette structure que nous recherchons **de suite ou à convenir** un/e:ICLS \- Infirmier clinicien spécialisé (H/F)==============================================Taux d'activité à 80%Contrat fixe à durée indéterminée  **Votre mission**Vous exercez un rôle d'expert clinique auprès des client·e·s et de leurs proches, au service du projet de vie à domicile. Votre pratique s'appuie sur les données probantes. Pratique clinique et raisonnement expert* Évaluer et gérer les situations complexes par un raisonnement clinique expert  * Adapter les soins aux besoins, valeurs et contexte de la personne, dans une vision populationnelle.  * Contribuer à la promotion de la santé et à la prévention.   Soutien aux équipes* Accompagner les équipes dans les situations complexes (consultation, guidance, coaching, supervision)  * Diffuser les bonnes pratiques et renforcer les compétences des soignant·e·s  * Superviser la documentation clinique et intégrer les nouveaux collaborateurs   Innovation et changement* Piloter des projets d'amélioration continue et d'innovation  * Guider l'implantation des nouvelles pratiques et favoriser l'adhésion des équipes   Collaboration et coordination* Favoriser un travail d'équipe coordonné, en intra et en interprofessionnel  * Renforcer la collaboration avec les partenaires du réseau  * Consolider le partenariat avec le·la client·e et ses proches   Données probantes et qualité* Garantir des interventions fondées sur les données actualisées, adaptées au domicile  * Participer aux protocoles, à l'analyse des évènements indésirables et au suivi des indicateurs  * Contribuer au développement des sciences infirmières en soins à domicile   Éthique* Promouvoir la réflexion éthique dans les pratiques cliniques et institutionnelles    **Votre profil et vos compétences*** Bachelor en soins infirmiers (ou titre jugé équivalent)  *  **Master** en sciences infirmières obligatoire  * Expérience confirmée dans le domaine médico\-social, la santé communautaire et la pratique clinique  * Excellentes capacités d’évaluation clinique et de gestion des situations complexes  * Aptitude avérée à travailler en collaboration interdisciplinaire, avec les partenaires et les réseaux  * Sens des responsabilités, esprit d’initiative et capacité à s'organiser de manière autonome et à fixer des priorités  * Aptitude à créer un climat de confiance et d’échange au sein d’une équipe  * Capacité confirmée à la gestion de projet    **Nous offrons*** Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant  * Un environnement de travail qui privilégie le contact humain et l'échange  * Un travail passionnant dans un cadre agréable pour le bien\-être des clients  * Des conditions de travail et de rémunération équitables  * Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi    **Les avantages de nous rejoindre*** Plan d’intégration par métier, offres de formations continues riches et variées, possibilités d’évolution professionnelle  * L'équité salariale entre femmes et hommes (certification Fair\-ON\-Pay)  * Rémunération selon la Convention Collective de Travail (CCT) du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois  * Offres avantageuses avec tarifs préférentiels dans des sociétés de services autour du sport, santé et bien\-être et loisirs divers  * Politique de mobilité douce et participation aux frais de transports publics  * Cinq semaines de vacances par année et six semaines dès 50 ans   Monsieur se tient à votre disposition pour tout renseignement au .Pour un traitement de qualité de votre candidature, nous vous prions d'adresser un **dossier de candidature complet** via Jobup jusqu'au **27 octobre 2026\.** Le service des Ressources Humaines se fera un plaisir de vous répondre dans les meilleurs délais.****** jidaf81511jm jit1042jm jiy26jm

title: Un·e Assistant·e social·e pour le CMS de Terre-Sainte
description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Un·e Assistant·e social·e pour le CMS de Terre-Sainte---Un·e Assistant·e social·e pour le CMS de Terre\-Sainte========================================================= **Votre profil*** Titulaire d'un diplôme d'une école sociale reconnue type HES (filière travail social avec orientation en service social), EESP\-Ecole d'études sociales et pédagogiques Suisse, Bachelor en travail social ou titre jugé équivalent  * Bonnes connaissances des assurances sociales et du réseau médico\-social vaudois  * Capacité à s’organiser de manière autonome et facilité d’adaptation  * Capacités d’écoute et de négociation  * Permis de conduire indispensable   **Votre petit \+*** Connaissance du domaine des soins à domicile  * Expérience d’au moins 5 ans dans le domaine médico\-social   **Vos futures missions*** Vous accompagnez les patients et leurs proches pour effectuer des démarches spécifiques et complexes dans un but thérapeutique en s'appuyant sur la relation d'aide et de soutien  * Vous assurez une activité de liaison et d'orientation avec les proches et le réseau médico\-social  * Vous êtes partenaire de référence de l'équipe pluridisciplinaire pour les questions sociales  * Vous assurez un pôle de référence et d'expertise auprès des membres de l'équipe pluridisciplinaire pour les questions ayant trait aux domaines juridique, assécurologique et administratif  La FLC encourage les postulations internes. Alors si votre profil correspond et que vous êtes intéressé\-e par un nouveau défi professionnel, transmettez\-nous votre dossier (lettre de motivation, CV, diplômes, certificats de travail) via **Entrée en fonction :** dès le 1er décembre 2026 **Besoin de renseignements complémentaires ?**Contactez Monsieur REYNAUD, Responsable du CMS de Terre\-Sainte au 022 950 98 20La FLC promeut un environnement de travail agréable, dynamique, varié et durable, ainsi que la formation continue. professionnelles.**Coordination avec les entreprises et les partenaires de formation*** Entretenir des relations de confiance avec les entreprises membres du réseau.* Assurer une communication fluide entre les apprenti\-e\-s, les entreprises, les écoles professionnelles et les autres partenaires concernés.* Accompagner les entreprises dans leurs démarches et répondre à leurs besoins en matière de formation professionnelle.* Assurer un suivi rigoureux des situations et garantir la continuité des échanges entre les parties prenantes.**Développement et prospection du réseau*** Identifier et prospecter de nouvelles entreprises susceptibles de rejoindre le réseau.* Présenter les prestations et les avantages de l'organisation aux entreprises intéressées.* Comprendre les besoins des entreprises et leur proposer des solutions adaptées à leurs possibilités de formation.* Développer et entretenir un portefeuille de partenaires durables.* Participer activement à la promotion de la formation professionnelle dans la région fribourgeoise.Profil recherché-----------------* Vous êtes au bénéfice d'une **formation professionnelle d'employé/e de commerce (CFC obligatoire)*** **Vous échanges avec des interlocuteurs variés et savez instaurer une relation de confiance.* Vous faites preuve d'écoute, de diplomatie, de pragmatisme et d'un bon sens des responsabilités.* Vous êtes **autonome**, **proactif\-ve** et orienté\-e **solutions**.* Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels et disposez d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles en français.jpid6b7addcjm jpit1043jm title: Key Account Manager
description: Ref 2586485 \| Date: 20 Oct 2026![Société des Produits Nestlé  ]( )Be a part of Nestlé. Be a force for good.Help us make a real difference on a global scale. With a presence in almost 185 countries, we're dedicated to our purpose of unlocking the power of food and beverages to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. Whether you're starting or continuing your career, explore how you can work with us.Key Account Manager**Location and work model:** La\-Tour\-de\-Peilz, with regular customer visits across Switzerland and a remote working policy  **Contract type / duration:** Permanent  **Activity rate:** 80\-100%**Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet**As a Key Account Manager at Nestlé Purina PetCare Switzerland, your mission is to own and steer the commercial performance of strategic retail customers in Switzerland, delivering sustainable growth, profitability, market share and excellent execution. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with customer stakeholders and with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and key support teams. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and deliver meaningful results that make a difference at scale.**How you'll make an impact as a** **Key Account Manager*** Leading the commercial performance of assigned retail customers, taking ownership of sales, profitability, market share, distribution, forecasting and trade investment outcomes* Driving customer strategy and joint business planning that translate category priorities into strong customer plans and sustainable profitable growth* Building trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders and leading impactful negotiations supported by strong financial insight, clear priorities and sound investment choices* Steering accurate customer forecasting, baseline and promotional planning, while driving best\-in\-class execution of promotions, launches, distribution initiatives and commercial plans to strengthen customer and category performance* Turning shopper, category, customer and financial insights into fact\-based recommendations that improve business performance and decision\-making* Aligning cross\-functional teams around customer priorities, enabling focused execution and creating shared value for customers, consumers and Purina**What will make you successful*** Bringing relevant expertise gained through education or professional experience combined with proven track record in solid key account management in fast\-moving consumer goods or retail, with proven ownership of customer growth, profitability and market share* Bringing eCommerce experience would be a strong asset* Applying strong commercial and financial acumen to manage customer performance, trade investments, forecasting, budgeting and profitability decisions* Using negotiation, customer planning and relationship\-building skills to influence senior stakeholders and deliver mutually valuable business outcome* Collaborating across functions with confidence, resilience and accountability to turn strategies, insights and priorities into excellent execution* Communicating fluently in German and English, French is an advantage.* Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value**At Nestlé Purina PetCare Switzerland, we place people at the heart of everything we do**Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:* Paid holidays beyond legal requirements* Learning and development opportunities to grow your career* Performance based bonus* Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program* Strong employer contribution to your pension plan* Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions* Attractive employee discounts across various products and services**What to expect from our hiring process**We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.  *Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.***Ready to Be a Force for Good?**Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.  \#nestlecareerswitzerlandjpid25504b4jm jpit1043jm jpiy26jm

Test Engineer \- Function Validation (m/f/x)
============================================

Your Responsibilities
---------------------

* You are responsible for the development, improvement and validation of the performance of axial piston machines
* You are responsible for establishing and improving standardised and automated test procedures to ensure reliable results and high quality
* You analyse measurement results and propose optimisation measures to improve products and reduce costs
* You use simulation tools to facilitate the interpretation and understanding of test results
* You identify the root causes of technical problems and independently develop innovative solutions
* You manage the implementation and evaluation of functional tests
* You provide technical expertise to assembly operators and test bench operators to ensure smooth operations
* You collaborate with various departments and internal customers to ensure effective coordination and the smooth execution of tests


Your Profile
------------

* You hold a higher education in microengineering, mechatronics, systems engineering or an equivalent field
* You have several years of professional experience in hydraulic systems development
* You are fluent in French and German and have a good command of English
* You have excellent knowledge of MS Office, Python, MATLAB, HBM Catman and NI DIAdem
* You have excellent analytical skills and demonstrate commitment, flexibility and autonomy. You also possess excellent professional communication skills


Our Offer
---------

Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family\-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us.

In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Anna KOMARDINA.

**One Passion. Many Opportunities.**

The company
-----------

​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace.

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Responsable applicatif (Domaine du laboratoire)---Responsable applicatif (Domaine du laboratoire)===============================================L’hôpital fribourgeois (HFR) s’engage au quotidien pour la santé de la population. Actif sur plusieurs sites, il offre une gamme complète de soins stationnaires et ambulatoires de haute qualité, en plaçant le bien\-être des patients au cœur de ses préoccupations. Respect, orientation patients, solidarité et engagement constituent les valeurs essentielles de ses 3’800 collaboratrices et collaborateurs.Vous avez l'opportunité de jouer un rôle clé dans la digitalisation au sein d'un hôpital au service de la population Fribourgeoise. Si vous avez une passion pour la technologie, la santé et l'innovation, cette opportunité est faite pour vous.  Responsable applicatif (Domaine du laboratoire)===============================================ace à une activité croissante et des projets stratégiques en constante évolution, nous cherchons à renforcer notre équipe dédiée à la gestion des applications du système d’information médico\-technique. Rejoignez\-nous pour contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue de nos services et accompagner notre développement. **Missions principales**Dans le cadre de la gestion du système d’information médico\-technique du domaine du laboratoire, vous serez chargé\-e de : **Gestion et exploitation des applications :*** Planifier, organiser et assurer l’exploitation courante d’un portefeuille d’applications supportant les activités du laboratoire.  * Coordonner la maintenance évolutive des applications en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles.   **Coordination et relation fournisseurs :*** Assurer la liaison entre les utilisateurs, les équipes informatiques et les fournisseurs.   **Développement et intégration :*** Développer des interfaces et des scripts pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels spécifiques.   **Documentation et support :*** Rédiger, mettre à jour et gérer la documentation relative aux solutions logicielles, en partenariat avec les parties prenantes métiers.  * Fournir un support de 2ème niveau et servir de relais vers le support 3ème niveau (fournisseurs).  * Participer régulièrement au service de piquet du système d’information pour garantir la disponibilité et la continuité des services.   **Participation aux projets SI :*** Contribuer activement aux projets de l’HFR en lien avec le système d’information, en apportant votre expertise et vos recommandations.   **Projet Phare**Vous aurez l'opportunité unique de contribuer à un projet d'envergure : le renouvellement du dossier patient de l'hôpital. Ce projet, prévu pour les prochaines années, est un jalon important dans notre parcours d'innovation et d'amélioration continue de la qualité des soins. **Vos avantages*** Un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant au sein d'une équipe dédiée à l'excellence dans les soins de santé.  * La chance de travailler sur des projets innovants et d'avoir un impact réel sur le bien\-être des patients.  * Des opportunités de formation continue et de développement professionnel.   **Votre profil :*** Formation supérieure (HES/EPF/Uni, brevet fédéral) en informatique ou équivalent  * Expérience dans la gestion technique d’applications et en coordinations d’intervenants  * Bonnes connaissances en SQL  * Compétences en développement de scripts et en intégration de solutions logicielles  * Avoir une expérience professionnelle dans une institution de soins constitue un plus  * Rigoureux\-se, consciencieux\-se et résistant\-e au stress  * Dynamique et ayant le sens des responsabilités  * Capacité à travailler en équipe, sens de la communication et esprit analytique.  * Langue maternelle français ou allemand avec de très bonnes connaissances de l’autre langue et de l’anglais (technique)   **Entrée en fonction :** 1er janvier 2027ou à convenir **Renseignements :** , Responsable des systèmes informatiques, tél : **Délai de postulation :** 31 octobre 2026Réf : HFR\-A\-264201   ![HFR Fribourg - Hôpital cantonal]()* Chemin des Pensionnats 2\-6 1708 Fribourg** ![HFR Fribourg - Hôpital cantonal]()* Chemin des Pensionnats 2\-6 1708 Fribourg**jidca7e72ejm jit1042jm jiy26jm

title: Local Hosting Service Owner
description:
Local Hosting Service Owner (m/f/d) (80\-100%)  


  








Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy\-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best\-in\-class products, services, and solutions that are mission\-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting\-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.




Local Hosting Service Owner (m/f/d) (80\-100%)
==============================================




  








As a Local Hosting Service Owner (m/f/d), you are responsible for the reliable, secure, and cost\-efficient delivery of local hosting and infrastructure services across Accelleron’s locations in Switzerland.



You take end\-to\-end ownership of on\-premises hosting environments, including servers, virtualization, storage, dedicated High\-Performance Computing (HPC) environments, and local data center infrastructure, ensuring stable operations, continuous improvement, service quality, and alignment with business needs.



Acting as the key interface between factory IT, global Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams, service providers, and external partners, you ensure local requirements, enterprise standards, security policies, and strategic technology initiatives are effectively aligned and implemented. You manage changes, risks, compliance, service performance, resilience, and operational excellence through effective governance and stakeholder collaboration.



The role combines operational service ownership (RUN) with active contribution to infrastructure projects and modernization initiatives (BUILD), supporting factory growth, engineering and simulation environments, business continuity, lifecycle management, and long\-term infrastructure strategy from solution design through operational handover.



If you are a team player, a structured, reliable, and hands\-on infrastructure professional with strong stakeholder management skills a passion for delivering reliable services in a manufacturing and engineering environment, we look forward to getting to know you.



Your Responsibilities:
----------------------



### *Service Ownership \& Operations (RUN)*



* Own and continuously improve local hosting services, including servers, virtualization, storage, HPC environments, and data center infrastructure across Accelleron’s Swiss locations.
* Ensure stable, secure, resilient, and SLA\-driven operations for business\-critical factory and engineering environments.
* Act as technical authority for local hosting platforms, including capacity planning, infrastructure standards, and service governance.
* Manage incidents, problem resolution, root\-cause analyses, escalations, and operational risks.
* Ensure compliance with security, cybersecurity, regulatory, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements.
* Serve as the primary interface between local factory operations, global Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams, and service providers.


### Lifecycle, Documentation \& Governance



* Define and maintain lifecycle, capacity, refresh, and modernization roadmaps for hosting services.
* Maintain infrastructure, asset, and operational documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, standardization, automation, and governance.
* Coordinate budgeting, purchasing, vendor governance, and service reviews with internal and external stakeholders.


### Vendor, Contract \& Cost Management



* Manage service providers, contracts, budgets, forecasts, and operational costs.
* Monitor and improve service delivery through SLA/KPI governance, escalation management, and performance reviews.
* Ensure effective collaboration between local service providers and global IT teams.


### Project \& Initiative Contribution (BUILD)



* Support and lead hosting\-related projects from solution design through implementation and operational handover.
* Lead and/or contribute to factory, infrastructure, modernization, and site expansion initiatives.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, application, cybersecurity, and external partner teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
* Drive automation, standardization, resiliency, and operational excellence across the hosting landscape.


Your Background \& Skills:
--------------------------



* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a comparable technical field.
* Strong expertise in on\-premises hosting, virtualization, storage, and data center technologies.
* Experience as a Service Owner or in managing infrastructure services with responsibility for SLAs, KPIs, service governance, and continuous improvement.
* Understanding of cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Experience in IT service operations, incident management, and vendor management; ITSM knowledge is an advantage.
* Experience in budget planning, cost management, and enterprise procurement processes; SAP knowledge is beneficial.
* Experience with infrastructure standardization, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Experience supporting manufacturing, engineering, or other business\-critical operational environments is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in a global IT environment with international teams and service providers.
* Fluent German and good English (minimum B2\).
* High ownership, reliability, and willingness to support sites across Switzerland.


Your Benefits:
--------------



* Competitive compensation package.


* Performance\-related bonus opportunities for eligible employees.
* Supportive culture focused on trust, accountability, and flexibility.


* Global Parental Leave Program.


* Employee Assistance Program.


* Health and well\-being initiatives.


* Company canteen.


* Opportunities to work with global teams and industry\-leading technologies in a modern workplace.


We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website [](/).

Test Engineer \- Function Validation (m/f/x)
============================================

Your Responsibilities
---------------------

* You are responsible for the development, improvement and validation of the performance of axial piston machines
* You are responsible for establishing and improving standardised and automated test procedures to ensure reliable results and high quality
* You analyse measurement results and propose optimisation measures to improve products and reduce costs
* You use simulation tools to facilitate the interpretation and understanding of test results
* You identify the root causes of technical problems and independently develop innovative solutions
* You manage the implementation and evaluation of functional tests
* You provide technical expertise to assembly operators and test bench operators to ensure smooth operations
* You collaborate with various departments and internal customers to ensure effective coordination and the smooth execution of tests


Your Profile
------------

* You hold a higher education in microengineering, mechatronics, systems engineering or an equivalent field
* You have several years of professional experience in hydraulic systems development
* You are fluent in French and German and have a good command of English
* You have excellent knowledge of MS Office, Python, MATLAB, HBM Catman and NI DIAdem
* You have excellent analytical skills and demonstrate commitment, flexibility and autonomy. You also possess excellent professional communication skills


Our Offer
---------

Can we inspire you to take on a responsible position in a dynamic and independent family business? We offer you room for ideas, a secure job, modern and family\-friendly employment conditions such as flexible working hours, home office, a company restaurant, training opportunities as well as many benefits. The workplace is located in Bulle, surrounded by the wonderful nature of the Gruyère region. Start planning your personal and professional development with us.

In order to ensure a fair application process, we cannot accept applications by post or email.

Have we awoken your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application. If you have any questions, please contact Anna KOMARDINA.

**One Passion. Many Opportunities.**

The company
-----------

​Liebherr Machines Bulle SA is the centre of excellence for combustion engines (diesel and gas engines) and hydraulic components (axial piston pumps and motors). The company develops and produces various products, which find their use in building construction and civil engineering, mining, agriculture, decentralised energy, machine and plant engineering, as well as aerospace.

**MANAGEMENT OF UNIVERSITY ADVISING**1.      management of the Director of University Advising.  2.      Ensure the School Director and other members of the School Council are fully informed regarding trends and patterns and new developments in university applications.  3.      Ensure the School Director and other members of the School Council are fully informed regarding Year 13 university offers.   **MANAGEMENT OF LEARNING SUPPORT AND EXAMINATIONS**1.      management of the Head of Learning Support  2.      To work with the Head of Learning Support to oversee the applications for special consideration.  3.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the planning and management of internal and external examinations  4.      To work with the Assistant Heads to ensure the accurate and timely analysis and publication of examination results   **MANAGEMENT OF SCHOOL EVENTS AND MARKETING MATERIALS**1.      To work with other members of the School Council to ensure school events are well\-planned and run smoothly.  2.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the well\-planning of Prize Giving, Graduation, and parent\-teacher events.  3.      To work with other members of the School Council to ensure the Aiglon Guide is updated annually.  4.      To work with the Marketing and Communications team and the Director of Educational Systems to ensure Aiglon Study Guides are accurate and available to the school community.   **DIVERSITY, EQUALITY AND INCLUSIVITY**1.      Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of the School’s DEIJ policies and procedures.   **SAFEGUARDING**1.      Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of safeguarding legislation and the School’s safeguarding policies and procedures and liaise closely with the Safeguarding lead.   **HEALTH AND SAFETY**1.      Ensure that up\-to\-date knowledge of health and safety legislation applicable to the role is maintained and that the school’s health and safety policies and procedures are fully implemented and adhered to.   **PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT**1.      Maintain and update personal knowledge and skills in line with legislation and the role's needs.   **GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES**1.      To be actively involved in staff recruitment as required by the School Director.  2.      To be on hand out of hours in the event of an emergency.  3.      Attend school functions and events as often as possible and support students and staff in their activities and endeavours.  4.      To be a teacher in their specialist area with a reduced teaching load.  5.      To participate in the duty rota of School Council members on certain weekends and weekend evenings.  6.      To be a member of the Critical Incident team.  7.      To undertake any other reasonable tasks delegated by the School Director.

title: Scientific Assistant – Real-Time Generative Models / Computer Vision
description: EinleitungstextThe Biomedical Image Computing Group develops algorithmic solutions to enable automatic interpretation and forming of biomedical images, aiming to increase efficiency and accuracy in clinical practice and research.ProjekthintergrundThe enhancement of endoscopic videos is a critical yet complex task. These videos are integral to various clinical interventions, where the clarity of imaging data is essential for procedural success. Due to challenging imaging conditions, the quality of endoscopic videos can be significantly compromised by a range of artifacts. This project seeks to develop the next generation of enhancement algorithms tailored for endoscopic videos, with a focus on applications in real-time interventions. Development efforts will prioritize both enhancement quality and computational efficiency, particularly with respect to latency. The successful candidate will join the BMIC team at ETH Zurich and also be part of the Computer Vision Lab (CVL). The project is conducted in collaboration with an industrial implementation partner, who will provide support with hardware and software integration. The position is open immediately and initially limited to 8 months. Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungThis position involves the implementation, optimization, and deployment of deep-learning image-enhancement models for real-time operation. Rather than focusing primarily on model training, the successful candidate will work on translating existing and new architectures into efficient real-time processing pipelines connected directly to an industrial camera system. Typical tasks will include profiling and optimizing models for low-latency inference, implementing and adapting neural-network architectures with real-time constraints in mind, integrating camera acquisition and preprocessing pipelines, and contributing to project deliverables and scientific manuscript preparation. Ihr ProfilMSc degree in computer science, machine learning, medical image computing, or a related field. Familiarity with neural-network-based image processing pipelines. Excellent programming skills and experience with Python. Experience implementing and validating neural-network architectures using PyTorch. Demonstrable experience with model deployment/acceleration (PyTorch, ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA/C++, etc.), profiling tools, and camera/sensor integration is a plus. Wir bietenYour job with impact: Become part of ETH Zurich, which not only supports your professional development, but also actively contributes to positive change in societyYou can expect numerous benefits, such as public transport season tickets and car sharing, a wide range of sports offered by the ASVZ, childcare and attractive pension benefitsNeugierig? Sind wir auch.We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:CVRecommendation Letter (if available)Further information about Biomedical Image Computing can be found on our Website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Julio Jose Silva Rodríguez, julio.silva-rodriguez@vision.ee.ethz.ch (no applications).Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

title: Accountant
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Accountant--- Accountant==========Your **Mission**At World Gymnastics, sound financial management underpins the delivery of the federation’s events, memberships and services. Based at the headquarters in Lausanne and reporting to the Finance Director, the Accountant ensures the accurate, timely and compliant management of the federation’s financial operations. You handle accounts payable and receivable, maintain the general ledger, manage event\-related invoicing and support budget preparation and monitoring, working closely with the sport management units and other departments to guarantee correct financial data capture and standardised procedures across the organisation.Your **Responsibilities**Process payments, receipts and related transactions accurately and on time, in line with internal procedures and regulatory requirements, including bank reconciliations and cash management.Prepare, issue and follow up invoices for events, memberships and services, ensuring correct allocation and timely collection.Manage and capture supplier invoices, expense allowances, employee expense claims and petty cash, ensuring proper documentation and approval processes.Support the Finance team in the preparation of annual and multi\-year budgets, maintain budget tracking tools and provide comparative analysis between periods.Develop, implement and maintain standardised financial processes, templates and documentation, proactively propose improvements to processes and tools (automation, digitalisation, reporting) and train colleagues as needed.Liaise with sport managers and other departments to ensure accurate and complete financial information.Provide data, reconciliations and analysis to support internal and external financial reporting, including audits.About **You**Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.Minimum 3 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in an international or non\-profit environment; experience in an event\-driven or sports organisation is an asset.Solid knowledge of accounting principles and financial regulations applicable in Switzerland.Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced functions, pivot tables) and financial software, with hands\-on experience in invoicing and accounts reconciliation.Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, high attention to detail and the ability to organise and prioritise your workload under deadlines.Team player with a genuine service mindset, acting as a responsive and reliable point of contact for finance questions in a multicultural organisation.Proactive and solution\-oriented mindset, with effective communication skills and respect for discretion and confidentiality.Fluency in French and strong written and spoken English.Valid Swiss work permit. We **Offer**Being part of a leading international sports federation and contributing to the smooth running of the organisation behind a globally recognised Olympic sport.A varied role within a collaborative Finance team open to new ideas, covering payables and receivables, event invoicing, budget support and process improvement.A human\-sized, multicultural environment fostering collaboration, trust and autonomy, with room for professional growth.Regular interaction with sports and other departments, in an environment where your initiatives to improve the way we work are welcome and valued. About **World Gymnastics**The Fédération Internationale de Gymnastique (FIG), operating under its brand World Gymnastics™, is the international governing body recognised by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) for the sport of gymnastics. Founded in 1881, it is the oldest established international federation of an Olympic sport and has been part of the Olympic Games since their revival in 1896\. FIG governs nine sports: Gymnastics for All, ’s and Women’s Artistic, Rhythmic, Trampoline \& Tumbling, Acrobatics, Aerobics, Parkour and Paragymnastics. Through the World Gymnastics™ brand, the federation promotes participation, inspires engagement, and supports the long\-term development of the sport worldwide. FIG brings together 165 member federations and engages millions of athletes, coaches, officials, and fans, making gymnastics one of the world’s most widely practiced and watched sports.World Gymnastics™ is a trademark of the Fédération Internationale de Gymnastique (FIG).*At World Gymnastics, we foster trust, promote equality, celebrate diversity and ensure gymnastics thrives with integrity, innovation and inclusivity worldwide*  \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-We believe that in order to recruit the best professionals all applications must be reviewed equally. For this reason, all the elements you wish to share with us in your file are not discriminating (photo, age, gender, location for example). We are committed to offering equal opportunities. If your application is selected, we will reach out for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role.When applying to this career opportunity, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that, in accordance with relevant legal regulations, World Gymnastics will collect and process his/her personal information for the purpose of contacting you and to analyse if your profile meets our criteria for the job. In the absence of a favourable response from us, we will keep your personal data for a limited period so that we can contact you again if we have new job offers.![Fédération Internationale de Gymnastique]()* Fédération Internationale de Gymnastique  Avenue de la Gare 12A  1003 Lausanne*jidf23b2cajm jit1043jm jiy26jm

description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Deputy School Director (Academic)---Deputy School Director (Academic)================================= **Aiglon College** seeks to appoint a suitably qualified  Deputy School Director (Academic)=================================to join the school from: **23\.08\.2027** **Your profile**The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application. **About us**Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not\-for\-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world\-class education in a stunning alpine setting.The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes. **What we offer**Aiglon is dedicated to the well\-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages. **How to apply**Deadline for applications: **23\.10\.2026**Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered. **Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.** **Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.**You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s . **JOB PURPOSE**The role of Deputy School Director is a key management and leadership position in the school, and they are a pivotal member of both the School Council (the leadership team) overseeing many aspects of the operational management and leadership of the School. The role is primarily concerned with the school's academic leadership, with the other Deputy School Directors leading and managing school safeguarding, wellbeing, character education and boarding functions. Additionally, the Deputy School Director is an integral part of the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), working alongside the School Director, CFO/COO, and other Deputy School Directors. Aiglon, distinguished by its philosophy and ethos, prioritises the holistic development of every child. As a school committed to character development and holistic education, we prioritise the student experience and ensure their wellbeing and safety, which are fundamental to their journey at Aiglon. **OBJECTIVES***      To deputise for the School Director as and when required.  *      To manage all academic aspects of the school.  *      The following list should not be considered definitive but act as a guide to those areas for which the Deputy School Director will be responsible.   **KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **MEMBERSHIP OF THE SCHOOL LEADERSHIP TEAM**1.      To be a member of the School Council and the ELT.  2.      To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.  3.      To ensure student needs and interests are placed at the forefront of all decisions made at the school.  4.      To be fully involved in the whole\-school strategic planning and implementing and developing the school’s vision of education.  5.      To be the representative and advocate for all direct reports.  6.      To work with all members of the School Council to ensure that students’ education is appropriate, broad, balanced and effective across all aspects of school life and that the well\-being and safeguarding of students are prioritised.  7.      Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.  8.      Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.   **MANAGEMENT AND LEADERSHIP OF ACADEMIC ASPECTS OF THE SCHOOL, INCLUDING LEARNING, TEACHING, AND ASSESSMENT**1.      To monitor and evaluate the quality of teaching and learning in the school and to be proactive in devising and implementing strategies for high performance in these areas.  2.      Oversee the school reporting structure and academic assessment plans and monitor their delivery.  3.      To advise the School Director on academic policy and carry overall responsibility for the school's academic life, including chairing the Academic Leadership Group and leading new initiatives such as curriculum reviews and effective academic monitoring of students.  4.      To act as line manager to the ALG, Academic Heads of Departments and University Advising departments.  5.      To oversee the Learning Support Department and monitor the provision of Learning Support.  6.      In conjunction with the Assistant Heads, monitor and analyse all school public examination results.  7.      Management of student data and trends regarding academic performance and potential, including but not limited to overseeing the analysis and dissemination of data from year group examinations (e.g. MIDYIS and ALIS) and overseeing target setting and the administration of other measures of value added and academic performance.   **LEADERSHIP OF STAFFING, INCLUDING RECRUITMENT**1.      To be fully involved in recruiting new academic staff.  2.      To oversee the management of staff professional development days, inset and CPD (in conjunction with other members of the School Leadership Team).  3.      To be fully involved in new staff induction programmes (in conjunction with other members of the School Leadership Team).  4.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the academic staff have regular and useful performance management reviews.  5.      Manage the school’s PGCE programme.   **LEADERSHIP OF WHOLE\-SCHOOL ACCREDITATION**1.      To line\-manage the Accreditation Coordinator and ensure that all aspects of accreditation (CIS, NEASC, and IB) are well\-organised and well\-planned and that the School Director and School Council are fully informed about the progress of accreditation.   **MANAGEMENT OF UNIVERSITY ADVISING**1.      management of the Director of University Advising.  2.      Ensure the School Director and other members of the School Council are fully informed regarding trends and patterns and new developments in university applications.  3.      Ensure the School Director and other members of the School Council are fully informed regarding Year 13 university offers.   **MANAGEMENT OF LEARNING SUPPORT AND EXAMINATIONS**1.      management of the Head of Learning Support  2.      To work with the Head of Learning Support to oversee the applications for special consideration.  3.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the planning and management of internal and external examinations  4.      To work with the Assistant Heads to ensure the accurate and timely analysis and publication of examination results   **MANAGEMENT OF SCHOOL EVENTS AND MARKETING MATERIALS**1.      To work with other members of the School Council to ensure school events are well\-planned and run smoothly.  2.      To work with the Director of Educational Systems to ensure the well\-planning of Prize Giving, Graduation, and parent\-teacher events.  3.      To work with other members of the School Council to ensure the Aiglon Guide is updated annually.  4.      To work with the Marketing and Communications team and the Director of Educational Systems to ensure Aiglon Study Guides are accurate and available to the school community.   **DIVERSITY, EQUALITY AND INCLUSIVITY**1.      Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of the School’s DEIJ policies and procedures.   **SAFEGUARDING**1.      Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of safeguarding legislation and the School’s safeguarding policies and procedures and liaise closely with the Safeguarding lead.   **HEALTH AND SAFETY**1.      Ensure that up\-to\-date knowledge of health and safety legislation applicable to the role is maintained and that the school’s health and safety policies and procedures are fully implemented and adhered to.   **PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT**1.      Maintain and update personal knowledge and skills in line with legislation and the role's needs.   **GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES**1.      To be actively involved in staff recruitment as required by the School Director.  2.      To be on hand out of hours in the event of an emergency.  3.      Attend school functions and events as often as possible and support students and staff in their activities and endeavours.  4.      To be a teacher in their specialist area with a reduced teaching load.  5.      To participate in the duty rota of School Council members on certain weekends and weekend evenings.  6.      To be a member of the Critical Incident team.  7.      To undertake any other reasonable tasks delegated by the School Director.

title: R&D Internship - Corrosion Protection 100%
description: R&amp;D Internship - Corrosion ProtectionPurpose of the roleWe at VAT Group AG invite a talented and passionate Internship candidate to join our Corporate R&amp;D.Fueled by the ever-growing demand for computational power, the leading-edge technology nodes (≤7nm) require process control at the atomic scale. At VAT, we are developing the next generation of advanced sensing and vacuum solutions for the semiconductor industry. Semiconductor manufacturing processes often utilize corrosive gases and plasma environments that pose a risk for VAT’s products. We are seeking an intern to join our team and focus on advancing the corrosion protection strategies for our sensors and products. This internship will be located in Zürich, Switzerland and will require occasional travel to Haag, Switzerland.What we offer  *  Join a global leader at the forefront of semiconductor innovation, we are a globally leading company in the semiconductor industry.  *  A technologically advanced and innovative working environment with Modern Laboratory and testing facilities.  *  Thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment that celebrates bold ideas and outstanding execution — where your potential knows no bounds.  *  Enjoy an exceptional working environment with great amenities at our VAT Group offices in Zurich and Haag.  *  Receive competitive compensation and benefits aligned with your expertise and contributions.Responsibilities   *  Support the development of protective measures to enhance material and sensor durability under extreme conditions.  *  Assist in the design, implementation, and testing of corrosion protection strategies.  *  Conduct failure analysis and material testing to identify failure mechanisms.  *  Design experiments for testing the durability of VAT’s products in plasma etching systems.Your competencies acquired at the end of the internshipThis internship aims to provide you with practical skills and knowledge in testing and experimental procedures in the semiconductor industry, preparing you for a future technical career. As a research &amp; development intern in our dynamic environment, you will get the opportunity to work on real-life industrial challenges. By the end of the internship, you will have acquired the following competencies:  *  Technical Skills: Gain hands-on experience in a cross-disciplinary project, where you will expand your knowledge in physics, chemistry, materials science, and both mechanical and electrical engineering.  *  Analytical Skills: Ability to plan, execute, and evaluate experiments, and to analyze and interpret experimental data.  *  Communication Skills: Experience in presenting technical information and progress reports, as well as participating in technical discussions.  *  Problem-Solving Skills: Practical experience in diagnosing and solving real-world problems in the semiconductor industry.  *  Collaboration Skills: Work within a dynamic team, including engineers, materials scientists, and designers, to address complex challenges.  *  Industry Experience: Insight into the practical aspects of product design, testing, and refinement within a commercial product development cycle.Qualifications  *  Current master’s student or recently completed master’s degree in materials science, chemistry, physics, or engineering.  *  Excellent communication skills, able to work independently, and passionate about learning.  *  Experience with or knowledge of material characterization and semiconductor fabrication.  *  (optional) Understanding of dry etching processes and thin-film deposition processes.  *  (optional) Practical experience working in a laboratory or clean environment.

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Head Client Lifecycle Integrity - Director - Member of Senior Management---Head Client Lifecycle Integrity \- Director \- Member of Senior Management==========================================================================At Swissquote, we're all in.  All in to shake things up. All in to build the bank people actually want to use. All in to make finance less boring — and a lot more powerful.We're Switzerland's leading digital bank — 1,400\+ people across Europe, the Middle East and , building real financial solutions for over a million clients worldwide. From trading and investing to everyday banking, we cover the full picture. We move fast, but we build things we're genuinely proud of. Have a look behind the scenes by checking on Instagram.Growing fast creates room. Room to try things, own things, and grow at a pace most places can't offer. Whether you like the spotlight or prefer to just put your head down and do great work, there's space for both here.We've ditched the dress code — but never the chance to celebrate. Big win or small, we make it count. The kind of place where the atmosphere takes care of itself.As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives to join our team and contribute to our shared success.Feeling it? It's a good start. Apply.Head Client Lifecycle Integrity \- Director \- Member of Senior Management==========================================================================As part of its ongoing organisational evolution, Swissquote is creating a new department, theClient Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) Department. Acting as a1\.5 line of defence and independent from the Front Office, the CLI brings together key activities supporting the integrity\-related management of private client relationships throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and periodic reviews to AML transaction monitoring.In this context, the Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will play a key leadership role in shaping and implementing the new organisation. As a member of Senior Management and Director, the role is responsible for defining the CLI's strategic direction, establishing an effective and forward\-looking operating model, driving a culture ofcontinuous improvement and operational excellence and ensuring the successful integration and performance of its different activities, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies. The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity shall in particular have a strong focus on technology enablement, AI\-driven optimisation and operational scalability, with a strong client\-centric and data\-driven approach.The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will act as a senior partner to the Executive Management and work closely with the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department as well as technology functions to continuously enhance the Bank's integrity\-related client lifecycle framework.  **Key responsibilities:** **1\. Leadership, Governance \& Stakeholder Management*** Lead the CLI, defining its strategy, organisation, governance and priorities, and establishing clear accountability across the department.* Establish and maintain a strong, risk\-based control environment, ensuring that all activities within the CLI's remit are effective, consistent and compliant with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.* Provide senior leadership and direction on complex or sensitive cases and operational matters, driving appropriate escalation and decision\-making.* Represent the CLI at Senior Management and in relevant governance bodies, and act as a strategic partner to the Executive Management, the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department and other key stakeholders.* Serve as a senior point of contact for FINMA, auditors and other relevant external stakeholders within the CLI's area of responsibility.* Drive high standards, quality and effectiveness across the different CLI activities, supported by appropriate policies, procedures, controls, management information and risk and performance indicators.* Ensure timely reporting of key risk and performance indicators to the Executive Management and relevant governance bodies.* Build and develop a high\-performing management team and foster a culture of strong control, collaboration and operational excellence.* Contribute to the preparation of external and internal audits, inspections as well as regulatory reviews. **2\. Client Onboarding, Integrity\-related Lifecycle Management \& AML Transaction Monitoring*** Oversee private client onboarding (incl. with respect to prospects introduced or managed by Group foreign entities), in line with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.* Oversee integrity\-related lifecycle activities, including periodic and event\-driven reviews, changes in circumstances, account maintenance, dormant account processes and closures, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.* Oversee AML transaction monitoring across all client segments, ensuring effective identification, assessment and escalation of potentially suspicious activities.* Ensure appropriate risk management and robust governance for complex or high\-risk client relationships and transactions, while maintaining effective collaboration with Front Office and the Compliance Department. **3\.
