description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Head of Years (Up to Year 4)---Head of Years (Up to Year 4\)============================= **Aiglon College** seeks to appoint a suitably qualified  Head of Years (Up to Year 4\)=============================to join the school from:  **2027** **Your profile**The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application. **About us**Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not\-for\-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world\-class education in a stunning alpine setting.The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes. **What we offer**Aiglon is dedicated to the well\-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages. **How to apply**Deadline for applications: **30\.10\.2026**Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered. **Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.** **Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.**You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s .JOB PURPOSEAiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 500 students aged 5\-18 representing 65 nations. In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The school is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the Senior School with a dedicated focus on students up to Year 8\.The school wishes to appoint, for 2027 (possibly January or 2027 for the right candidate), an innovative, caring, and dynamic Head of Years (Up to Year 4\) who will provide operational leadership, and support strategic development, for the lower junior phase up to Year 4, line manage class teachers and teaching assistants up to Year 4, and work in close partnership with the Director of School and Head of Curriculum and Academics.The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced primary/early years specialist with leadership experience, ideally in an international setting, who has expertise in early childhood education, literacy and numeracy foundations, and outdoor/experiential learning. Knowledge of inquiry based learning, project based learning, or biophilic education would be preferable.This position involves a teaching component and presents a unique opportunity to lead and nurture our youngest learners in a world\-class alpine environment.KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES*      To put the students first.  *      To lead the day\-to\-day operational and educational provision for students up to Year 4, working in close partnership with and under the strategic oversight of the Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      To participate actively in School Leadership Team meetings and contribute to strategic planning for the lower primary phase.  *      Direct line management of classroom teachers and teaching assistants across years up to Year 4, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and high\-performing staff team.  *      Direct operational delivery and coordination of the Mountain School programme up to Year 4, working closely with the Head of Expeditions and the Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      To be the primary point of contact for day\-to\-day academic, pastoral, and operational matters for families and day students up to Year 4\.  *      To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.  *      Become involved in discipline and pastoral matters up to Year 4, ensuring student behavior aligns with school expectations.  *      To ensure smooth transition and induction for children entering Year 1 and progressing through to Year 4, preparing them seamlessly for upper junior years (Years 5\-6\).  *      To ensure the Guiding Principles are embedded throughout the daily routine and learning environment of students up to Year 4\.  *      To participate in staff recruitment for lower junior phase positions as required by the Director of School and Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      To carry out tasks as delegated by the Director of School and Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      To be a classroom teacher with a reduced teaching load (approx 20% reduction).  *      To embrace innovative forms of assessment, play\-based learning, and holistic reporting for young learners.  Responsibility for the Wellbeing and Safeguarding of Students*      To oversee the daily pastoral care, wellbeing, and progress tracking of all students up to Year 4\.  *      To appreciate the key role of safeguarding in managing student interventions and work closely with the School DSL, Director of School, and wellbeing team.  *      To work with the Director of School, Head of Curriculum and Academics and School DSL in the implementation of policies and statements of good practice for safeguarding, wellbeing, and healthcare in lower primary.  *      To implement a nurturing and sequential Wellbeing programme across years up to Year 4 aligned with the Spirit Curriculum.  *      To promote Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion formally within the Spirit Curriculum to build a kind, positive, and inclusive culture among young learners.  *      To liaise with the Activities Coordinator and House teams to ensure appropriate co\-curricular activities, sports, and outdoor experiences for students up to Year 4\.  Academic Responsibilities*      To lead the daily implementation and delivery of the lower junior curriculum (up to Year 4\), including the 'Wonder' projects and early literacy/numeracy frameworks.  *      To work closely with the Head of Expeditions to plan and deliver the experiential Mountain School curriculum for students up to Year 4\.  *      To champion sustainability, outdoor exploration, and biophilic education within the classroom and Mountain School activities.  *      To ensure Aiglon's Guiding Principles for learning are embedded in all teaching and learning activities for students up to Year 4\.  *      To assist in monitoring student progress, organising learning interventions, and supporting personalised learning in coordination with the Head of Learning Support and Head of EAL.  *      To support the Head of Curriculum and Academics in teacher professional reviews and development for staff who teach up to Year 4\.  *      To assist in overseeing internal assessments, reporting structures, and parent\-teacher communication up to Year 4\.  *      To promote and ensure effective and safe usage of school educational technology (such as Google Apps for Education and age\-appropriate devices).  *      To participate in staff development days and continuous professional learning for the lower primary phase.  *      To monitor and enhance standards of teaching, learning, and classroom environment up to Year 4\.  *      Undertake any other task which may be reasonably required by the Director of the School or Head of Curriculum and Academics.  *      Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.  *      Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.  *      Embrace artificial intelligence and other related educational innovations to enhance early learning experiences.  This job outline only contains the main accountabilities relating to the post of Head of Years (Up to Year 4\) and does not describe in detail all of the duties required to carry them out. The Head of Years (Up to Year 4\) may be required to undertake other duties and responsibilities that are commensurate with the nature and level of the post.     ![AIGLON COLLEGE SA]()* Avenue Centrale 61 1885 Chesières (VD)** ![AIGLON COLLEGE SA]()* Avenue Centrale 61 1885 Chesières (VD)**jid61657adjm jit1043jm jiy26jm
